name: toList_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toList_cons (a : Lists α) (l) : toList (cons a l) = a :: l.toList

name: to_ofList
statement:
@[simp]
theorem to_ofList (l : List (Lists α)) : toList (ofList l) = l

name: of_toList
statement:
@[simp]
theorem of_toList : ∀ l : Lists' α true, ofList (toList l) = l
proof:
:=
  suffices ∀ (b) (h : true = b) (l : Lists' α b),
      let l' : Lists' α true := h ▸ l
      ofList (toList l') = l'
    from this _ rfl
  fun b h l => by
    induction l with
    | atom => cases h
    | nil => simp
    | cons' b a _ IH => simpa [cons] using IH rfl

name: mem_def
statement: theorem mem_def {b a} {l : Lists' α b} : a ∈ l ↔ ∃ a' ∈ l.toList, a ~ a'

name: mem_cons
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_cons {a y l} : a ∈ @cons α y l ↔ a ~ y ∨ a ∈ l

name: cons_subset
statement: theorem cons_subset {a} {l₁ l₂ : Lists' α true} : Lists'.cons a l₁ ⊆ l₂ ↔ a ∈ l₂ ∧ l₁ ⊆ l₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨⟨a', m, e⟩, s⟩ => Subset.cons e m s⟩
  generalize h' : Lists'.cons a l₁ = l₁' at h
  obtain - | @⟨a', _, _, _, e, m, s⟩ := h
  · cases a
    cases h'
  cases a; cases a'; cases h'; exact ⟨⟨_, m, e⟩, s⟩

name: ofList_subset
statement:
theorem ofList_subset {l₁ l₂ : List (Lists α)} (h : l₁ ⊆ l₂) :
    Lists'.ofList l₁ ⊆ Lists'.ofList l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => exact Subset.nil
  | cons _ _ l₁_ih =>
    refine Subset.cons (Lists.Equiv.refl _) ?_ (l₁_ih (List.subset_of_cons_subset h))
    simp only [List.cons_subset] at h; simp [h]

name: Subset.refl
statement:
@[refl]
theorem Subset.refl {l : Lists' α true} : l ⊆ l
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Lists'.of_toList l]; exact ofList_subset (List.Subset.refl _)

name: subset_nil
statement: theorem subset_nil {l : Lists' α true} : l ⊆ Lists'.nil → l = Lists'.nil
proof:
:= by
  rw [← of_toList l]
  induction toList l <;> intro h
  · rfl
  · rcases cons_subset.1 h with ⟨⟨_, ⟨⟩, _⟩, _⟩

name: mem_of_subset'
statement:
theorem mem_of_subset' {a} : ∀ {l₁ l₂ : Lists' α true} (_ : l₁ ⊆ l₂) (_ : a ∈ l₁.toList), a ∈ l₂
  | nil, _, Lists'.Subset.nil, h => by cases h
  | cons' a0 l0, l₂, s, h => by
    obtain - | ⟨e, m, s⟩
proof:
:= s
    simp only [toList, Sigma.eta, List.mem_cons] at h
    rcases h with (rfl | h)
    · exact ⟨_, m, e⟩
    · exact mem_of_subset' s h

name: subset_def
statement: theorem subset_def {l₁ l₂ : Lists' α true} : l₁ ⊆ l₂ ↔ ∀ a ∈ l₁.toList, a ∈ l₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H _ => mem_of_subset' H, fun H => by
    induction l₁ using recOfList with | _ l₁
    induction l₁ with
    | nil => exact Subset.nil
    | cons h t t_ih =>
      simp only [to_ofList, ofList, toList_cons, List.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp] at *
      exact cons_subset.2 ⟨H.1, t_ih H.2⟩⟩

name: isList_toList
statement: theorem isList_toList (l : List (Lists α)) : IsList (ofList l)

name: to_ofList
statement: theorem to_ofList (l : List (Lists α)) : toList (ofList l) = l

name: of_toList
statement:
theorem of_toList : ∀ {l : Lists α}, IsList l → ofList (toList l) = l
  | ⟨true, l⟩, _ => by simp_all [ofList, of']

instance : Inhabited (Lists α)

name: isList_of_mem
statement:
theorem isList_of_mem {a : Lists α} : ∀ {l : Lists α}, a ∈ l → IsList l
  | ⟨_, Lists'.nil⟩, _ => rfl
  | ⟨_, Lists'.cons' _ _⟩, _ => rfl

name: Equiv.antisymm_iff
statement: theorem Equiv.antisymm_iff {l₁ l₂ : Lists' α true} : of' l₁ ~ of' l₂ ↔ l₁ ⊆ l₂ ∧ l₂ ⊆ l₁
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => Equiv.antisymm h₁ h₂⟩
  obtain - | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h
  · simp [Lists'.Subset.refl]
  · exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

name: equiv_atom
statement: theorem equiv_atom {a} {l : Lists α} : atom a ~ l ↔ atom a = l
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; rfl, fun h => h ▸ Equiv.refl _⟩

name: Equiv.symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem Equiv.symm {l₁ l₂ : Lists α} (h : l₁ ~ l₂) : l₂ ~ l₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain - | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h <;> [rfl; exact Equiv.antisymm h₂ h₁]

name: Equiv.trans
statement: theorem Equiv.trans : ∀ {l₁ l₂ l₃ : Lists α}, l₁ ~ l₂ → l₂ ~ l₃ → l₁ ~ l₃
proof:
:= by
  let trans := fun l₁ : Lists α => ∀ ⦃l₂ l₃⦄, l₁ ~ l₂ → l₂ ~ l₃ → l₁ ~ l₃
  suffices PProd (∀ l₁, trans l₁) (∀ (l : Lists' α true), ∀ l' ∈ l.toList, trans l') by exact this.1
  apply inductionMut
  · intro a l₂ l₃ h₁ h₂
    rwa [← equiv_atom.1 h₁] at h₂
  · intro l₁ IH l₂ l₃ h₁ h₂
    obtain - | l₂ := id h₁
    · exact h₂
    obtain - | l₃ := id h₂
    · exact h₁
    obtain ⟨hl₁, hr₁⟩ := Equiv.antisymm_iff.1 h₁
    obtain ⟨hl₂, hr₂⟩ := Equiv.antisymm_iff.1 h₂
    apply Equiv.antisymm_iff.2; constructor <;> apply Lists'.subset_def.2
    · intro a₁ m₁
      rcases Lists'.mem_of_subset' hl₁ m₁ with ⟨a₂, m₂, e₁₂⟩
      rcases Lists'.mem_of_subset' hl₂ m₂ with ⟨a₃, m₃, e₂₃⟩
      exact ⟨a₃, m₃, IH _ m₁ e₁₂ e₂₃⟩
    · intro a₃ m₃
      rcases Lists'.mem_of_subset' hr₂ m₃ with ⟨a₂, m₂, e₃₂⟩
      rcases Lists'.mem_of_subset' hr₁ m₂ with ⟨a₁, m₁, e₂₁⟩
      exact ⟨a₁, m₁, (IH _ m₁ e₂₁.symm e₃₂.symm).symm⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨⟩
  · intro a l IH₁ IH₂
    simpa using ⟨IH₁, IH₂⟩

name: sizeof_pos
statement: theorem sizeof_pos {b} (l : Lists' α b) : 0 < SizeOf.sizeOf l
proof:
:= by
  cases l <;> simp only [Lists'.atom.sizeOf_spec, Lists'.nil.sizeOf_spec, Lists'.cons'.sizeOf_spec,
    true_or, add_pos_iff, zero_lt_one]

name: lt_sizeof_cons'
statement:
theorem lt_sizeof_cons' {b} (a : Lists' α b) (l) :
    SizeOf.sizeOf (⟨b, a⟩ : Lists α) < SizeOf.sizeOf (Lists'.cons' a l)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Sigma.mk.sizeOf_spec, Lists'.cons'.sizeOf_spec, lt_add_iff_pos_right]
  apply sizeof_pos

name: mem_equiv_left
statement: theorem mem_equiv_left {l : Lists' α true} : ∀ {a a'}, a ~ a' → (a ∈ l ↔ a' ∈ l)
proof:
:=
  suffices ∀ {a a'}, a ~ a' → a ∈ l → a' ∈ l from fun e => ⟨this e, this e.symm⟩
  fun e₁ ⟨_, m₃, e₂⟩ => ⟨_, m₃, e₁.symm.trans e₂⟩

name: mem_of_subset
statement:
theorem mem_of_subset {a} {l₁ l₂ : Lists' α true} (s : l₁ ⊆ l₂) : a ∈ l₁ → a ∈ l₂
  | ⟨_, m, e⟩ => (mem_equiv_left e).2 (mem_of_subset' s m)

name: Subset.trans
statement: theorem Subset.trans {l₁ l₂ l₃ : Lists' α true} (h₁ : l₁ ⊆ l₂) (h₂ : l₂ ⊆ l₃) : l₁ ⊆ l₃
proof:
:=
  subset_def.2 fun _ m₁ => mem_of_subset h₂ <| mem_of_subset' h₁ m₁

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {x y : Class.{u}} : (∀ z : ZFSet.{u}, x z ↔ y z) → x = y

name: mem_def
statement: theorem mem_def (A B : Class.{u}) : A ∈ B ↔ ∃ x : ZFSet, ↑x = A ∧ B x

name: notMem_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem notMem_empty (x : Class.{u}) : x ∉ (∅ : Class.{u})

name: not_empty_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_empty_hom (x : ZFSet.{u}) : ¬(∅ : Class.{u}) x

name: mem_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_univ {A : Class.{u}} : A ∈ univ.{u} ↔ ∃ x : ZFSet.{u}, ↑x = A

name: mem_univ_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_univ_hom (x : ZFSet.{u}) : univ.{u} x

statement: theorem eq_univ_iff_forall {A : Class.{u}} : A = univ ↔ ∀ x : ZFSet, A x

name: eq_univ_of_forall
statement: theorem eq_univ_of_forall {A : Class.{u}} : (∀ x : ZFSet, A x) → A = univ

name: mem_wf
statement: theorem mem_wf : @WellFounded Class.{u} (· ∈ ·)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by
    have H : ∀ x : ZFSet.{u}, @Acc Class.{u} (· ∈ ·) ↑x := by
      refine fun a => ZFSet.inductionOn a fun x IH => ⟨_, ?_⟩
      rintro A ⟨z, rfl, hz⟩
      exact IH z hz
    refine fun A => ⟨A, ?_⟩
    rintro B ⟨x, rfl, _⟩
    exact H x⟩

name: mem_asymm
statement: theorem mem_asymm {x y : Class} : x ∈ y → y ∉ x

name: mem_irrefl
statement: theorem mem_irrefl (x : Class) : x ∉ x

name: univ_notMem_univ
statement: theorem univ_notMem_univ : univ ∉ univ

name: congToClass_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem congToClass_empty : congToClass ∅ = ∅

name: classToCong_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem classToCong_empty : classToCong ∅ = ∅

name: ofSet.inj
statement: theorem ofSet.inj {x y : ZFSet.{u}} (h : (x : Class.{u}) = y) : x = y
proof:
:=
  ZFSet.ext fun z => by
    change (x : Class.{u}) z ↔ (y : Class.{u}) z
    rw [h]

name: toSet_of_ZFSet
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toSet_of_ZFSet (A : Class.{u}) (x : ZFSet.{u}) : ToSet A x ↔ A x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨y, yx, py⟩ => by rwa [ofSet.inj yx] at py, fun px => ⟨x, rfl, px⟩⟩

name: coe_mem
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_mem {x : ZFSet.{u}} {A : Class.{u}} : ↑x ∈ A ↔ A x

name: coe_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_apply {x y : ZFSet.{u}} : (y : Class.{u}) x ↔ x ∈ y

name: coe_subset
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_subset (x y : ZFSet.{u}) : (x : Class.{u}) ⊆ y ↔ x ⊆ y

name: coe_sep
coe_empty
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_empty : ↑(∅ : ZFSet.{u}) = (∅ : Class.{u})
proof:
:=
  ext fun y => iff_false _ ▸ ZFSet.notMem_empty y

statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_insert (x y : ZFSet.{u}) : ↑(insert x y) = @insert ZFSet.{u} Class.{u} _ x y

statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_union (x y : ZFSet.{u}) : ↑(x ∪ y) = (x : Class.{u}) ∪ y

statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_sdiff (x y : ZFSet.{u}) : ↑(x \ y) = (x : Class.{u}) \ y

statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_powerset (x : ZFSet.{u}) : ↑x.powerset = powerset.{u} x

name: powerset_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powerset_apply {A : Class.{u}} {x : ZFSet.{u}} : powerset A x ↔ ↑x ⊆ A

name: sUnion_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sUnion_apply {x : Class} {y : ZFSet} : (⋃₀ x) y ↔ ∃ z : ZFSet, x z ∧ y ∈ z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, ⟨z, rfl, hxz⟩, hyz⟩
    exact ⟨z, hxz, hyz⟩
  · exact fun ⟨z, hxz, hyz⟩ => ⟨_, coe_mem.2 hxz, hyz⟩

name: coe_sUnion
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_sUnion (x : ZFSet.{u}) : ↑(⋃₀ x : ZFSet) = ⋃₀ (x : Class.{u})
proof:
:=
  ext fun y =>
    ZFSet.mem_sUnion.trans (sUnion_apply.trans <| by rfl).symm

name: mem_sUnion
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_sUnion {x y : Class.{u}} : y ∈ ⋃₀ x ↔ ∃ z, z ∈ x ∧ y ∈ z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl, z, hzx, hwz⟩
    exact ⟨z, hzx, coe_mem.2 hwz⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, hwx, z, rfl, hwz⟩
    exact ⟨z, rfl, w, hwx, hwz⟩

name: sInter_apply
statement: theorem sInter_apply {x : Class.{u}} {y : ZFSet.{u}} : (⋂₀ x) y ↔ ∀ z : ZFSet.{u}, x z → y ∈ z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hxy z hxz => hxy _ ⟨z, rfl, hxz⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro H - ⟨z, rfl, hxz⟩
  exact H _ hxz

name: coe_sInter
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_sInter {x : ZFSet.{u}} (h : x.Nonempty) : ↑(⋂₀ x : ZFSet) = ⋂₀ (x : Class.{u})

name: mem_of_mem_sInter
statement: theorem mem_of_mem_sInter {x y z : Class} (hy : y ∈ ⋂₀ x) (hz : z ∈ x) : y ∈ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl, hw⟩ := hy
  exact coe_mem.2 (hw z hz)

name: mem_sInter
statement: theorem mem_sInter {x y : Class.{u}} (h : x.Nonempty) : y ∈ ⋂₀ x ↔ ∀ z, z ∈ x → y ∈ z
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hy z => mem_of_mem_sInter hy, fun H => ?_⟩
  simp_rw [mem_def, sInter_apply]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨y, rfl, _⟩ := H z (coe_mem.2 hz)
  refine ⟨y, rfl, fun w hxw => ?_⟩
  simpa only [coe_mem, coe_apply] using H w (coe_mem.2 hxw)

name: sUnion_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sUnion_empty : ⋃₀ (∅ : Class.{u}) = (∅ : Class.{u})

name: sInter_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sInter_empty : ⋂₀ (∅ : Class.{u}) = univ

name: eq_univ_of_powerset_subset
statement: theorem eq_univ_of_powerset_subset {A : Class} (hA : powerset A ⊆ A) : A = univ
proof:
:=
  eq_univ_of_forall
    (by
      by_contra! hnA
      exact
        WellFounded.min_mem ZFSet.mem_wf _ hnA
          (hA fun x hx =>
            Classical.not_not.1 fun hB =>
              WellFounded.not_lt_min ZFSet.mem_wf _ hB <| coe_apply.1 hx))

name: iota_val
statement: theorem iota_val (A : Class) (x : ZFSet) (H : ∀ y, A y ↔ y = x) : iota A = ↑x
proof:
:=
  ext fun y =>
    ⟨fun ⟨_, ⟨x', rfl, h⟩, yx'⟩ => by rwa [← (H x').1 <| (h x').2 rfl], fun yx =>
      ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl, H⟩, yx⟩⟩

name: iota_ex
statement: theorem iota_ex (A) : iota.{u} A ∈ univ.{u}
proof:
:=
  mem_univ.2 <|
    Or.elim (Classical.em <| ∃ x, ∀ y, A y ↔ y = x) (fun ⟨x, h⟩ => ⟨x, Eq.symm <| iota_val A x h⟩)
      fun hn =>
      ⟨∅, ext fun _ => coe_empty.symm ▸ ⟨False.rec, fun ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl, H⟩, _⟩ => hn ⟨x, H⟩⟩⟩

name: fval_ex
statement: theorem fval_ex (F A : Class.{u}) : F ′ A ∈ univ.{u}

name: map_fval
proof:
:=
  Class.iota_val _ _ fun z => by
    rw [Class.toSet_of_ZFSet, Class.coe_apply, mem_map]
    exact
      ⟨fun ⟨w, _, pr⟩ => by
        let ⟨wy, fw⟩ := ZFSet.pair_injective pr
        rw [← fw, wy], fun e => by
        subst e
        exact ⟨_, h, rfl⟩⟩

name: choice_mem_aux
statement:
theorem choice_mem_aux (h : ∅ ∉ x) (y : ZFSet.{u}) (yx : y ∈ x) :
    (Classical.epsilon fun z : ZFSet.{u} => z ∈ y) ∈ y
proof:
:=
  (@Classical.epsilon_spec _ fun z : ZFSet.{u} => z ∈ y) <|
    by_contradiction fun n => h <| by rwa [← (eq_empty y).2 fun z zx => n ⟨z, zx⟩]

name: choice_isFunc
statement: theorem choice_isFunc (h : ∅ ∉ x) : IsFunc x (⋃₀ x) (choice x)
proof:
:=
  (@map_isFunc _ (Classical.allZFSetDefinable _) _ _).2 fun y yx =>
    mem_sUnion.2 ⟨y, yx, choice_mem_aux x h y yx⟩

name: choice_mem
statement:
theorem choice_mem (h : ∅ ∉ x) (y : ZFSet.{u}) (yx : y ∈ x) :
    (choice x ′ y : Class.{u}) ∈ (y : Class.{u})
proof:
:= by
  delta choice
  rw [@map_fval _ (Classical.allZFSetDefinable _) x y yx, Class.coe_mem, Class.coe_apply]
  exact choice_mem_aux x h y yx

name: coe_equiv_aux
statement:
private lemma coe_equiv_aux {s : Set ZFSet.{u}} (hs : Small.{u} s) :
    (mk <| PSet.mk (Shrink s) fun x ↦ ((equivShrink s).symm x).1.out) = s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ← mk_out x, mk_mem_iff, mk_out]
  refine ⟨?_, fun xs ↦ ⟨equivShrink s (Subtype.mk x xs), ?_⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, h2⟩
    rw [← ZFSet.eq, ZFSet.mk_out] at h2
    simp [h2]
  · simp [PSet.Equiv.refl]

name: isOrdinal_notMem_univ
statement: theorem isOrdinal_notMem_univ : IsOrdinal ∉ Class.univ.{u}
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx, -⟩
  suffices IsOrdinal x by
    apply Class.mem_irrefl x
    rwa [Class.coe_mem, hx]
  refine ⟨fun y hy z hz ↦ ?_, fun hyz hzw hwx ↦ ?_⟩ <;> rw [← Class.coe_apply, hx] at *
  exacts [hy.mem hz, hwx.mem_trans hyz hzw]

name: rank_congr
statement:
theorem rank_congr : ∀ {x y : PSet}, Equiv x y → rank x = rank y
  | ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨αβ, βα⟩ => by
    apply congr_arg sSup
    ext
    constructor <;> simp only [Set.mem_range, forall_exists_index] <;> intro a h
    · obtain ⟨b, h'⟩
proof:
:= αβ a
      exists b
      rw [← h, rank_congr h']
    · obtain ⟨b, h'⟩ := βα a
      exists b
      rw [← h, rank_congr h']

name: rank_lt_of_mem
statement:
theorem rank_lt_of_mem : ∀ {x y : PSet}, y ∈ x → rank y < rank x
  | ⟨_, _⟩, _, ⟨_, h⟩ => by
    rw [rank_congr h, ← succ_le_iff]
    apply Ordinal.le_iSup

name: rank_le_iff
statement:
theorem rank_le_iff {o : Ordinal} : ∀ {x : PSet}, rank x ≤ o ↔ ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ x → rank y < o
  | ⟨_, A⟩ => by
    refine ⟨fun h _ h' => (rank_lt_of_mem h').trans_le h, fun h ↦ Ordinal.iSup_le fun a ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [succ_le_iff]
    exact h (Mem.mk A a)

name: lt_rank_iff
statement: theorem lt_rank_iff {o : Ordinal} {x : PSet} : o < rank x ↔ ∃ y ∈ x, o ≤ rank y

name: rank_mono
statement: @[gcongr] theorem rank_mono (h : x ⊆ y) : rank x ≤ rank y
proof:
:=
  rank_le_iff.2 fun _ h₁ => rank_lt_of_mem (mem_of_subset h h₁)

name: rank_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rank_empty : rank ∅ = 0

name: rank_insert
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rank_insert (x y : PSet) : rank (insert x y) = max (succ (rank x)) (rank y)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simp_rw [rank_le_iff, mem_insert_iff]
    rintro _ (h | h)
    · simp [rank_congr h]
    · simp [rank_lt_of_mem h]
  · apply max_le
    · exact (rank_lt_of_mem (mem_insert x y)).succ_le
    · exact rank_mono (subset_iff.2 fun z => mem_insert_of_mem x)

name: rank_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rank_singleton (x : PSet) : rank {x} = succ (rank x)

name: rank_pair
statement: theorem rank_pair (x y : PSet) : rank {x, y} = max (succ (rank x)) (succ (rank y))

name: rank_powerset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rank_powerset (x : PSet) : rank (powerset x) = succ (rank x)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simp_rw [rank_le_iff, mem_powerset, lt_succ_iff]
    intro
    exact rank_mono
  · rw [succ_le_iff]
    apply rank_lt_of_mem
    simp

name: rank_sUnion_le
statement: theorem rank_sUnion_le (x : PSet) : rank (⋃₀ x) ≤ rank x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [rank_le_iff, mem_sUnion]
  intro _ ⟨_, _, _⟩
  trans <;> apply rank_lt_of_mem <;> assumption

name: le_succ_rank_sUnion
statement: theorem le_succ_rank_sUnion (x : PSet) : rank x ≤ succ (rank (⋃₀ x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rank_powerset]
  apply rank_mono
  rw [subset_iff]
  intro z _
  rw [mem_powerset, subset_iff]
  intro _ _
  rw [mem_sUnion]
  exists z

name: rank_eq_wfRank
statement: theorem rank_eq_wfRank : lift.{u + 1, u} (rank x) = IsWellFounded.rank (α := PSet) (· ∈ ·) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using mem_wf.induction with | _ x ih
  rw [IsWellFounded.rank_eq]
  simp_rw [← fun y : { y // y ∈ x } => ih y y.2]
  apply (le_of_forall_lt _).antisymm (Ordinal.iSup_le _) <;> intro h
  · rw [lt_lift_iff]
    rintro ⟨o, h, rfl⟩
    simpa [Ordinal.lt_iSup_iff] using lt_rank_iff.1 h
  · simpa using rank_lt_of_mem h.2

name: rank_mk

name: rank_lt_of_mem
statement: theorem rank_lt_of_mem : y ∈ x → rank y < rank x

name: rank_le_iff
statement: theorem rank_le_iff {o : Ordinal} : rank x ≤ o ↔ ∀ ⦃y⦄, y ∈ x → rank y < o
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ h' => (rank_lt_of_mem h').trans_le h,
    Quotient.inductionOn x fun _ h =>
      PSet.rank_le_iff.2 fun y h' => @h ⟦y⟧ h'⟩

name: lt_rank_iff
statement: theorem lt_rank_iff {o : Ordinal} : o < rank x ↔ ∃ y ∈ x, o ≤ rank y

  · simp_rw [rank_le_iff, mem_union, lt_max_iff]
    intro
    apply Or.imp <;> apply rank_lt_of_mem
  · apply max_le <;> apply rank_mono <;> intro _ h <;> simp [h]

name: rank_range
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rank_range {α : Type*} [Small.{u} α] (f : α → ZFSet.{u}) :
    rank (range f) = ⨆ i, succ (rank (f i))
proof:
:= by
  apply (Ordinal.iSup_le _).antisymm'
  · simpa [rank_le_iff, ← add_one_le_iff] using Ordinal.le_iSup _
  · simp [rank_lt_of_mem]

name: rank_iUnion
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rank_iUnion {α : Type*} [Small.{u} α] (f : α → ZFSet.{u}) :
    rank (⋃ i, f i) = ⨆ i, rank (f i)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simp_rw [rank_le_iff, mem_iUnion]
    intro y ⟨i, hy⟩
    exact (rank_lt_of_mem hy).trans_le (Ordinal.le_iSup _ _)
  · exact Ordinal.iSup_le fun i => rank_mono (subset_iUnion f i)

name: rank_eq_wfRank
statement: theorem rank_eq_wfRank : lift.{u + 1, u} (rank x) = IsWellFounded.rank (α := ZFSet) (· ∈ ·) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using inductionOn with | _ x ih
  rw [IsWellFounded.rank_eq]
  simp_rw [← fun y : { y // y ∈ x } => ih y y.2]
  apply (le_of_forall_lt _).antisymm (Ordinal.iSup_le _) <;> intro h
  · rw [lt_lift_iff]
    rintro ⟨o, h, rfl⟩
    simpa [Ordinal.lt_iSup_iff] using lt_rank_iff.1 h
  · simpa using rank_lt_of_mem h.2

name: sUnion_lem
statement:
theorem sUnion_lem {α β : Type u} (A : α → PSet) (B : β → PSet) (αβ : ∀ a, ∃ b, Equiv (A a) (B b)) :
    ∀ a, ∃ b, Equiv ((sUnion ⟨α, A⟩).Func a) ((sUnion ⟨β, B⟩).Func b)
  | ⟨a, c⟩ => by
    let ⟨b, hb⟩
proof:
:= αβ a
    induction ea : A a with | _ γ Γ
    induction eb : B b with | _ δ Δ
    rw [ea, eb] at hb
    obtain ⟨γδ, δγ⟩ := hb
    let c : (A a).Type := c
    let ⟨d, hd⟩ := γδ (by rwa [ea] at c)
    use ⟨b, Eq.ndrec d (Eq.symm eb)⟩
    change PSet.Equiv ((A a).Func c) ((B b).Func (Eq.ndrec d eb.symm))
    match A a, B b, ea, eb, c, d, hd with
    | _, _, rfl, rfl, _, _, hd => exact hd

name: mem_sInter
statement: theorem mem_sInter {x y : ZFSet} (h : x.Nonempty) : y ∈ ⋂₀ x ↔ ∀ z ∈ x, y ∈ z
proof:
:= by
  unfold sInter
  simp only [and_iff_right_iff_imp, mem_sep]
  intro mem
  apply mem_sUnion.mpr
  replace ⟨s, h⟩ := h
  exact ⟨_, h, mem _ h⟩

  · exact (notMem_empty z hz).elim
  · exact (mem_sInter hx).1 hy z hz

statement: theorem regularity (x : ZFSet.{u}) (h : x ≠ ∅) : ∃ y ∈ x, x ∩ y = ∅
proof:
:=
  by_contradiction fun ne =>
    h <| (eq_empty x).2 fun y =>
      @inductionOn (fun z => z ∉ x) y fun z IH zx =>
        ne ⟨z, zx, (eq_empty _).2 fun w wxz =>

name: mem_image
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_image {f : ZFSet.{u} → ZFSet.{u}} [Definable₁ f] {x y : ZFSet.{u}} :
    y ∈ image f x ↔ ∃ z ∈ x, f z = y
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ x y fun ⟨_, A⟩ _ =>
    ⟨fun ⟨a, ya⟩ => ⟨⟦A a⟧, Mem.mk A a, ((Quotient.sound ya).trans Definable₁.mk_out).symm⟩,
      fun ⟨_, hz, e⟩ => e ▸ image.mk _ _ hz⟩

name: coe_image
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma coe_image (f : ZFSet → ZFSet) [Definable₁ f] (x : ZFSet) :
    (image f x : Set ZFSet) = f '' x

name: mem_range
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_range {f : α → ZFSet.{u}} {x : ZFSet.{u}} : x ∈ range f ↔ ∃ i, f i = x
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn x fun y => by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
      exact ⟨(equivShrink α).symm z, Quotient.eq_mk_iff_out.2 hz.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
      use equivShrink α z
      simpa [hz] using PSet.Equiv.symm (Quotient.mk_out y)

name: coe_range
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma coe_range (f : α → ZFSet.{u}) : (range f : Set ZFSet) = .range f

name: mem_range_self
statement: theorem mem_range_self {f : α → ZFSet.{u}} (a : α) : f a ∈ range f

name: mem_iUnion
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_iUnion {f : α → ZFSet.{u}} {x : ZFSet.{u}} : x ∈ ⋃ i, f i ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ f i

name: coe_iUnion
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma coe_iUnion (f : α → ZFSet.{u}) : ↑(⋃ i, f i) = ⋃ i, (f i : Set ZFSet)

name: subset_iUnion
statement: theorem subset_iUnion (f : α → ZFSet.{u}) (i : α) : f i ⊆ ⋃ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  simpa using ⟨i, hx⟩

name: coe_pair
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma coe_pair (x y : ZFSet.{u}) : (pair x y : Set ZFSet) = {{x}, {x, y}}

name: mem_pairSep
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_pairSep {p} {x y z : ZFSet.{u}} :
    z ∈ pairSep p x y ↔ ∃ a ∈ x, ∃ b ∈ y, z = pair a b ∧ p a b
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_sep.trans ⟨And.right, fun e => ⟨?_, e⟩⟩
  grind [mem_pair, mem_powerset, mem_singleton, mem_union, pair, subset_def]

name: pair_injective
statement: theorem pair_injective : Function.Injective2 pair
proof:
:= by
  intro x x' y y' H
  simp_rw [ZFSet.ext_iff, pair, mem_pair] at H
  obtain rfl : x = x' := And.left <| by simpa [or_and_left] using (H {x}).1 (Or.inl rfl)
  have he : y = x → y = y' := by
    rintro rfl
    simpa [eq_comm] using H {y, y'}
  have hx := H {x, y}
  simp_rw [pair_eq_singleton_iff, true_and, or_true, true_iff] at hx
  refine ⟨rfl, hx.elim he fun hy ↦ Or.elim ?_ he id⟩
  simpa using ZFSet.ext_iff.1 hy y

name: pair_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pair_inj {x y x' y' : ZFSet} : pair x y = pair x' y' ↔ x = x' ∧ y = y'

name: mem_prod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_prod {x y z : ZFSet.{u}} : z ∈ prod x y ↔ ∃ a ∈ x, ∃ b ∈ y, z = pair a b

name: pair_mem_prod
statement: theorem pair_mem_prod {x y a b : ZFSet.{u}} : pair a b ∈ prod x y ↔ a ∈ x ∧ b ∈ y

name: mem_funs
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_funs {x y f : ZFSet.{u}} : f ∈ funs x y ↔ IsFunc x y f

name: mem_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_map {f : ZFSet → ZFSet} [Definable₁ f] {x y : ZFSet} :
    y ∈ map f x ↔ ∃ z ∈ x, pair z (f z) = y

name: map_unique
statement:
theorem map_unique {f : ZFSet.{u} → ZFSet.{u}} [Definable₁ f] {x z : ZFSet.{u}}
    (zx : z ∈ x) : ∃! w, pair z w ∈ map f x
proof:
:=
  ⟨f z, image.mk _ _ zx, fun y yx => by
    let ⟨w, _, we⟩ := mem_image.1 yx
    let ⟨wz, fy⟩ := pair_injective we
    rw [← fy, wz]⟩

name: map_isFunc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_isFunc {f : ZFSet → ZFSet} [Definable₁ f] {x y : ZFSet} :
    IsFunc x y (map f x) ↔ ∀ z ∈ x, f z ∈ y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨ss, h⟩ z zx =>
    let ⟨_, t1, t2⟩ := h z zx
    (t2 (f z) (image.mk _ _ zx)).symm ▸ (pair_mem_prod.1 (ss t1)).right,
    fun h =>
    ⟨fun _ yx =>
      let ⟨z, zx, ze⟩ := mem_image.1 yx
      ze ▸ pair_mem_prod.2 ⟨zx, h z zx⟩,
      fun _ => map_unique⟩⟩

name: hereditarily_iff
statement: theorem hereditarily_iff : Hereditarily p x ↔ p x ∧ ∀ y ∈ x, Hereditarily p y

name: Hereditarily.self
statement: theorem Hereditarily.self (h : x.Hereditarily p) : p x

name: Hereditarily.mem
statement: theorem Hereditarily.mem (h : x.Hereditarily p) (hy : y ∈ x) : y.Hereditarily p

name: Hereditarily.empty
statement: theorem Hereditarily.empty : Hereditarily p x → p ∅
proof:
:= by
  apply @ZFSet.inductionOn _ x
  intro y IH h
  rcases ZFSet.eq_empty_or_nonempty y with (rfl | ⟨a, ha⟩)
  · exact h.self
  · exact IH a ha (h.mem ha)

name: mem_vonNeumann'
statement: lemma mem_vonNeumann' : x ∈ V_ o ↔ ∃ a < o, x ⊆ V_ a

name: isTransitive_vonNeumann
statement: theorem isTransitive_vonNeumann (o : Ordinal) : IsTransitive (V_ o)

name: vonNeumann_mem_of_lt
statement: @[gcongr] theorem vonNeumann_mem_of_lt (h : a < b) : V_ a ∈ V_ b

name: vonNeumann_subset_of_le
statement: @[gcongr] theorem vonNeumann_subset_of_le (h : a ≤ b) : V_ a ⊆ V_ b
proof:
:=
  h.eq_or_lt.rec (by simp_all) fun h ↦ isTransitive_vonNeumann _ _ <| vonNeumann_mem_of_lt h

name: subset_vonNeumann
statement: theorem subset_vonNeumann {o : Ordinal} {x : ZFSet} : x ⊆ V_ o ↔ rank x ≤ o
proof:
:= by
  rw [rank_le_iff]
  constructor <;> intro hx y hy
  · apply (rank_lt_of_mem (hx hy)).trans_le
    simp_rw [rank_le_iff, mem_vonNeumann']
    rintro z ⟨a, ha, hz⟩
    exact (subset_vonNeumann.1 hz).trans_lt ha
  · rw [mem_vonNeumann']
    have := hx hy
    exact ⟨_, this, subset_vonNeumann.2 le_rfl⟩

name: subset_vonNeumann_self
statement: theorem subset_vonNeumann_self (x : ZFSet) : x ⊆ V_ (rank x)

name: mem_vonNeumann
statement: theorem mem_vonNeumann : x ∈ V_ o ↔ rank x < o
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mem_vonNeumann', subset_vonNeumann]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨a, h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ h₂.trans_lt h₁, by aesop⟩

name: mem_vonNeumann_succ
statement: theorem mem_vonNeumann_succ (x : ZFSet) : x ∈ V_ (succ (rank x))

name: exists_mem_vonNeumann
statement: theorem exists_mem_vonNeumann (x : ZFSet) : ∃ o, x ∈ V_ o

name: rank_vonNeumann
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rank_vonNeumann (o : Ordinal) : rank (V_ o) = o
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (by rw [← subset_vonNeumann]) <| le_of_forall_lt fun a ha ↦
    rank_vonNeumann a ▸ rank_lt_of_mem (vonNeumann_mem_of_lt ha)

name: vonNeumann_mem_vonNeumann_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vonNeumann_mem_vonNeumann_iff : V_ a ∈ V_ b ↔ a < b

name: vonNeumann_subset_vonNeumann_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vonNeumann_subset_vonNeumann_iff : V_ a ⊆ V_ b ↔ a ≤ b

name: mem_vonNeumann_of_subset
statement: theorem mem_vonNeumann_of_subset {y : ZFSet} (h : x ⊆ y) (hy : y ∈ V_ o) : x ∈ V_ o
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_vonNeumann] at *
  exact (rank_mono h).trans_lt hy

name: vonNeumann_strictMono
statement: theorem vonNeumann_strictMono : StrictMono vonNeumann

name: vonNeumann_injective
statement: theorem vonNeumann_injective : Function.Injective vonNeumann

name: vonNeumann_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vonNeumann_inj : V_ a = V_ b ↔ a = b

name: vonNeumann_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vonNeumann_zero : V_ 0 = ∅

name: vonNeumann_add_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vonNeumann_add_one (o : Ordinal) : V_ (o + 1) = powerset (V_ o)
proof:
:=
  ext fun z ↦ by rw [mem_vonNeumann, mem_powerset, subset_vonNeumann, lt_add_one_iff]

name: vonNeumann_succ
statement:
@[deprecated vonNeumann_add_one (since := "2026-05-25")]
theorem vonNeumann_succ (o : Ordinal) : V_ (succ o) = powerset (V_ o)

name: vonNeumann_of_isSuccPrelimit
statement:
theorem vonNeumann_of_isSuccPrelimit (h : IsSuccPrelimit o) :
    V_ o = ⋃ a : Set.Iio o, vonNeumann a
proof:
:=
  ext fun z ↦ by simpa [mem_vonNeumann] using h.lt_iff_exists_lt

name: iUnion_vonNeumann
statement: theorem iUnion_vonNeumann : ⋃ o, (V_ o : Class) = Class.univ
proof:
:=
  Class.eq_univ_of_forall fun x ↦ Set.mem_iUnion.2 <| exists_mem_vonNeumann x

name: _root_.Ordinal.toZFSet_subset_vonNeumann
statement: theorem _root_.Ordinal.toZFSet_subset_vonNeumann (o : Ordinal) : o.toZFSet ⊆ V_ o

name: _root_.Ordinal.card_le_card_vonNeumann
statement: lemma _root_.Ordinal.card_le_card_vonNeumann (o : Ordinal) : o.card ≤ card (V_ o)

name: card_vonNeumann
statement: theorem card_vonNeumann (o : Ordinal.{u}) : card (V_ o) = preBeth o
proof:
:= by
  induction o using Ordinal.limitRecOn with
  | zero => simp
  | add_one o ih => simp [ih]
  | limit o ho ih =>
    simp_rw [preBeth_limit ho.isSuccPrelimit, ← fun i : Set.Iio o => ih i i.2,
      vonNeumann_of_isSuccPrelimit ho.isSuccPrelimit]
    apply iSup_card_le_card_iUnion.antisymm'
    rw [← lift_le.{u + 1}]
    apply lift_card_iUnion_le_sum_card.trans
    refine (sum_eq_lift_iSup_of_lift_mk_le_lift_iSup ?_ ?_).le
    · rw [mk_Iio_ordinal, ← lift_aleph0.{u + 1, u}, lift_le, Ordinal.aleph0_le_card]
      exact Ordinal.omega0_le_of_isSuccLimit ho
    · rw [mk_Iio_ordinal, lift_lift, lift_le]
      by_contra! h
      refine (⨆ i : Set.Iio o, (V_ ↑i).card).card_ord.not_lt <|
        (Ordinal.card_le_card_vonNeumann _).trans_lt <| (cantor _).trans_le ?_
      rw [← card_powerset, ← vonNeumann_add_one]
      refine le_ciSup bddAbove_of_small (⟨_, ho.succ_lt ?_⟩ : Set.Iio o)
      exact (ord_card_le _).trans_lt' (ord_strictMono h)

name: isTransitive_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isTransitive_empty : IsTransitive ∅

name: IsTransitive.subset_of_mem
statement: theorem IsTransitive.subset_of_mem (h : x.IsTransitive) : y ∈ x → y ⊆ x

name: isTransitive_iff_mem_trans
statement: theorem isTransitive_iff_mem_trans : z.IsTransitive ↔ ∀ {x y : ZFSet}, x ∈ y → y ∈ z → x ∈ z
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ _ hx hy => h.subset_of_mem hy hx, fun H _ hx _ hy => H hy hx⟩

name: IsTransitive.inter
statement:
protected theorem IsTransitive.inter (hx : x.IsTransitive) (hy : y.IsTransitive) :
    (x ∩ y).IsTransitive
proof:
:= fun z hz w hw => by
  rw [mem_inter] at hz ⊢
  exact ⟨hx.mem_trans hw hz.1, hy.mem_trans hw hz.2⟩

name: IsTransitive.sUnion
statement:
protected theorem IsTransitive.sUnion (h : x.IsTransitive) :
    (⋃₀ x : ZFSet).IsTransitive
proof:
:= fun y hy z hz => by
  rcases mem_sUnion.1 hy with ⟨w, hw, hw'⟩
  exact mem_sUnion_of_mem hz (h.mem_trans hw' hw)

name: IsTransitive.sUnion'
statement:
theorem IsTransitive.sUnion' (H : ∀ y ∈ x, IsTransitive y) :
    (⋃₀ x : ZFSet).IsTransitive
proof:
:= fun y hy z hz => by
  rcases mem_sUnion.1 hy with ⟨w, hw, hw'⟩
  exact mem_sUnion_of_mem ((H w hw).mem_trans hz hw') hw

name: IsTransitive.iUnion
statement:
protected theorem IsTransitive.iUnion {α : Type*} [Small.{u} α] {f : α → ZFSet.{u}}
    (hf : ∀ i, (f i).IsTransitive) : (⋃ i, f i).IsTransitive

name: IsTransitive.union
statement:
protected theorem IsTransitive.union (hx : x.IsTransitive) (hy : y.IsTransitive) :
    (x ∪ y).IsTransitive
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sUnion_pair]
  apply IsTransitive.sUnion'
  intro
  rw [mem_pair]
  rintro (rfl | rfl)
  assumption'

name: IsTransitive.powerset
statement: protected theorem IsTransitive.powerset (h : x.IsTransitive) : (powerset x).IsTransitive
proof:
:=
  fun y hy z hz => by
  rw [mem_powerset] at hy ⊢
  exact h.subset_of_mem (hy hz)

name: isTransitive_iff_sUnion_subset
statement: theorem isTransitive_iff_sUnion_subset : x.IsTransitive ↔ (⋃₀ x : ZFSet) ⊆ x
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;>
  intro h y hy
  · obtain ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ := mem_sUnion.1 hy
    exact h.mem_trans hz' hz
  · exact fun z hz ↦ h <| mem_sUnion_of_mem hz hy

name: isTransitive_iff_subset_powerset
statement: theorem isTransitive_iff_subset_powerset : x.IsTransitive ↔ x ⊆ powerset x
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ hy => mem_powerset.2 <| h.subset_of_mem hy, fun H _ hy _ hz => mem_powerset.1 (H hy) hz⟩

name: subset_of_mem
statement: theorem subset_of_mem (h : x.IsOrdinal) : y ∈ x → y ⊆ x

name: mem_trans
statement: theorem mem_trans (h : z.IsOrdinal) : x ∈ y → y ∈ z → x ∈ z

name: isTrans
statement: protected theorem isTrans (h : x.IsOrdinal) : IsTrans _ (Subrel (· ∈ ·) (· ∈ x))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ c hab hbc => h.mem_trans' hab hbc c.2⟩

name: _root_.ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_isTrans
statement:
theorem _root_.ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_isTrans :
    x.IsOrdinal ↔ x.IsTransitive ∧ IsTrans _ (Subrel (· ∈ ·) (· ∈ x)) where
  mp h
proof:
:= ⟨h.isTransitive, h.isTrans⟩
  mpr := by
    rintro ⟨h₁, ⟨h₂⟩⟩
    refine ⟨h₁, fun {y z w} hyz hzw hwx ↦ ?_⟩
    have hzx := h₁.mem_trans hzw hwx
    exact h₂ ⟨y, h₁.mem_trans hyz hzx⟩ ⟨z, hzx⟩ ⟨w, hwx⟩ hyz hzw

name: mem
statement: protected theorem mem (hx : x.IsOrdinal) (hy : y ∈ x) : y.IsOrdinal
proof:
:=
  have := hx.isTrans
  let f : _ ↪r Subrel (· ∈ ·) (· ∈ x) := Subrel.inclusionEmbedding (· ∈ ·) (hx.subset_of_mem hy)
  isOrdinal_iff_isTrans.2 ⟨fun _ hz _ ha ↦ hx.mem_trans' ha hz hy, f.isTrans⟩

name: _root_.ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_forall_mem_isTransitive
statement:
theorem _root_.ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_forall_mem_isTransitive :
    x.IsOrdinal ↔ x.IsTransitive ∧ ∀ y ∈ x, y.IsTransitive where
  mp h
proof:
:= ⟨h.isTransitive, fun _ hy ↦ (h.mem hy).isTransitive⟩
  mpr := fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ ⟨h₁, fun hyz hzw hwx ↦ (h₂ _ hwx).mem_trans hyz hzw⟩

name: _root_.ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_forall_mem_isOrdinal
statement:
theorem _root_.ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_forall_mem_isOrdinal :
    x.IsOrdinal ↔ x.IsTransitive ∧ ∀ y ∈ x, y.IsOrdinal where
  mp h
proof:
:= ⟨h.isTransitive, fun _ ↦ h.mem⟩
  mpr := fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ ↦ isOrdinal_iff_forall_mem_isTransitive.2
    ⟨h₁, fun y hy ↦ (h₂ y hy).isTransitive⟩

name: subset_iff_eq_or_mem
statement: theorem subset_iff_eq_or_mem (hx : x.IsOrdinal) (hy : y.IsOrdinal) : x ⊆ y ↔ x = y ∨ x ∈ y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · revert hx hy
    refine Sym2.GameAdd.recursion mem_wf ?_ x y
    intro x y IH hx hy hxy
    by_cases hyx : y ⊆ x
    · exact Or.inl (subset_antisymm hxy hyx)
    · obtain ⟨m, hm, hm'⟩ := mem_wf.has_min (y \ x) (Set.sdiff_nonempty.2 hyx)
      have hmy : m ∈ y := by simp only [Set.mem_sdiff, SetLike.mem_coe] at hm; exact hm.1
      have hmx : m ⊆ x := by
        intro z hzm
        by_contra hzx
        exact hm' _ ⟨hy.mem_trans hzm hmy, hzx⟩ hzm
      obtain rfl | H := IH m x (Sym2.GameAdd.fst_snd hmy) (hy.mem hmy) hx hmx
      · exact Or.inr hmy
      · cases Set.notMem_of_mem_sdiff hm H
  · rintro (rfl | h)
    · rfl
    · exact hy.subset_of_mem h

name: mem_of_subset_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_of_subset_of_mem (h : x.IsOrdinal) (hz : z.IsOrdinal) (hx : x ⊆ y) (hy : y ∈ z) :
    x ∈ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx := h.eq_or_mem_of_subset (hz.mem hy) hx
  · exact hy
  · exact hz.mem_trans hx hy

name: notMem_iff_subset
statement: theorem notMem_iff_subset (hx : x.IsOrdinal) (hy : y.IsOrdinal) : x ∉ y ↔ y ⊆ x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun hxy hyx ↦ mem_irrefl _ (hxy hyx)⟩
  revert hx hy
  refine Sym2.GameAdd.recursion mem_wf (fun x y IH hx hy hyx z hzy ↦ ?_) x y
  by_contra hzx
  exact hyx (mem_of_subset_of_mem hx hy (IH z x (Sym2.GameAdd.fst_snd hzy) (hy.mem hzy) hx hzx) hzy)

name: not_subset_iff_mem
statement: theorem not_subset_iff_mem (hx : x.IsOrdinal) (hy : y.IsOrdinal) : ¬ x ⊆ y ↔ y ∈ x

name: mem_or_subset
statement: theorem mem_or_subset (hx : x.IsOrdinal) (hy : y.IsOrdinal) : x ∈ y ∨ y ⊆ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_left, notMem_iff_subset hx hy]
  exact id

name: subset_total
statement: theorem subset_total (hx : x.IsOrdinal) (hy : y.IsOrdinal) : x ⊆ y ∨ y ⊆ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h := mem_or_subset hx hy
  · exact Or.inl (hy.subset_of_mem h)
  · exact Or.inr h

name: mem_trichotomous
statement: theorem mem_trichotomous (hx : x.IsOrdinal) (hy : y.IsOrdinal) : x ∈ y ∨ x = y ∨ y ∈ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, ← subset_iff_eq_or_mem hy hx]
  exact mem_or_subset hx hy

name: trichotomous
statement: protected theorem trichotomous (h : x.IsOrdinal) : Std.Trichotomous (Subrel (· ∈ ·) (· ∈ x))
proof:
:=
  Std.trichotomous_of_rel_or_eq_or_rel_swap <| by
    intro ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩
    simpa using mem_trichotomous (h.mem ha) (h.mem hb)

name: _root_.ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_trichotomous
statement:
theorem _root_.ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_trichotomous :
    x.IsOrdinal ↔ x.IsTransitive ∧ Std.Trichotomous (Subrel (· ∈ ·) (· ∈ x)) where
  mp h
proof:
:= ⟨h.isTransitive, h.trichotomous⟩
  mpr := by
    rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    rw [isOrdinal_iff_isTrans]
    refine ⟨h₁, ⟨@fun y z w hyz hzw ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    obtain hyw | rfl | hwy := trichotomous_of (Subrel (· ∈ ·) (· ∈ x)) y w
    · exact hyw
    · cases asymm hyz hzw
    · cases mem_wf.asymmetric₃ _ _ _ hyz hzw hwy

name: isWellOrder
statement:
protected theorem isWellOrder (h : x.IsOrdinal) : IsWellOrder _ (Subrel (· ∈ ·) (· ∈ x)) where
  wf

name: _root_.ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_isWellOrder
statement:
theorem _root_.ZFSet.isOrdinal_iff_isWellOrder : x.IsOrdinal ↔
    x.IsTransitive ∧ IsWellOrder _ (Subrel (· ∈ ·) (· ∈ x))
proof:
:= by
  use fun h ↦ ⟨h.isTransitive, h.isWellOrder⟩
  rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  refine isOrdinal_iff_isTrans.2 ⟨h₁, ?_⟩
  infer_instance

name: rank_lt_iff_mem
statement:
theorem rank_lt_iff_mem {x y : ZFSet} (hx : IsOrdinal x) (hy : IsOrdinal y) :
    rank x < rank y ↔ x ∈ y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, rank_lt_of_mem⟩
  rw [← hy.not_subset_iff_mem hx]
  exact fun h' ↦ (rank_mono h').not_gt h

name: rank_le_iff_subset
statement:
theorem rank_le_iff_subset {x y : ZFSet} (hx : IsOrdinal x) (hy : IsOrdinal y) :
    rank x ≤ rank y ↔ x ⊆ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← notMem_iff_subset hy hx, ← rank_lt_iff_mem hy hx, not_lt]

name: rank_inj
statement:
theorem rank_inj {x y : ZFSet} (hx : IsOrdinal x) (hy : IsOrdinal y) :
    rank x = rank y ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_antisymm_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, rank_le_iff_subset hx hy, rank_le_iff_subset hy hx]

name: isOrdinal_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isOrdinal_empty : IsOrdinal ∅

name: isOrdinal_succ
statement: theorem isOrdinal_succ {x : ZFSet} (h : IsOrdinal x) : IsOrdinal (insert x x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun y hy ↦ ?_, @fun y z w hyz hzw hw ↦ ?_⟩
  · obtain rfl | hy := mem_insert_iff.1 hy
    on_goal 2 => apply (h.subset_of_mem hy).trans
    all_goals simp_all [subset_def]
  · obtain rfl | hw := mem_insert_iff.1 hw
    exacts [h.mem_trans hyz hzw, h.mem_trans' hyz hzw hw]

name: mem_toPSet_iff
statement: theorem mem_toPSet_iff {o : Ordinal} {x : PSet} : x ∈ o.toPSet ↔ ∃ a < o, x.Equiv a.toPSet

:= by
  rw [toPSet, PSet.mem_def]
  simpa using ((@ToType.mk o).exists_congr_left (p := fun y ↦ x.Equiv y.1.toPSet)).symm

theorem rank_toPSet (o : Ordinal) : o.toPSet.rank = o
proof:
:= by
  rw [toPSet, PSet.rank]
  conv_rhs => rw [← _root_.iSup_succ o]
  convert! ToType.mk.symm.iSup_comp (g := fun x ↦ Order.succ x.1.toPSet.rank)
  rw [rank_toPSet]

proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.ind
  rw [toZFSet, mk_eq, ZFSet.mk_mem_iff, mem_toPSet_iff]
  congr!
  rw [toZFSet, eq, PSet.Equiv.comm]

  intro a b h x hx
  obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := mem_toZFSet_iff.1 hx
  exact toZFSet_mem_toZFSet_of_lt (hc.trans_le h)

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, toZFSet_mem_toZFSet_of_lt⟩
  contrapose!
  exact fun h ↦ notMem_of_subset (toZFSet_monotone h)

  contrapose!
  exact fun h ↦ not_subset_of_mem (toZFSet_mem_toZFSet_of_lt h)

name: isOrdinal_toZFSet
statement: theorem isOrdinal_toZFSet (o : Ordinal) : IsOrdinal o.toZFSet
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x hx y hy ↦ ?_, fun {z y x} hz hy hx ↦ ?_⟩
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_toZFSet_iff.1 hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_toZFSet_iff.1 hy
  · exact toZFSet_mem_toZFSet_iff.2 (hb.trans ha)
  · obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := mem_toZFSet_iff.1 hz
    exact toZFSet_mem_toZFSet_iff.2 (hc.trans hb)

proof:

  · rw [← h.toZFSet_rank_eq]
    exact Set.mem_range_self _
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact isOrdinal_toZFSet a

/
equivalent to some element of the second family and vice-versa. -/
def Equiv : PSet → PSet → Prop
  | ⟨_, A⟩, ⟨_, B⟩ => (∀ a, ∃ b, Equiv (A a) (B b)) ∧ (∀ b, ∃ a, Equiv (A a) (B b))

    ∀ {x y : PSet},
      Equiv x y ↔ (∀ i, ∃ j, Equiv (x.Func i) (y.Func j)) ∧ ∀ j, ∃ i, Equiv (x.Func i) (y.Func j)
  | ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩ => Iff.rfl

name: Equiv.refl
statement:
@[refl]
protected theorem Equiv.refl : ∀ x, Equiv x x
  | ⟨_, _⟩ => ⟨fun a => ⟨a, Equiv.refl _⟩, fun a => ⟨a, Equiv.refl _⟩⟩

protected theorem Equiv.rfl {x} : Equiv x x

name: Equiv.rfl
statement: protected theorem Equiv.rfl {x} : Equiv x x

name: Equiv.euc
statement:
protected theorem Equiv.euc : ∀ {x y z}, Equiv x y → Equiv z y → Equiv x z
  | ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨αβ, βα⟩, ⟨γβ, βγ⟩ =>
    ⟨ fun a =>
        let ⟨b, ab⟩
proof:
:= αβ a
        let ⟨c, bc⟩ := βγ b
        ⟨c, Equiv.euc ab bc⟩,
      fun c =>
        let ⟨b, cb⟩ := γβ c
        let ⟨a, ba⟩ := βα b
        ⟨a, Equiv.euc ba cb⟩ ⟩

name: Equiv.symm
statement:
@[symm]
protected theorem Equiv.symm {x y} : Equiv x y → Equiv y x

name: Equiv.comm
statement: protected theorem Equiv.comm {x y} : Equiv x y ↔ Equiv y x

name: Equiv.trans
statement:
@[trans]
protected theorem Equiv.trans {x y z} (h1 : Equiv x y) (h2 : Equiv y z) : Equiv x z

name: equiv_of_isEmpty
statement: protected theorem equiv_of_isEmpty (x y : PSet) [IsEmpty x.Type] [IsEmpty y.Type] : Equiv x y

name: Equiv.ext
statement:
theorem Equiv.ext : ∀ x y : PSet, Equiv x y ↔ x ⊆ y ∧ y ⊆ x
  | ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩ =>
    ⟨fun ⟨αβ, βα⟩ =>
      ⟨αβ, fun b =>
        let ⟨a, h⟩
proof:
:= βα b
        ⟨a, Equiv.symm h⟩⟩,
      fun ⟨αβ, βα⟩ =>
      ⟨αβ, fun b =>
        let ⟨a, h⟩ := βα b
        ⟨a, Equiv.symm h⟩⟩⟩

name: Subset.congr_left
statement:
theorem Subset.congr_left : ∀ {x y z : PSet}, Equiv x y → (x ⊆ z ↔ y ⊆ z)
  | ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨αβ, βα⟩ =>
    ⟨fun αγ b =>
      let ⟨a, ba⟩
proof:
:= βα b
      let ⟨c, ac⟩ := αγ a
      ⟨c, (Equiv.symm ba).trans ac⟩,
      fun βγ a =>
      let ⟨b, ab⟩ := αβ a
      let ⟨c, bc⟩ := βγ b
      ⟨c, Equiv.trans ab bc⟩⟩

name: Subset.congr_right
statement:
theorem Subset.congr_right : ∀ {x y z : PSet}, Equiv x y → (z ⊆ x ↔ z ⊆ y)
  | ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨αβ, βα⟩ =>
    ⟨fun γα c =>
      let ⟨a, ca⟩
proof:
:= γα c
      let ⟨b, ab⟩ := αβ a
      ⟨b, ca.trans ab⟩,
      fun γβ c =>
      let ⟨b, cb⟩ := γβ c
      let ⟨a, ab⟩ := βα b
      ⟨a, cb.trans (Equiv.symm ab)⟩⟩

name: Mem.ext
statement:
theorem Mem.ext : ∀ {x y : PSet.{u}}, (∀ w : PSet.{u}, w ∈ x ↔ w ∈ y) → Equiv x y
  | ⟨_, A⟩, ⟨_, B⟩, h =>
    ⟨fun a => (h (A a)).1 (Mem.mk A a), fun b =>
      let ⟨a, ha⟩

name: Mem.congr_right
statement:
theorem Mem.congr_right : ∀ {x y : PSet.{u}}, Equiv x y → ∀ {w : PSet.{u}}, w ∈ x ↔ w ∈ y
  | ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨αβ, βα⟩, _ =>
    ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ =>
      let ⟨b, hb⟩
proof:
:= αβ a
      ⟨b, ha.trans hb⟩,
      fun ⟨b, hb⟩ =>
      let ⟨a, ha⟩ := βα b
      ⟨a, hb.euc ha⟩⟩

name: equiv_iff_mem
statement: theorem equiv_iff_mem {x y : PSet.{u}} : Equiv x y ↔ ∀ {w : PSet.{u}}, w ∈ x ↔ w ∈ y
proof:
:=
  ⟨Mem.congr_right,
    match x, y with
    | ⟨_, A⟩, ⟨_, B⟩ => fun h =>
      ⟨fun a => h.1 (Mem.mk A a), fun b =>
        let ⟨a, h⟩ := h.2 (Mem.mk B b)
        ⟨a, h.symm⟩⟩⟩

name: Mem.congr_left
statement:
theorem Mem.congr_left : ∀ {x y : PSet.{u}}, Equiv x y → ∀ {w : PSet.{u}}, x ∈ w ↔ y ∈ w
  | _, _, h, ⟨_, _⟩ => ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => ⟨a, h.symm.trans ha⟩, fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => ⟨a, h.trans ha⟩⟩

name: mem_wf_aux
statement:
private theorem mem_wf_aux : ∀ {x y : PSet.{u}}, Equiv x y → Acc (· ∈ ·) y
  | ⟨α, A⟩, ⟨β, B⟩, H =>
    ⟨_, by
      rintro ⟨γ, C⟩ ⟨b, hc⟩
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩
proof:
:= H.exists_right b
      have H := ha.trans hc.symm
      rw [mk_func] at H
      exact mem_wf_aux H⟩

name: mem_insert_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_insert_iff : ∀ {x y z : PSet.{u}}, x ∈ insert y z ↔ Equiv x y ∨ x ∈ z
  | x, y, ⟨α, A⟩ =>
    show (x ∈ PSet.mk (Option α) fun o => Option.rec y A o) ↔ Equiv x y ∨ x ∈ PSet.mk α A from
      ⟨fun m =>
        match m with
        | ⟨some a, ha⟩ => Or.inr ⟨a, ha⟩
        | ⟨none, h⟩ => Or.inl h,
        fun m =>
        match m with
        | Or.inr ⟨a, ha⟩ => ⟨some a, ha⟩
        | Or.inl h => ⟨none, h⟩⟩

statement:

theorem mem_singleton {x y : PSet} : x ∈ ({y} : PSet) ↔ Equiv x y
proof:
:=
  mem_insert_iff.trans
    ⟨fun o => Or.rec id (fun n => absurd n (notMem_empty _)) o, Or.inl⟩

name: mem_sep
statement:
theorem mem_sep {p : PSet → Prop} (H : ∀ x y, Equiv x y → p x → p y) :
    ∀ {x y : PSet}, y ∈ PSet.sep p x ↔ y ∈ x ∧ p y
  | ⟨_, _⟩, _ =>
    ⟨fun ⟨⟨a, pa⟩, h⟩ => ⟨⟨a, h⟩, H _ _ h.symm pa⟩, fun ⟨⟨a, h⟩, pa⟩ =>
      ⟨⟨a, H _ _ h pa⟩, h⟩⟩

/
def powerset (x : PSet) : PSet
proof:
:=
  ⟨Set x.Type, fun p => ⟨p, fun y => x.Func y.1⟩⟩

name: mem_powerset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_powerset : ∀ {x y : PSet}, y ∈ powerset x ↔ y ⊆ x
  | ⟨_, A⟩, ⟨_, B⟩ =>
    ⟨fun ⟨_, e⟩ => (Subset.congr_left e).2 fun ⟨a, _⟩ => ⟨a, Equiv.refl (A a)⟩, fun βα =>
      ⟨{ a | ∃ b, Equiv (B b) (A a) }, fun b =>
        let ⟨a, ba⟩
proof:
:= βα b
        ⟨⟨a, b, ba⟩, ba⟩,
        fun ⟨_, b, ba⟩ => ⟨b, ba⟩⟩⟩

name: mem_sUnion
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_sUnion : ∀ {x y : PSet.{u}}, y ∈ ⋃₀ x ↔ ∃ z ∈ x, y ∈ z
  | ⟨α, A⟩, y =>
    ⟨fun ⟨⟨a, c⟩, (e : Equiv y ((A a).Func c))⟩ =>
      have : Func (A a) c ∈ mk (A a).Type (A a).Func
proof:
:= Mem.mk (A a).Func c
      ⟨_, Mem.mk _ _, (Mem.congr_left e).2 (by rwa [eta] at this)⟩,
      fun ⟨⟨β, B⟩, ⟨a, (e : Equiv (mk β B) (A a))⟩, ⟨b, yb⟩⟩ => by
      rw [← eta (A a)] at e
      exact
        let ⟨βt, _⟩ := e
        let ⟨c, bc⟩ := βt b
        ⟨⟨a, c⟩, yb.trans bc⟩⟩

name: mem_image
statement:
theorem mem_image {f : PSet.{u} → PSet.{u}} (H : ∀ x y, Equiv x y → Equiv (f x) (f y)) :
    ∀ {x y : PSet.{u}}, y ∈ image f x ↔ ∃ z ∈ x, Equiv y (f z)
  | ⟨_, A⟩, _ =>
    ⟨fun ⟨a, ya⟩ => ⟨A a, Mem.mk A a, ya⟩, fun ⟨_, ⟨a, za⟩, yz⟩ => ⟨a, yz.trans <| H _ _ za⟩⟩

/
protected def Lift : PSet.{u} → PSet.{max u v}
  | ⟨α, A⟩ => ⟨ULift.{v, u} α, fun ⟨x⟩ => PSet.Lift (A x)⟩


set_option linter.checkUnivs false in
/
def embed : PSet.{max (u + 1) v}
proof:
:=
  ⟨ULift.{v, u + 1} PSet, fun ⟨x⟩ => PSet.Lift.{u, max (u + 1) v} x⟩

name: lift_mem_embed
statement: theorem lift_mem_embed : ∀ x : PSet.{u}, PSet.Lift.{u, max (u + 1) v} x ∈ embed.{u, v}

statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_empty : card ∅ = 0

name: card_insert_le
statement: theorem card_insert_le : card (insert x y) ≤ card y + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_le.{u + 1}]
  simpa [← cardinalMk_coe_sort] using! mk_insert_le

name: card_insert
statement: theorem card_insert (h : x ∉ y) : card (insert x y) = card y + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_inj.{u, u + 1}]
  simpa [← cardinalMk_coe_sort] using! mk_insert (SetLike.mem_coe.not.2 h)

name: card_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_singleton : card {x} = 1

name: card_pair_of_ne
statement: theorem card_pair_of_ne (h : x ≠ y) : card {x, y} = 2
proof:
:= by
  convert! card_insert (notMem_singleton.2 h)
  rw [card_singleton, one_add_one_eq_two]

name: card_union_le
statement: theorem card_union_le : card (x ∪ y) ≤ card x + card y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_le.{u + 1}]
  simpa [← cardinalMk_coe_sort] using! mk_union_le (x : Set ZFSet) y

name: card_powerset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_powerset (x : ZFSet.{u}) : card (powerset x) = 2 ^ card x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_inj.{u, u + 1}]
  simpa [← cardinalMk_coe_sort] using mk_congr (powersetEquiv x)

name: card_image_le
statement:
theorem card_image_le {f : ZFSet → ZFSet} [Definable₁ f] :
    card (image f x) ≤ card x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [cardinalMk_coe_sort, ← coe_image, -mem_image] using mk_image_le (f := f) (s := x)

name: lift_card_range_le
statement:
theorem lift_card_range_le {α} [Small.{v, u} α] {f : α → ZFSet.{v}} :
    lift.{u} (card (range f)) ≤ lift.{v} #α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_le.{max u (v + 1)}, lift_lift.{v}, lift_umax.{u, v + 1}]
  simpa [cardinalMk_coe_sort, ← coe_range, -mem_range] using mk_range_le_lift (f := f)

name: iSup_card_le_card_iUnion
statement:
theorem iSup_card_le_card_iUnion {α} [Small.{v, u} α] {f : α → ZFSet.{v}} :
    ⨆ i, card (f i) ≤ card (⋃ i, f i)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [cardinalMk_coe_sort, ← coe_iUnion, ← lift_iSup bddAbove_of_small, -mem_iUnion] using
    iSup_mk_le_mk_iUnion (f := SetLike.coe ∘ f)

name: lift_card_iUnion_le_sum_card
statement:
theorem lift_card_iUnion_le_sum_card {α} [Small.{v, u} α] {f : α → ZFSet.{v}} :
    lift (card (⋃ i, f i)) ≤ sum fun i => card (f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_le.{max u (v + 1)}, lift_umax.{max u v, v + 1}]
  simpa [cardinalMk_coe_sort, ← coe_iUnion, -mem_iUnion] using
    mk_iUnion_le_sum_mk_lift (f := SetLike.coe ∘ f)

name: not_injective_limitation_set
statement: theorem not_injective_limitation_set : ¬ InjOn g (Iio (ord <| succ #α))
proof:
:= by
  intro h_inj
  have h := lift_mk_le_lift_mk_of_injective <| injOn_iff_injective.1 h_inj
  have mk_initialSeg_subtype :
      #(Iio (ord <| succ #α)) = lift.{u + 1} (succ #α) := by
    simpa only [coe_ofPred, card_typein, card_ord] using mk_Iio_ordinal (ord <| succ #α)
  rw [mk_initialSeg_subtype, lift_lift, lift_le] at h
  exact not_le_of_gt (Order.lt_succ #α) h

name: lfpApprox_mono_right
statement: theorem lfpApprox_mono_right : Monotone (lfpApprox f x)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  rw [lfpApprox, lfpApprox]
  apply sup_le_sup_left (iSup₂_mono' _)
  grind

name: lfpApprox_zero
statement: theorem lfpApprox_zero : lfpApprox f x 0 = x

name: le_lfpApprox
statement: theorem le_lfpApprox {a : Ordinal} : x ≤ lfpApprox f x a

name: apply_lfpApprox_le_lfpApprox_of_lt
statement:
theorem apply_lfpApprox_le_lfpApprox_of_lt {a b : Ordinal} (h : a < b) :
    f (lfpApprox f x a) ≤ lfpApprox f x b
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [lfpApprox]
  exact le_sup_of_le_right <| le_iSup₂_of_le a h le_rfl

name: lfpApprox_add_one
statement:
theorem lfpApprox_add_one (hx : x ≤ f x) (a : Ordinal) :
    lfpApprox f x (a + 1) = f (lfpApprox f x a)
proof:
:= by
  apply (apply_lfpApprox_le_lfpApprox_of_lt f (lt_add_one a)).antisymm'
  rw [lfpApprox]
  apply sup_le <| hx.trans (f.mono (le_lfpApprox f))
  simpa using fun i h ↦ f.monotone.comp (lfpApprox_mono_right f) h

name: lfpApprox_of_isSuccLimit
statement:
theorem lfpApprox_of_isSuccLimit {a : Ordinal} (ha : Order.IsSuccLimit a) :
    lfpApprox f x a = ⨆ b : Set.Iio a, lfpApprox f x b
proof:
:= by
  apply (iSup_le fun b => lfpApprox_mono_right f b.2.le).antisymm'
  rw [lfpApprox, sup_le_iff, iSup_le_iff]
  constructor
  · refine le_iSup_of_le ⟨0, ha.bot_lt⟩ (by simp [lfpApprox_zero])
  · exact fun b => iSup_mono' fun hab => ⟨⟨b + 1, ha.succ_lt hab⟩, (by
    simpa using apply_lfpApprox_le_lfpApprox_of_lt f (lt_add_one b))⟩

name: lfpApprox_mono_left
statement: theorem lfpApprox_mono_left : Monotone (lfpApprox : (α →o α) → _)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h x a
  induction a using WellFoundedLT.induction with | ind i IH
  rw [lfpApprox, lfpApprox]
  exact sup_le_sup_left (iSup₂_mono fun j hj ↦ (f.mono (IH j hj)).trans (h _)) _

name: lfpApprox_mono_mid
statement: theorem lfpApprox_mono_mid : Monotone (lfpApprox f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x₁ x₂ h a
  induction a using WellFoundedLT.induction with | ind i IH
  rw [lfpApprox, lfpApprox]
  exact sup_le_sup h <| iSup₂_mono fun j hj ↦ f.mono (IH j hj)

name: lfpApprox_eq_of_mem_fixedPoints
statement:
theorem lfpApprox_eq_of_mem_fixedPoints (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : lfpApprox f x a ∈ fixedPoints f) : lfpApprox f x b = lfpApprox f x a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_fixedPoints_iff] at hf
  induction b using WellFoundedLT.induction with | ind b IH
  apply (lfpApprox_mono_right f hab).antisymm'
  rw [lfpApprox]
  apply sup_le (le_lfpApprox ..)
  rw [iSup₂_le_iff]
  intro i hi
  by_cases! hi' : i < a
  · exact apply_lfpApprox_le_lfpApprox_of_lt f hi'
  · simp [IH i hi hi', hf]

name: lfpApprox_eq_all_of_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem lfpApprox_eq_all_of_fixedPoint (hx : x ≤ f x) :
    (∀ o, lfpApprox f x o = x) ↔ f x = x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h o ↦ ?_⟩
  · specialize h 1
    rwa [← zero_add 1, lfpApprox_add_one f hx, lfpApprox_zero] at h
  · have : lfpApprox f x 0 ∈ fixedPoints f := by
      rwa [mem_fixedPoints_iff, lfpApprox_zero]
    simpa [lfpApprox_zero] using
      lfpApprox_eq_of_mem_fixedPoints f zero_le this

name: lfpApprox_mem_fixedPoints_of_eq
statement:
lemma lfpApprox_mem_fixedPoints_of_eq (hx : x ≤ f x) (hab : a < b) (hac : a ≤ c)
    (hf : lfpApprox f x a = lfpApprox f x b) : lfpApprox f x c ∈ fixedPoints f
proof:
:= by
  have H : lfpApprox f x a ∈ fixedPoints f := by
    rw [mem_fixedPoints_iff, ← lfpApprox_add_one f hx]
    exact (lfpApprox_mono_right f).eq_of_ge_of_le
      hf (lt_add_one a).le (add_one_le_of_lt hab)
  rwa [lfpApprox_eq_of_mem_fixedPoints f hac H]

name: lfpApprox_eq_of_fixedPoint_or_zero
statement:
theorem lfpApprox_eq_of_fixedPoint_or_zero (hx : x ≤ f x) (o : Ordinal) :
    lfpApprox f x o = x ↔ f x = x ∨ o = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · rcases eq_or_ne o 0 with (rfl | ho)
    · exact Or.inr rfl
    · have hpos : (0 : Ordinal) < o :=
        zero_lt_one.trans_le (one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr ho)
      have hmem : lfpApprox f x 0 ∈ fixedPoints f :=
        lfpApprox_mem_fixedPoints_of_eq f hx hpos (le_refl _)
          ((lfpApprox_zero f).trans h.symm)
      have hfx : f x = x :=
        (mem_fixedPoints_iff.mp (by simpa [lfpApprox_zero] using hmem))
      exact Or.inl hfx
  · rcases h with (hf | rfl)
    · exact (lfpApprox_eq_all_of_fixedPoint f hx).mpr hf o
    · exact lfpApprox_zero f

name: exists_lfpApprox_eq_lfpApprox
statement:
theorem exists_lfpApprox_eq_lfpApprox : ∃ a < ord <| succ #α, ∃ b < ord <| succ #α,
    a ≠ b ∧ lfpApprox f x a = lfpApprox f x b
proof:
:= by
  have h_ninj := not_injective_limitation_set <| lfpApprox f x
  rw [Set.injOn_iff_injective, Function.not_injective_iff] at h_ninj
  let ⟨a, b, h_fab, h_nab⟩ := h_ninj
  use a.val; apply And.intro a.prop
  use b.val; apply And.intro b.prop
  apply And.intro
  · intro h_eq; rw [Subtype.coe_inj] at h_eq; exact h_nab h_eq
  · exact h_fab

name: lfpApprox_ord_mem_fixedPoint
statement:
theorem lfpApprox_ord_mem_fixedPoint (hx : x ≤ f x) :
    lfpApprox f x (ord <| succ #α) ∈ fixedPoints f
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hne, hf⟩ := exists_lfpApprox_eq_lfpApprox f x
  cases le_total a b with
  | inl hab => exact lfpApprox_mem_fixedPoints_of_eq f hx (hne.lt_of_le hab) ha.le hf
  | inr hba => exact lfpApprox_mem_fixedPoints_of_eq f hx (hne.symm.lt_of_le hba) hb.le hf.symm

name: lfpApprox_le_of_mem_fixedPoints
statement:
theorem lfpApprox_le_of_mem_fixedPoints {a : α}
    (ha : a ∈ fixedPoints f) (hxa : x ≤ a) (i : Ordinal) : lfpApprox f x i ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  induction i using WellFoundedLT.induction with | ind i IH
  rw [lfpApprox]
  apply sup_le hxa
  rw [iSup₂_le_iff, ← ha.eq]
  exact fun y hy ↦ f.mono (IH y hy)

name: lfpApprox_ord_eq_lfp
statement: theorem lfpApprox_ord_eq_lfp : lfpApprox f ⊥ (ord <| succ #α) = f.lfp
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h_lfp : ∃ y : fixedPoints f, f.lfp = y := by use ⊥; exact rfl
    let ⟨y, h_y⟩ := h_lfp; rw [h_y]
    exact lfpApprox_le_of_mem_fixedPoints f y.2 bot_le (ord <| succ #α)
  · have h_fix : ∃ y : fixedPoints f, lfpApprox f ⊥ (ord <| succ #α) = y := by
      simpa only [Subtype.exists, mem_fixedPoints, exists_prop, exists_eq_right'] using
        lfpApprox_ord_mem_fixedPoint f bot_le
    let ⟨x, h_x⟩ := h_fix; rw [h_x]
    exact lfp_le_fixed f x.prop

name: lfp_mem_range_lfpApprox
statement: theorem lfp_mem_range_lfpApprox : f.lfp ∈ Set.range (lfpApprox f ⊥)
proof:
:= by

  exact lfpApprox_ord_eq_lfp f

name: iSup_lfpApprox_eq_of_mem_fixedPoints
statement:
lemma iSup_lfpApprox_eq_of_mem_fixedPoints (hf : lfpApprox f x a ∈ fixedPoints f) :
    ⨆ i : Ordinal, lfpApprox f x i = lfpApprox f x a
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_iSup (lfpApprox f x) a).antisymm'
  refine ciSup_le fun i => ?_
  by_cases h : i ≤ a
  · exact lfpApprox_mono_right f h
  · exact (lfpApprox_eq_of_mem_fixedPoints f (le_of_not_ge h) hf).le

name: nextFixed_eq_iSup_lfpApprox
statement:
theorem nextFixed_eq_iSup_lfpApprox (hx : x ≤ f x) :
    (f.nextFixed x hx).val = ⨆ a : Ordinal, lfpApprox f x a
proof:
:= by
  let o := (succ #α).ord
  have hfix : lfpApprox f x o ∈ fixedPoints f :=
    lfpApprox_ord_mem_fixedPoint f hx
  rw [iSup_lfpApprox_eq_of_mem_fixedPoints f hfix]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact f.nextFixed_le hx (y := ⟨lfpApprox f x o, hfix⟩) (le_lfpApprox f)
  · exact lfpApprox_le_of_mem_fixedPoints f (f.nextFixed x hx).2 (f.le_nextFixed hx) o

theorem succ_lt_iSup_of_ne_iSup {ι} {f : ι → Ordinal.{u}} [Small.{u} ι]

proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hoa
  exact hao.not_ge (Ordinal.iSup_le fun i ↦ le_of_lt_succ <|

name: iSup_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem iSup_eq_zero_iff {ι} {f : ι → Ordinal.{u}} [Small.{u} ι] :

proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun h i => ?_, fun h =>
      le_antisymm (Ordinal.iSup_le fun i => nonpos_iff_eq_zero.2 (h i)) zero_le⟩
  rw [← nonpos_iff_eq_zero, ← h]
  exact Ordinal.le_iSup f i

name: iSup_eq_of_range_eq
iSup_sum
statement:
theorem iSup_sum {α β} (f : α ⊕ β → Ordinal.{u}) [Small.{u} α] [Small.{u} β] :
    iSup f = max (⨆ a, f (Sum.inl a)) (⨆ b, f (Sum.inr b))
proof:
:= by
  apply (Ordinal.iSup_le _).antisymm (max_le _ _)
  · rintro (i | i)
    · exact le_max_of_le_left (Ordinal.le_iSup (fun x ↦ f (Sum.inl x)) i)
    · exact le_max_of_le_right (Ordinal.le_iSup (fun x ↦ f (Sum.inr x)) i)
  all_goals
    apply csSup_le_csSup' bddAbove_of_small
    rintro i ⟨a, rfl⟩
    apply mem_range_self

name: unbounded_range_of_le_iSup

proof:
:=

    h.not_gt <| lt_of_le_of_lt
      (Ordinal.iSup_le fun y => ((typein_lt_typein r).2 <| hx _ <| mem_range_self y).le)
      (typein_lt_type r x)

name: sSup_ord

    · exact isNormal_ord.map_sSup hn hs
    · rw [csSup_of_not_bddAbove hs, csSup_of_not_bddAbove (bddAbove_ord_image_iff.not.2 hs)]

  constructor <;> rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
  · exact ⟨a, fun b hb ↦ (lt_add_one _).le.trans (ha (mem_image_of_mem _ hb))⟩
  · use a + 1

statement: theorem sSup_le_sSup_add_one (s : Set Ordinal) : sSup s ≤ sSup ((· + 1) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : BddAbove s
  · have hs' := bddAbove_add_one_image_iff.2 hs
    rw [csSup_le_iff' hs]
    exact fun x hx ↦ (lt_add_one _).le.trans (le_csSup hs' (mem_image_of_mem _ hx))
  · rw [csSup_of_not_bddAbove hs, csSup_of_not_bddAbove (s := _ '' _)]
    rwa [bddAbove_add_one_image_iff]

    {f : β → Ordinal.{u}} (hf : StrictMono f) : ⨆ i, f i + 1 = ⨆ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  apply (iSup_le_iSup_add_one f).antisymm'
  by_cases hf' : BddAbove (range f)
  · rw [ciSup_le_iff' (bddAbove_range_add_one_iff.2 hf')]
    intro i
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_gt i
    apply (le_ciSup hf' j).trans'
    rw [add_one_le_iff]
    exact hf hj
  · rw [ciSup_of_not_bddAbove hf', ciSup_of_not_bddAbove]
    rwa [← bddAbove_range_add_one_iff] at hf'

  · rw [← h]

  by_contra! hle
  have heq := (succ_iSup_eq_lsub_iff f).2 ⟨i, le_antisymm (Ordinal.le_iSup _ _) hle⟩
  have :=
    hf _
      (by
        rw [← heq]

  rw [heq] at this
  exact this.false

name: bsup_eq_blsub_or_succ_bsup_eq_blsub
statement:

theorem bsup_eq_blsub_or_succ_bsup_eq_blsub {o : Ordinal.{u}} (f : ∀ a < o, Ordinal.{max u v}) :

proof:

name: bsup_succ_le_blsub
statement:
@[deprecated "blsub is deprecated" (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem bsup_succ_le_blsub {o : Ordinal.{u}} (f : ∀ a < o, Ordinal.{max u v}) :
    succ (bsup.{_, v} o f) ≤ blsub.{_, v} o f ↔ ∃ i hi, f i hi = bsup.{_, v} o f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra! hf
    exact
      ne_of_lt (succ_le_iff.1 h)
        (le_antisymm (bsup_le_blsub f) (blsub_le (lt_bsup_of_ne_bsup.1 hf)))
  rintro ⟨_, _, hf⟩
  rw [succ_le_iff, ← hf]
  exact lt_blsub _ _ _

name: bsup_succ_eq_blsub
statement:
@[deprecated "blsub is deprecated" (since := "2026-03-23")]

name: bsup_eq_blsub_iff_succ
statement:
@[deprecated "blsub is deprecated" (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem bsup_eq_blsub_iff_succ {o : Ordinal.{u}} (f : ∀ a < o, Ordinal.{max u v}) :
    bsup.{_, v} o f = blsub.{_, v} o f ↔ ∀ a < blsub.{_, v} o f, succ a < blsub.{_, v} o f
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_eq_bsup, ← lsub_eq_blsub]
  apply iSup_eq_lsub_iff

name: bsup_eq_blsub_iff_lt_bsup
statement:
@[deprecated "blsub is deprecated" (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem bsup_eq_blsub_iff_lt_bsup {o : Ordinal.{u}} (f : ∀ a < o, Ordinal.{max u v}) :
    bsup.{_, v} o f = blsub.{_, v} o f ↔ ∀ i hi, f i hi < bsup.{_, v} o f
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h i => by
    rw [h]
    apply lt_blsub, fun h => le_antisymm (bsup_le_blsub f) (blsub_le h)⟩

name: bsup_eq_blsub_of_lt_succ_limit
statement:
@[deprecated "blsub is deprecated" (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem bsup_eq_blsub_of_lt_succ_limit {o : Ordinal.{u}} (ho : IsSuccLimit o)
    {f : ∀ a < o, Ordinal.{max u v}} (hf : ∀ a ha, f a ha < f (succ a) (ho.succ_lt ha)) :
    bsup.{_, v} o f = blsub.{_, v} o f
proof:
:= by
  rw [bsup_eq_blsub_iff_lt_bsup]
  exact fun i hi => (hf i hi).trans_le (le_bsup f _ _)

name: blsub_succ_of_mono
proof:
:=
  bsup_succ_of_mono fun {_ _} hi hj h => succ_le_succ (hf hi hj h)

name: blsub_type
statement:
@[deprecated "blsub is deprecated" (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem blsub_type {α : Type u} (r : α → α → Prop) [IsWellOrder α r]
    (f : ∀ a < type r, Ordinal.{max u v}) :
    blsub.{_, v} (type r) f = lsub.{_, v} fun a => f (typein r a) (typein_lt_type _ _)
proof:
:=
  eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun o => by
    rw [blsub_le_iff, lsub_le_iff]

proof:
:=
  bsup_le_of_brange_subset.{u, v, w} fun a ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩ := h ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    simp_rw [← hc'] at hb'
    exact ⟨c, hc, hb'⟩

name: blsub_eq_of_brange_eq
statement:
@[deprecated "blsub is deprecated" (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem blsub_eq_of_brange_eq {o o'} {f : ∀ a < o, Ordinal} {g : ∀ a < o', Ordinal}
    (h : { o | ∃ i hi, f i hi = o } = { o | ∃ i hi, g i hi = o }) :
    blsub.{u, max v w} o f = blsub.{v, max u w} o' g
proof:
:=
  (blsub_le_of_brange_subset.{u, v, w} h.le).antisymm (blsub_le_of_brange_subset.{v, u, w} h.ge)

name: bsup_comp
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm <;> refine bsup_le fun i hi => ?_
  · apply le_bsup
  · rw [← hg, lt_blsub_iff] at hi
    rcases hi with ⟨j, hj, hj'⟩
    exact (hf _ _ hj').trans (le_bsup _ _ _)

name: blsub_comp
IsNormal.bsup_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsNormal.bsup.{u, u, v} H (fun x _ => x) h.ne_bot, bsup_id_limit fun _ ↦ h.succ_lt]

name: IsNormal.blsub_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsNormal.bsup_eq.{u, v} H h, bsup_eq_blsub_of_lt_succ_limit h]
  exact fun a _ => H.strictMono (lt_succ a)

name: isNormal_iff_lt_succ_and_bsup_eq
statement:
@[deprecated isNormal_iff (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem isNormal_iff_lt_succ_and_bsup_eq {f : Ordinal.{u} → Ordinal.{max u v}} :
    IsNormal f ↔ (∀ a, f a < f (succ a)) ∧
      ∀ o, IsSuccLimit o → (bsup.{_, v} o fun x _ => f x) = f o
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨fun a ↦ h.strictMono (lt_succ a), @IsNormal.bsup_eq f h⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ =>
    .of_succ_lt h₁ fun ho ↦ by
      rw [← h₂ _ ho]
      simpa [IsLUB, upperBounds, lowerBounds, IsLeast, bsup_le_iff] using le_bsup _⟩

name: isNormal_iff_lt_succ_and_blsub_eq
statement:
@[deprecated isNormal_iff (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem isNormal_iff_lt_succ_and_blsub_eq {f : Ordinal.{u} → Ordinal.{max u v}} :
    IsNormal f ↔ (∀ a, f a < f (succ a)) ∧
      ∀ o, IsSuccLimit o → (blsub.{_, v} o fun x _ => f x) = f o
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNormal_iff_lt_succ_and_bsup_eq.{u, v}, and_congr_right_iff]
  intro h
  constructor <;> intro H o ho <;> have := H o ho <;>
    rwa [← bsup_eq_blsub_of_lt_succ_limit ho fun a _ => h a] at *

name: not_surjective_of_ordinal
statement:
theorem not_surjective_of_ordinal {α : Type*} [Small.{u} α] (f : α → Ordinal.{u}) :
    ¬ Surjective f
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h (⨆ i, succ (f i))
  apply ha.not_lt
  rw [Ordinal.lt_iSup_iff]
  exact ⟨a, Order.lt_succ _⟩

name: Ordinal.not_bddAbove_compl_of_small
statement:
theorem Ordinal.not_bddAbove_compl_of_small (s : Set Ordinal.{u}) [hs : Small.{u} s] :
    ¬BddAbove sᶜ
proof:
:= by
  rw [bddAbove_iff_small]
  intro h
  have := small_union s sᶜ
  rw [union_compl_self, small_univ_iff] at this
  exact not_small_ordinal this

name: mul_sSup
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mul_sSup (o : Ordinal) (s : Set Ordinal) : o * sSup s = sSup ((o * ·) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with (rfl | hs)
  · simp
  rcases eq_zero_or_pos o with (rfl | ho)
  · simp [hs.image_const]
  by_cases bdd : BddAbove s
  · exact (isNormal_mul_right ho).map_sSup hs bdd
  · rw [csSup_of_not_bddAbove bdd, csSup_empty, csSup_of_not_bddAbove]
    · simp
    exact fun ⟨u, hu⟩ ↦ bdd ⟨u, fun x hx ↦ (x.le_mul_right ho).trans (hu ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)⟩

lemma mul_iSup (o : Ordinal) {ι} (f : ι → Ordinal) : o * ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ i, o * f i
proof:

proof:

    a ∈ range (veblenWith f o) ↔ ∀ b < o, veblenWith f b a = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [veblenWith_of_ne_zero f h, mem_range_derivFamily (fun _ ↦ isNormal_veblenWith hf _)]
  exact Subtype.forall

    veblenWith f o₁ (veblenWith f o₂ a) = veblenWith f o₂ a
proof:
:= by

proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | h := h.eq_or_lt
  · assumption
  · rw [← h', veblenWith_veblenWith_of_lt hf h]

name: veblenWith_mem_range
statement: theorem veblenWith_mem_range : veblenWith f o a ∈ range f
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | h := eq_zero_or_pos o
  · simp
  · rw [← veblenWith_veblenWith_of_lt hf h]
    simp

name: veblenWith_add_one
statement: theorem veblenWith_add_one (o : Ordinal) : veblenWith f (o + 1) = deriv (veblenWith f o)
proof:
:= by
  rw [deriv_eq_enumOrd (isNormal_veblenWith hf o),
    veblenWith_of_ne_zero f (add_pos_of_right zero_lt_one _).ne', derivFamily_eq_enumOrd]
  · apply congr_arg
    ext a
    rw [mem_iInter]
    use fun ha ↦ ha ⟨o, lt_succ o⟩
    rintro (ha : _ = _) ⟨b, hb : b < _⟩
    obtain rfl | hb := lt_succ_iff_eq_or_lt.1 hb
    · rw [Function.mem_fixedPoints_iff, ha]
    · rw [← ha]
      exact veblenWith_veblenWith_of_lt hf hb _
  · exact fun o ↦ isNormal_veblenWith hf o.1

name: veblenWith_left_monotone
statement: theorem veblenWith_left_monotone (a : Ordinal) : Monotone (veblenWith f · a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [monotone_iff_forall_lt]
  intro o₁ o₂ h
  rw [← veblenWith_veblenWith_of_lt hf h]
  exact (veblenWith_right_strictMono hf o₁).monotone (right_le_veblenWith hf o₂ a)

name: veblenWith_pos
statement: theorem veblenWith_pos (hp : 0 < f 0) : 0 < veblenWith f o a
proof:
:= by
  have H (b) : 0 < veblenWith f 0 b := by
    rw [veblenWith_zero]
    exact hp.trans_le (hf.monotone zero_le)
  obtain rfl | h := eq_zero_or_pos o
  · exact H a
  · rw [← veblenWith_veblenWith_of_lt hf h]
    exact H _

name: veblenWith_zero_strictMono
statement: theorem veblenWith_zero_strictMono (hp : 0 < f 0) : StrictMono (veblenWith f · 0)
proof:

  intro o₁ o₂ h
  dsimp only
  rw [← veblenWith_veblenWith_of_lt hf h, veblenWith_lt_veblenWith_iff_right hf]
  exact veblenWith_pos hf hp

name: isNormal_veblenWith_zero
statement: theorem isNormal_veblenWith_zero (hp : 0 < f 0) : IsNormal (veblenWith f · 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isNormal_iff]
  refine ⟨veblenWith_zero_strictMono hf hp, fun o ho a IH ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [veblenWith_of_ne_zero f ho.ne_bot, derivFamily_zero]
  apply nfpFamily_le fun l ↦ ?_
  suffices ∃ b < o, List.foldr _ 0 l ≤ veblenWith f b 0 by
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := this
    exact hb'.trans (IH b hb)
  induction l with
  | nil => use 0; simpa using ho.bot_lt
  | cons a l IH =>
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := IH
    refine ⟨_, ho.succ_lt (max_lt a.2 hb), ((veblenWith_right_strictMono hf _).monotone <|
      hb'.trans <| veblenWith_left_monotone hf _ <|
        (le_max_right a.1 b).trans (le_succ _)).trans ?_⟩
    rw [veblenWith_veblenWith_of_lt hf]
    rw [lt_succ_iff]
    exact le_max_left _ b

name: cmp_veblenWith
statement:
theorem cmp_veblenWith :
    cmp (veblenWith f o₁ a) (veblenWith f o₂ b) =
    match cmp o₁ o₂ with
    | .eq => cmp a b
    | .lt => cmp a (veblenWith f o₂ b)
    | .gt => cmp (veblenWith f o₁ a) b
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | rfl | h := lt_trichotomy o₁ o₂
  on_goal 2 => simp [(veblenWith_right_strictMono hf _).cmp_map_eq]
  all_goals
    conv_lhs => rw [← veblenWith_veblenWith_of_lt hf h]
    simp [h.cmp_eq_lt, h.cmp_eq_gt, (veblenWith_right_strictMono hf _).cmp_map_eq]

name: veblenWith_lt_veblenWith_iff
statement:
theorem veblenWith_lt_veblenWith_iff :
    veblenWith f o₁ a < veblenWith f o₂ b ↔
      o₁ = o₂ ∧ a < b ∨ o₁ < o₂ ∧ a < veblenWith f o₂ b ∨ o₂ < o₁ ∧ veblenWith f o₁ a < b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cmp_eq_lt_iff, cmp_veblenWith hf]
  aesop (add simp lt_asymm)

name: veblenWith_le_veblenWith_iff
statement:
theorem veblenWith_le_veblenWith_iff :
    veblenWith f o₁ a ≤ veblenWith f o₂ b ↔
      o₁ = o₂ ∧ a ≤ b ∨ o₁ < o₂ ∧ a ≤ veblenWith f o₂ b ∨ o₂ < o₁ ∧ veblenWith f o₁ a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_lt, ← cmp_eq_gt_iff, cmp_veblenWith hf]
  aesop (add simp [not_lt_of_ge, lt_asymm])

name: veblenWith_eq_veblenWith_iff
statement:

    veblenWith f o₁ a = veblenWith f o₂ b ↔
      o₁ = o₂ ∧ a = b ∨ o₁ < o₂ ∧ a = veblenWith f o₂ b ∨ o₂ < o₁ ∧ veblenWith f o₁ a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cmp_eq_eq_iff, cmp_veblenWith hf]
  aesop (add simp lt_asymm)

name: card_veblen_le
statement: theorem card_veblen_le (a b : Ordinal) : (veblen a b).card ≤ max (max a.card b.card) ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  induction a using WellFoundedLT.induction generalizing b with
  | ind a ih =>
    obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
    · simpa [Or.comm] using card_opow_le ω b
    rw [veblen_of_ne_zero ha, ← max_right_comm]
    apply card_derivFamily_le (le_max_right _ _) (by simp)
    intro i x
    grw [ih i i.2 x, max_right_comm]
    apply sup_le_sup_right (c := x.card) <| sup_le_sup_right ?_ ℵ₀
    simp [card_le_card i.2.le]

proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (card_veblen_le a b) <| max_le (le_card_veblen_aux a b) ?_
  exact aleph0_le_card.mpr <| omega0_le_veblen_of_left_ne_zero b ha

    (max_le ?_ ?_)
  · exact aleph0_le_card.mpr <| omega0_lt_gamma o |>.le
  · exact card_le_card isNormal_gamma.strictMono.le_apply

name: mem_range_rank_of_le
statement:
theorem mem_range_rank_of_le {o : Ordinal} (ha : Acc r a) (ho : o ≤ ha.rank) :
    ∃ (b : α) (hb : Acc r b), hb.rank = o
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ho := ho.eq_or_lt
  · exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  · revert ho
    refine ha.recOn fun a ha IH ho ↦ ?_
    rw [rank_eq, Ordinal.lt_iSup_iff] at ho
    obtain ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, ho⟩ := ho
    rw [Order.lt_succ_iff] at ho
    obtain rfl | ho := ho.eq_or_lt
    exacts [⟨b, ha b hb, rfl⟩, IH _ hb ho]

name: mem_closure_tfae
statement:
theorem mem_closure_tfae (a : Ordinal.{u}) (s : Set Ordinal) :
    TFAE [a ∈ closure s,
      a ∈ closure (s ∩ Iic a),
      (s ∩ Iic a).Nonempty ∧ sSup (s ∩ Iic a) = a,
      ∃ t, t ⊆ s ∧ t.Nonempty ∧ BddAbove t ∧ sSup t = a,
      ∃ (ι : Type u), Nonempty ι ∧ ∃ f : ι → Ordinal, (∀ i, f i ∈ s) ∧ ⨆ i, f i = a]
proof:
:= by
  tfae_have 1 → 2 := by
    simpa only [mem_closure_iff_nhdsWithin_neBot, inter_comm s, nhdsWithin_inter',
      SuccOrder.nhdsLE_eq_nhds] using! id
  tfae_have 2 → 3
  | h => by
    rcases (s ∩ Iic a).eq_empty_or_nonempty with he | hne
    · simp [he] at h
    · refine ⟨hne, (isLUB_of_mem_closure ?_ h).csSup_eq hne⟩
      exact fun x hx => hx.2
  tfae_have 3 → 4
  | h => ⟨_, inter_subset_left, h.1, bddAbove_Iic.mono inter_subset_right, h.2⟩
  tfae_have 4 → 5 := by
    rintro ⟨t, ht, ht₀, ht₁, rfl⟩
    rw [bddAbove_iff_small] at ht₁
    refine ⟨Shrink t, ?_, Subtype.val ∘ (equivShrink _).symm, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have := ht₀.to_subtype
      exact (equivShrink _).symm.nonempty
    · simpa [← (equivShrink t).forall_congr_left (p := (·.1 ∈ s))]
    · simp [(equivShrink t).symm.iSup_comp, ← sSup_eq_iSup']
  tfae_have 5 → 1 := by
    rintro ⟨ι, hne, f, hfs, rfl⟩
    exact closure_mono (range_subset_iff.2 hfs) <| csSup_mem_closure (range_nonempty f)
      bddAbove_of_small
  tfae_finish

theorem mem_closure_iff_iSup :

name: mem_closure_iff_bsup
statement:
@[deprecated mem_closure_iff_iSup (since := "2026-04-05")]
theorem mem_closure_iff_bsup :
    a ∈ closure s ↔
      ∃ (o : Ordinal) (_ho : o ≠ 0) (f : ∀ a < o, Ordinal),
        (∀ i hi, f i hi ∈ s) ∧ bsup.{u, u} o f = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_closure_iff_iSup]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ι, _, f, hf, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, by simp, bfamilyOfFamily f, fun i hi ↦ hf .., bsup_eq_iSup f⟩
  · rintro ⟨o, ho, f, hf, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, by simpa, familyOfBFamily _ f, fun i ↦ hf .., iSup_eq_bsup f⟩

name: isClosed_iff_iSup
statement:
theorem isClosed_iff_iSup :
    IsClosed s ↔
      ∀ {ι : Type u}, Nonempty ι → ∀ f : ι → Ordinal, (∀ i, f i ∈ s) → ⨆ i, f i ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  use fun hs ι hι f hf => (mem_iff_iSup_of_isClosed hs).2 ⟨ι, hι, f, hf, rfl⟩
  rw [← closure_subset_iff_isClosed]
  intro h x hx
  rcases mem_closure_iff_iSup.1 hx with ⟨ι, hι, f, hf, rfl⟩
  exact h hι f hf

name: isClosed_iff_bsup
statement:
@[deprecated isClosed_iff_iSup (since := "2026-04-05")]
theorem isClosed_iff_bsup :
    IsClosed s ↔
      ∀ {o : Ordinal}, o ≠ 0 → ∀ f : ∀ a < o, Ordinal,
        (∀ i hi, f i hi ∈ s) → bsup.{u, u} o f ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [isClosed_iff_iSup]
  refine ⟨fun H o ho f hf => H (nonempty_toType_iff.2 ho) _ ?_, fun H ι hι f hf => ?_⟩
  · exact fun i => hf _ _
  · rw [← bsup_eq_iSup]
    apply H (type_ne_zero_iff_nonempty.2 hι)
    exact fun i hi => hf _

name: enumOrd_isNormal_iff_isClosed
statement:
@[deprecated isNormal_enum_iff_dirSupClosed (since := "2026-05-25")]
theorem enumOrd_isNormal_iff_isClosed (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) :
    IsNormal (enumOrd s) ↔ IsClosed s
proof:
:= by
  have Hs := enumOrd_strictMono hs
  refine
    ⟨fun h => isClosed_iff_iSup.2 fun {ι} hι f hf => ?_, fun h =>
      isNormal_iff.2 ⟨Hs, fun a ha o H => ?_⟩⟩
  · let g : ι → Ordinal.{u} := fun i => (enumOrdOrderIso s hs).symm ⟨_, hf i⟩
    suffices enumOrd s (⨆ i, g i) = ⨆ i, f i by
      rw [← this]
      exact enumOrd_mem hs _
    rw [h.map_iSup bddAbove_of_small]
    congr
    ext x
    change (enumOrdOrderIso s hs _).val = f x
    rw [OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
  · have := csSup_mem_closure (ha.nonempty_Iio.image (enumOrd s)) bddAbove_of_small
    have := h.closure_eq ▸ closure_mono (t := s) ?_ this
    · apply (Set.image_subset_range ..).trans_eq
      rw [range_enumOrd hs]
    · apply (enumOrd_le_of_forall_lt this _).trans
      · apply csSup_le'
        grind [upperBounds]
      · exact fun b hb ↦ (enumOrd_strictMono hs (lt_add_one b)).trans_le <|
          le_csSup bddAbove_of_small <| Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (ha.add_one_lt hb)

@[simp]
theorem one_opow (a : Ordinal) : (1 : Ordinal) ^ a = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction a using limitRecOn with
  | zero => simp
  | add_one _ IH => simp [IH, mul_one]
  | limit b l IH =>
    refine eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun c => ?_
    rw [opow_le_of_isSuccLimit one_ne_zero l]
    exact ⟨fun H => by simpa only [opow_zero] using H 0 l.bot_lt, fun H b' h => by rwa [IH _ h]⟩

name: opow_pos
statement: theorem opow_pos {a : Ordinal} (b : Ordinal) (a0 : 0 < a) : 0 < a ^ b
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 0 < a ^ (0 : Ordinal) := by simp
  induction b using limitRecOn with
  | zero => exact h0
  | add_one b IH => simpa using mul_pos IH a0
  | limit b l _ => exact (lt_opow_of_isSuccLimit (pos_iff_ne_zero.1 a0) l).2 ⟨0, l.pos, h0⟩

name: isNormal_opow
statement: theorem isNormal_opow {a : Ordinal} (h : 1 < a) : IsNormal (a ^ · : Ordinal → Ordinal)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 < a := zero_lt_one.trans h
  refine IsNormal.of_succ_lt ?_ fun hl ↦ ?_
  · simpa only [succ_eq_add_one, mul_one, opow_add_one] using
      fun b ↦ mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h (opow_pos b ha)
  · simp [IsLUB, IsLeast, upperBounds, lowerBounds, ← opow_le_of_isSuccLimit ha.ne' hl]

proof:
:= by

  · contrapose! +distrib
    rw [le_one_iff]
    rintro ((rfl | rfl) | rfl)
    · exact zero_opow_le b
    · simp
    · simp
  · rwa [← opow_zero a, opow_lt_opow_iff_right ha, pos_iff_ne_zero]

  contrapose! h
  obtain ha | ha := le_or_gt a 1
  · simp_all [le_one_iff]
  · simpa using ((opow_lt_opow_iff_right ha).2 h.2.pos).ne'
