name: isSuccLimit_opow_left
statement:
theorem isSuccLimit_opow_left {a b : Ordinal} (l : IsSuccLimit a) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    IsSuccLimit (a ^ b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases zero_or_succ_or_isSuccLimit b with (e | ⟨b, rfl⟩ | l')
  · exact absurd e hb
  · rw [succ_eq_add_one, opow_add_one]
    exact isSuccLimit_mul_right (opow_pos _ l.bot_lt) l
  · exact isSuccLimit_opow (one_lt_of_isSuccLimit l) l'

name: opow_le_opow_right
statement: theorem opow_le_opow_right {a b c : Ordinal} (h₁ : 0 < a) (h₂ : b ≤ c) : a ^ b ≤ a ^ c
proof:
:= by
  rcases (one_le_iff_pos.2 h₁).eq_or_lt' with h₁ | h₁
  · simp_all
  · exact (opow_le_opow_iff_right h₁).2 h₂

name: opow_le_opow_left
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem opow_le_opow_left {a b : Ordinal} (c : Ordinal) (ab : a ≤ b) : a ^ c ≤ b ^ c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · by_cases c = 0 <;> simp_all
  · induction c using limitRecOn with
    | zero => simp
    | add_one c IH => simpa using mul_le_mul' IH ab
    | limit c l IH =>
      exact (opow_le_of_isSuccLimit ha l).2 fun b' h ↦
        (IH _ h).trans (opow_le_opow_right ((pos_iff_ne_zero.2 ha).trans_le ab) h.le)

name: opow_le_opow
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem opow_le_opow {a b c d : Ordinal} (hac : a ≤ c) (hbd : b ≤ d) (hc : 0 < c) : a ^ b ≤ c ^ d

name: left_le_opow
statement: theorem left_le_opow (a : Ordinal) {b : Ordinal} (b1 : 0 < b) : a ≤ a ^ b
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← opow_one a]
  rcases le_or_gt a 1 with a1 | a1
  · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le a1 with a0 | a1
    · rw [lt_one_iff] at a0
      rw [a0, zero_opow one_ne_zero]
      exact zero_le
    rw [a1, one_opow, one_opow]
  rwa [opow_le_opow_iff_right a1, one_le_iff_pos]

name: left_lt_opow
statement: theorem left_lt_opow {a b : Ordinal} (ha : 1 < a) (hb : 1 < b) : a < a ^ b
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← opow_one a]
  rwa [opow_lt_opow_iff_right ha]

name: right_le_opow
statement: theorem right_le_opow {a : Ordinal} (b : Ordinal) (a1 : 1 < a) : b ≤ a ^ b

name: opow_lt_opow_left_of_succ
statement: theorem opow_lt_opow_left_of_succ {a b c : Ordinal} (ab : a < b) : a ^ succ c < b ^ succ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [succ_eq_add_one, opow_add_one, opow_add_one]
  exact mul_lt_mul_of_le_of_lt_of_nonneg_of_pos (by gcongr) ab zero_le (opow_pos _ ab.bot_lt)

name: opow_add
statement: theorem opow_add (a b c : Ordinal) : a ^ (b + c) = a ^ b * a ^ c
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_zero_or_pos a
  · obtain rfl | hc := eq_zero_or_pos c; · simp
    have : b + c ≠ 0 := (hc.trans_le le_add_self).ne'
    rw [zero_opow hc.ne', zero_opow, mul_zero]
    exact (hc.trans_le le_add_self).ne'
  obtain rfl | ha' := (one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 ha.ne').eq_or_lt; · simp
  induction c using limitRecOn with
  | zero => simp
  | add_one c IH => rw [← add_assoc, opow_add_one, IH, opow_add_one, mul_assoc]
  | limit c l IH =>
    refine eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun d ↦
      (((isNormal_opow ha').comp (isNormal_add_right b)).le_iff_forall_le l).trans ?_
    simpa +contextual [IH] using
      (((isNormal_mul_right <| opow_pos b (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 ha.ne')).comp
        (isNormal_opow ha')).le_iff_forall_le l).symm

name: opow_one_add
statement: theorem opow_one_add (a b : Ordinal) : a ^ (1 + b) = a * a ^ b

name: opow_dvd_opow
statement: theorem opow_dvd_opow (a : Ordinal) {b c : Ordinal} (h : b ≤ c) : a ^ b ∣ a ^ c
proof:
:=
  ⟨a ^ (c - b), by rw [← opow_add, Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le h]⟩

name: opow_dvd_opow_iff
statement: theorem opow_dvd_opow_iff {a b c : Ordinal} (a1 : 1 < a) : a ^ b ∣ a ^ c ↔ b ≤ c
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    le_of_not_gt fun hn =>
      not_le_of_gt ((opow_lt_opow_iff_right a1).2 hn) <|
        le_of_dvd (opow_ne_zero _ <| one_le_iff_ne_zero.1 <| a1.le) h,
    opow_dvd_opow _⟩

name: opow_mul
statement: theorem opow_mul (a b c : Ordinal) : a ^ (b * c) = (a ^ b) ^ c
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hb := eq_zero_or_pos b; · simp
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · have := hb.ne'
    by_cases c = 0 <;> simp_all
  obtain rfl | ha' := (one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 ha).eq_or_lt; · simp
  induction c using limitRecOn with
  | zero => simp
  | add_one c IH => rw [mul_add_one, opow_add, IH, opow_add_one]
  | limit c l IH =>
    refine eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun d ↦
      (((isNormal_opow ha').comp (isNormal_mul_right hb)).le_iff_forall_le l).trans ?_
    simpa +contextual [IH] using (opow_le_of_isSuccLimit (opow_ne_zero _ ha) l).symm

name: opow_mul_add_pos
statement:
theorem opow_mul_add_pos {b v : Ordinal} (hb : b ≠ 0) (u : Ordinal) (hv : v ≠ 0) (w : Ordinal) :
    0 < b ^ u * v + w
proof:
:=
  (opow_pos u <| pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hb).trans_le <|
    (le_mul_left _ <| pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hv).trans le_self_add

name: opow_mul_add_lt_opow_mul
statement:
theorem opow_mul_add_lt_opow_mul {b u w x : Ordinal} {v : Ordinal} (hw : w < b ^ u) (hv : v < x) :
    b ^ u * v + w < b ^ u * x
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_lt_of_le (b := b ^ u * (v + 1))
  · rwa [mul_add_one, add_lt_add_iff_left]
  · grw [add_one_le_of_lt hv]

name: opow_mul_add_lt_opow
statement:
theorem opow_mul_add_lt_opow {b u v w x : Ordinal} (hv : v < b) (hw : w < b ^ u) (hu : u < x) :
    b ^ u * v + w < b ^ x
proof:
:= by
  apply (opow_mul_add_lt_opow_mul hw hv).trans_le
  rw [← opow_add_one]
  exact opow_le_opow_right hv.pos (succ_le_of_lt hu)

name: opow_mul_lt_opow
statement: theorem opow_mul_lt_opow {b u v x : Ordinal} (hv : v < b) (hu : u < x) : b ^ u * v < b ^ x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using opow_mul_add_lt_opow hv (opow_pos _ hv.pos) hu

name: log_of_left_le_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_of_left_le_one {b : Ordinal} (h : b ≤ 1) (x : Ordinal) : log b x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | rfl := le_one_iff.1 h
  · apply (csSup_of_not_bddAbove _).trans csSup_empty
    by_contra! hb
    refine not_bddAbove_Ici 1 (hb.mono fun a ↦ ?_)
    simp +contextual [one_le_iff_ne_zero]
  · simp_rw [log, one_opow, preimage_const]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: log_zero_left
statement: theorem log_zero_left (x : Ordinal) : log 0 x = 0

name: log_one_left
statement: theorem log_one_left (x : Ordinal) : log 1 x = 0

name: log_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_zero_right (b : Ordinal) : log b 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b 0
  · exact log_zero_left 0
  · rw [log]
    convert! csSup_empty
    aesop

name: opow_le_iff_le_log
statement:
theorem opow_le_iff_le_log {b x c : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    b ^ c ≤ x ↔ c ≤ log b x

name: opow_le_iff_le_log'
statement:
theorem opow_le_iff_le_log' {b x c : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    b ^ c ≤ x ↔ c ≤ log b x
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx := eq_or_ne x 0
  · simpa [hc] using hb.ne_bot
  · exact opow_le_iff_le_log hb hx

name: le_log_of_opow_le
statement: theorem le_log_of_opow_le {b x c : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) (h : b ^ c ≤ x) : c ≤ log b x
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx := eq_or_ne x 0
  · rw [nonpos_iff_eq_zero, opow_eq_zero] at h
    exact (zero_lt_one.asymm <| h.1 ▸ hb).elim
  · exact (opow_le_iff_le_log hb hx).1 h

name: opow_le_of_le_log
statement: theorem opow_le_of_le_log {b x c : Ordinal} (hc : c ≠ 0) (h : c ≤ log b x) : b ^ c ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain hb | hb := le_or_gt b 1
  · rw [log_of_left_le_one hb] at h
    exact (h.not_gt (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hc)).elim
  · rwa [opow_le_iff_le_log' hb hc]

name: lt_opow_iff_log_lt
statement: theorem lt_opow_iff_log_lt {b x c : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) (hx : x ≠ 0) : x < b ^ c ↔ log b x < c

name: lt_opow_iff_log_lt'
statement: theorem lt_opow_iff_log_lt' {b x c : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) (hc : c ≠ 0) : x < b ^ c ↔ log b x < c

name: lt_opow_of_log_lt
statement: theorem lt_opow_of_log_lt {b x c : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) : log b x < c → x < b ^ c

name: lt_log_of_lt_opow
statement: theorem lt_log_of_lt_opow {b x c : Ordinal} (hc : c ≠ 0) : x < b ^ c → log b x < c

name: lt_opow_succ_log_self
statement:
theorem lt_opow_succ_log_self {b : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) (x : Ordinal) :
    x < b ^ succ (log b x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx := eq_or_ne x 0
  · simpa using hb.pos
  · rw [lt_opow_iff_log_lt hb hx, lt_succ_iff]

name: opow_log_le_self
statement: theorem opow_log_le_self (b : Ordinal) {x : Ordinal} (hx : x ≠ 0) : b ^ log b x ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain hb | hb := le_or_gt b 1
  · rw [← one_le_iff_ne_zero] at hx
    obtain rfl | rfl := le_one_iff.1 hb <;> simpa
  · rw [opow_le_iff_le_log hb hx]

name: log_pos
statement: theorem log_pos {b o : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) (ho : o ≠ 0) (hbo : b ≤ o) : 0 < log b o
proof:
:= by
  rwa [← add_one_le_iff, zero_add, ← opow_le_iff_le_log hb ho, opow_one]

name: log_eq_zero
statement: theorem log_eq_zero {b o : Ordinal} (hbo : o < b) : log b o = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne o 0 with (rfl | ho)
  · exact log_zero_right b
  rcases le_or_gt b 1 with hb | hb
  · rcases le_one_iff.1 hb with (rfl | rfl)
    · exact log_zero_left o
    · exact log_one_left o
  · rwa [← nonpos_iff_eq_zero, ← lt_add_one_iff, zero_add, ← lt_opow_iff_log_lt hb ho, opow_one]

name: log_mono_right
statement:
@[gcongr, mono]
theorem log_mono_right (b : Ordinal) {x y : Ordinal} (xy : x ≤ y) : log b x ≤ log b y
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx := eq_or_ne x 0
  · simp_rw [log_zero_right, zero_le]
  · obtain hb | hb := lt_or_ge 1 b
    · exact (opow_le_iff_le_log hb (hx.bot_lt.trans_le xy).ne').1 <|
        (opow_log_le_self _ hx).trans xy
    · rw [log_of_left_le_one hb, log_of_left_le_one hb]

name: log_le_self
statement: theorem log_le_self (b x : Ordinal) : log b x ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx := eq_or_ne x 0
  · rw [log_zero_right]
  · obtain hb | hb := lt_or_ge 1 b
    · exact (right_le_opow _ hb).trans (opow_log_le_self b hx)
    · simp_rw [log_of_left_le_one hb, zero_le]

name: log_one_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_one_right (b : Ordinal) : log b 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain hb | hb := lt_or_ge 1 b
  · exact log_eq_zero hb
  · exact log_of_left_le_one hb 1

name: mod_opow_log_lt_self
statement: theorem mod_opow_log_lt_self (b : Ordinal) {o : Ordinal} (ho : o ≠ 0) : o % (b ^ log b o) < o
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb)
  · simpa using pos_iff_ne_zero.2 ho
  · exact (mod_lt _ <| opow_ne_zero _ hb).trans_le (opow_log_le_self _ ho)

name: log_mod_opow_log_lt_log_self
statement:
theorem log_mod_opow_log_lt_log_self {b o : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) (hbo : b ≤ o) :
    log b (o % (b ^ log b o)) < log b o
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (o % (b ^ log b o)) 0 with h | h
  · rw [h, log_zero_right]
    exact log_pos hb (one_le_iff_ne_zero.1 (hb.le.trans hbo)) hbo
  · rw [← lt_opow_iff_log_lt hb h]
    exact mod_lt _ (opow_pos _ hb.pos).ne'

name: log_eq_iff
statement:
theorem log_eq_iff {b x : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) (hx : x ≠ 0) (y : Ordinal) :
    log b x = y ↔ b ^ y ≤ x ∧ x < b ^ (y + 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    use opow_log_le_self b hx, lt_opow_succ_log_self hb x
  · rintro ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩
    apply le_antisymm
    · rwa [← lt_add_one_iff, ← lt_opow_iff_log_lt hb hx]
    · rwa [← opow_le_iff_le_log hb hx]

name: log_opow_mul_add
statement:
theorem log_opow_mul_add {b u v w : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) (hv : v ≠ 0) (hw : w < b ^ u) :
    log b (b ^ u * v + w) = u + log b v
proof:
:= by
  rw [log_eq_iff hb]
  · constructor
    · grw [opow_add, opow_log_le_self b hv, ← le_self_add]
    · grw [hw, ← mul_add_one, add_assoc, opow_add]
      gcongr
      rw [add_one_le_iff]
      exact lt_opow_succ_log_self hb _
  · exact fun h ↦ mul_ne_zero (opow_ne_zero u (bot_lt_of_lt hb).ne') hv <|
      eq_zero_of_add_right h

name: log_opow_mul
statement:
theorem log_opow_mul {b v : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) (u : Ordinal) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    log b (b ^ u * v) = u + log b v
proof:
:= by
  simpa using log_opow_mul_add hb hv (opow_pos u (bot_lt_of_lt hb))

name: log_opow
statement: theorem log_opow {b : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) (x : Ordinal) : log b (b ^ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  convert! log_opow_mul hb x zero_ne_one.symm using 1
  · rw [mul_one]
  · rw [log_one_right, add_zero]

name: div_opow_log_pos
statement: theorem div_opow_log_pos (b : Ordinal) {o : Ordinal} (ho : o ≠ 0) : 0 < o / b ^ log b o
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_pos b with (rfl | hb)
  · simpa using pos_iff_ne_zero.2 ho
  · rw [div_pos (opow_ne_zero _ hb.ne')]
    exact opow_log_le_self b ho

name: div_opow_log_lt
statement: theorem div_opow_log_lt {b : Ordinal} (o : Ordinal) (hb : 1 < b) : o / b ^ log b o < b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lt_mul_iff_div_lt (opow_pos _ (zero_lt_one.trans hb)).ne', ← opow_add_one]
  exact lt_opow_succ_log_self hb o

name: div_two_opow_log
statement: theorem div_two_opow_log {o : Ordinal} (ho : o ≠ 0) : o / 2 ^ log 2 o = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa [← one_add_one_eq_two] using div_opow_log_lt o one_lt_two
  · simpa [one_le_iff_ne_zero, pos_iff_ne_zero] using div_opow_log_pos 2 ho

name: two_opow_log_add
statement: theorem two_opow_log_add {o : Ordinal} (ho : o ≠ 0) : 2 ^ log 2 o + o % 2 ^ log 2 o = o
proof:
:= by
  convert! div_add_mod .. using 2
  rw [div_two_opow_log ho, mul_one]

name: add_log_le_log_mul
statement:
theorem add_log_le_log_mul {x y : Ordinal} (b : Ordinal) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    log b x + log b y ≤ log b (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain hb | hb := lt_or_ge 1 b
  · rw [← opow_le_iff_le_log hb (mul_ne_zero hx hy), opow_add]
    exact mul_le_mul' (opow_log_le_self b hx) (opow_log_le_self b hy)
  · simpa only [log_of_left_le_one hb, zero_add] using le_rfl

name: omega0_opow_mul_nat_lt
statement:
@[deprecated opow_mul_lt_opow (since := "2026-06-01")]
theorem omega0_opow_mul_nat_lt {a b : Ordinal} (h : a < b) (n : ℕ) : ω ^ a * n < ω ^ b

name: sub_omega0_opow_log_lt
statement: theorem sub_omega0_opow_log_lt {a : Ordinal} (ha : a ≠ 0) : a - ω ^ log ω a < a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := lt_omega0.1 <| div_opow_log_lt a one_lt_omega0
  conv_lhs => left; rw [← div_add_mod a (ω ^ log ω a), hn]
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simpa using ((div_pos (opow_ne_zero _ omega0_ne_zero)).2 (opow_log_le_self _ ha)).trans_eq hn
  | succ n =>
    rw [add_comm, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, mul_one_add, add_assoc, Ordinal.add_sub_cancel]
    apply (opow_mul_add_lt_opow_mul _ (lt_add_one _)).trans_le
    · rw [Ordinal.mul_le_iff_le_div, hn] <;> simp
    · exact mod_lt _ (opow_ne_zero _ omega0_ne_zero)

name: lt_omega0_opow
statement:
theorem lt_omega0_opow {a b : Ordinal} (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a < ω ^ b ↔ ∃ c < b, ∃ n : ℕ, a < ω ^ c * n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ha ↦ ⟨_, lt_log_of_lt_opow hb ha, ?_⟩,
    fun ⟨c, hc, n, hn⟩ ↦ hn.trans (opow_mul_lt_opow (natCast_lt_omega0 n) hc)⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := lt_omega0.1 (div_opow_log_lt a one_lt_omega0)
  use n + 1
  rw [Nat.cast_add_one, ← hn]
  exact lt_mul_succ_div a (opow_ne_zero _ omega0_ne_zero)

name: lt_omega0_opow_succ
statement: theorem lt_omega0_opow_succ {a b : Ordinal} : a < ω ^ succ b ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, a < ω ^ b * n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ha ↦ ?_, fun ⟨n, hn⟩ ↦ hn.trans (opow_mul_lt_opow (natCast_lt_omega0 n) (lt_succ b))⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc, n, hn⟩ := (lt_omega0_opow (add_pos_of_right zero_lt_one b).ne').1 ha
  refine ⟨n, hn.trans_le ?_⟩
  grw [lt_succ_iff.1 hc]
  exact omega0_pos

name: lt_omega0_omega0_opow
statement:
theorem lt_omega0_omega0_opow {a b : Ordinal} (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    a < ω ^ ω ^ b ↔ ∃ c < b, ∃ n : ℕ, a < ω ^ (ω ^ c * n)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [lt_omega0_opow (opow_ne_zero _ omega0_ne_zero), lt_omega0_opow hb]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨a, ⟨b, hb, ⟨m, hm⟩⟩, ⟨n, hn⟩⟩
    exact ⟨_, hb, _, hn.trans <| opow_mul_lt_opow (natCast_lt_omega0 _) <|
      hm.trans_le (mul_le_mul_right (Nat.cast_le.2 m.le_succ) _)⟩
  · intro ⟨a, ha, ⟨n, hn⟩⟩
    refine ⟨ω ^ a * n, ⟨a, ha, n + 1, ?_⟩, 1, ?_⟩
    · simp [mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀, opow_pos]
    · simpa

name: natCast_pow
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem natCast_pow (m : ℕ) : ∀ n : ℕ, ↑(m ^ n : ℕ) = (m : Ordinal) ^ n
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by simp [pow_succ, natCast_pow m n]

name: iSup_pow_natCast
statement: theorem iSup_pow_natCast {o : Ordinal} (ho : 0 < o) : ⨆ n : ℕ, o ^ n = o ^ ω
proof:
:= by
  rcases (one_le_iff_pos.2 ho).lt_or_eq with ho₁ | rfl
  · simpa using apply_omega0_of_isNormal (isNormal_opow ho₁)
  · simp

name: natCast_log
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma natCast_log (m n : ℕ) : ↑(Nat.log m n) = Ordinal.log ↑m ↑n
proof:
:= by
  obtain hm | hm := le_or_gt m 1
  case inl => rw_mod_cast [Nat.log_of_left_le_one hm, log_of_left_le_one (mod_cast hm)]
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  case inl => simp

proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ a b, Prod.Lex s r (b, a) (enum _ ⟨_, l⟩) from irrefl _ (this _ _)

  rw [← typein_lt_typein (Prod.Lex s r), typein_enum]

  rw [mul_succ] at this

  refine (RelEmbedding.ofMonotone (fun a => ?_) fun a b => ?_).ordinal_type_le.trans_lt this
  · rcases a with ⟨⟨b', a'⟩, h⟩
    by_cases e : b = b'
    · exact .inr ⟨a', by grind [asymm_of s]⟩

proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hc := eq_or_ne c 0
  · rw [div_zero, div_zero]
  · rw [← mul_le_iff_le_div hc]
    exact (mul_div_le a c).trans h

name: mul_add_div
statement: theorem mul_add_div (a) {b : Ordinal} (b0 : b ≠ 0) (c) : (b * a + c) / b = a + c / b
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (div_le b0).2
    rw [mul_succ, mul_add, add_assoc, add_lt_add_iff_left]
    apply lt_mul_div_add _ b0
  · rw [← mul_le_iff_le_div b0, mul_add, add_le_add_iff_left]
    apply mul_div_le

name: div_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: theorem div_eq_zero_of_lt {a b : Ordinal} (h : a < b) : a / b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← nonpos_iff_eq_zero, div_le h.ne_bot]
  simpa

name: mul_div_cancel
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_div_cancel (a) {b : Ordinal} (b0 : b ≠ 0) : b * a / b = a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mul_add_div a b0 0

name: mul_add_div_mul
statement:
theorem mul_add_div_mul {a c : Ordinal} (hc : c < a) (b d : Ordinal) :
    (a * b + c) / (a * d) = b / d
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hd := eq_or_ne d 0
  · rw [mul_zero, div_zero, div_zero]
  · have H := mul_ne_zero hc.ne_zero hd
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← lt_succ_iff, ← lt_mul_iff_div_lt H, mul_assoc]
      · grw [hc, ← mul_succ]
        gcongr
        rw [succ_le_iff]
        exact lt_mul_succ_div b hd
    · grw [← mul_le_iff_le_div H, mul_assoc, mul_div_le b d, ← le_self_add]

name: mul_div_mul_cancel
statement: theorem mul_div_mul_cancel {a : Ordinal} (ha : a ≠ 0) (b c) : a * b / (a * c) = b / c
proof:
:= by
  convert! mul_add_div_mul (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 ha) b c using 1
  rw [add_zero]

name: div_eq
statement: theorem div_eq {a b c : Ordinal} (hle : b * c ≤ a) (hlt : a < b * (c + 1)) : a / b = c
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb)
  · simp at hlt
  exact le_antisymm (div_le hb |>.mpr hlt) (mul_le_iff_le_div hb |>.mp hle)

name: div_eq_iff
statement: theorem div_eq_iff {a b c : Ordinal} (hb : b ≠ 0) : a / b = c ↔ b * c ≤ a ∧ a < b * (c + 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h ▸ ⟨mul_div_le a b, lt_mul_succ_div a hb⟩, fun ⟨hle, hlt⟩ ↦ div_eq hle hlt⟩

name: div_eq_iff'
statement: theorem div_eq_iff' {a b c : Ordinal} (hc : c ≠ 0) : a / b = c ↔ b * c ≤ a ∧ a < b * (c + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb)
  · simp [hc.symm]
  exact div_eq_iff hb

name: div_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem div_eq_one_iff {a b : Ordinal} : a / b = 1 ↔ b ≤ a ∧ a < b * 2

name: div_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_one (a : Ordinal) : a / 1 = a
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [one_mul] using mul_div_cancel a one_ne_zero

name: div_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem div_self {a : Ordinal} (h : a ≠ 0) : a / a = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_one] using mul_div_cancel 1 h

name: mul_sub
statement: theorem mul_sub (a b c : Ordinal) : a * (b - c) = a * b - a * c
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp
  · refine eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun d ↦ ?_
    rw [sub_le, mul_le_iff_le_div ha, sub_le, mul_le_iff_le_div ha, mul_add_div _ ha]

name: isSuccLimit_add_iff
statement:
theorem isSuccLimit_add_iff {a b : Ordinal} :
    IsSuccLimit (a + b) ↔ IsSuccLimit b ∨ b = 0 ∧ IsSuccLimit a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by grind [isSuccLimit_add]⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | h')
  · grind
  rw [← add_sub_cancel a b]
  exact .inl <| isSuccLimit_sub h.isSuccPrelimit <| lt_add_of_pos_right a h'.pos

name: isSuccLimit_add_iff_of_isSuccLimit
statement:
theorem isSuccLimit_add_iff_of_isSuccLimit {a b : Ordinal} (h : IsSuccLimit a) :
    IsSuccLimit (a + b) ↔ IsSuccPrelimit b
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSuccLimit_add_iff]
  obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b 0
  · simpa
  · simp [hb, isSuccLimit_iff]

name: dvd_add_iff
statement:
theorem dvd_add_iff : ∀ {a b c : Ordinal}, a ∣ b → (a ∣ b + c ↔ a ∣ c)
  | a, _, c, ⟨b, rfl⟩ =>
    ⟨fun ⟨d, e⟩ => ⟨d - b, by rw [mul_sub, ← e, add_sub_cancel]⟩, fun ⟨d, e⟩ => by
      rw [e, ← mul_add]
      apply dvd_mul_right⟩

name: div_mul_cancel
statement:
theorem div_mul_cancel : ∀ {a b : Ordinal}, a ≠ 0 → a ∣ b → a * (b / a) = b
  | a, _, a0, ⟨b, rfl⟩ => by rw [mul_div_cancel _ a0]

name: le_of_dvd
statement: theorem le_of_dvd {a b : Ordinal} (b0 : b ≠ 0) (h : a ∣ b) : a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨b, rfl⟩
  simpa using mul_le_mul_right (one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr fun h ↦ by simp [h] at b0) a

name: dvd_antisymm
statement: theorem dvd_antisymm {a b : Ordinal} (h₁ : a ∣ b) (h₂ : b ∣ a) : a = b
proof:
:=
  if a0 : a = 0 then by subst a; exact (eq_zero_of_zero_dvd h₁).symm
  else
    if b0 : b = 0 then by subst b; exact eq_zero_of_zero_dvd h₂
    else (le_of_dvd b0 h₁).antisymm (le_of_dvd a0 h₂)

name: mod_def
statement: theorem mod_def (a b : Ordinal) : a % b = a - b * (a / b)

name: mod_le
statement: theorem mod_le (a b : Ordinal) : a % b ≤ a

name: mod_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mod_zero (a : Ordinal) : a % 0 = a

name: mod_eq_of_lt
statement: theorem mod_eq_of_lt {a b : Ordinal} (h : a < b) : a % b = a

name: zero_mod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_mod (b : Ordinal) : 0 % b = 0

name: div_add_mod
statement: theorem div_add_mod (a b : Ordinal) : b * (a / b) + a % b = a

name: mod_lt
statement: theorem mod_lt (a) {b : Ordinal} (h : b ≠ 0) : a % b < b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_lt_add_iff_left, div_add_mod]
  exact lt_mul_div_add a h

name: mod_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mod_self (a : Ordinal) : a % a = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp
  · simp [mod_def, ha]

name: mod_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mod_one (a : Ordinal) : a % 1 = 0

name: dvd_of_mod_eq_zero
statement: theorem dvd_of_mod_eq_zero {a b : Ordinal} (H : a % b = 0) : b ∣ a
proof:
:=
  ⟨a / b, by simpa [H] using (div_add_mod a b).symm⟩

name: mod_eq_zero_of_dvd
statement: theorem mod_eq_zero_of_dvd {a b : Ordinal} (H : b ∣ a) : a % b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases H with ⟨c, rfl⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb)
  · simp
  · simp [mod_def, hb]

name: dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero
statement: theorem dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero {a b : Ordinal} : b ∣ a ↔ a % b = 0

name: mul_add_mod_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_add_mod_self (x y z : Ordinal) : (x * y + z) % x = z % x
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · simp
  · rwa [mod_def, mul_add_div, mul_add, ← sub_sub, add_sub_cancel, mod_def]

name: mul_mod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mul_mod (x y : Ordinal) : x * y % x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mul_add_mod_self x y 0

name: mul_add_mod_mul
statement:
theorem mul_add_mod_mul {w x : Ordinal} (hw : w < x) (y z : Ordinal) :
    (x * y + w) % (x * z) = x * (y % z) + w
proof:
:= by
  rw [mod_def, mul_add_div_mul hw]
  apply sub_eq_of_add_eq
  rw [← add_assoc, mul_assoc, ← mul_add, div_add_mod]

name: mul_mod_mul
statement: theorem mul_mod_mul (x y z : Ordinal) : (x * y) % (x * z) = x * (y % z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx := eq_zero_or_pos x
  · simp
  · convert! mul_add_mod_mul hx y z using 1 <;>
    rw [add_zero]

name: mod_mod_of_dvd
statement: theorem mod_mod_of_dvd (a : Ordinal) {b c : Ordinal} (h : c ∣ b) : a % b % c = a % c
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← div_add_mod a b]
  rcases h with ⟨d, rfl⟩
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_add_mod_self]

name: mod_mod
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mod_mod (a b : Ordinal) : a % b % b = a % b

name: lt_mul_iff
statement: theorem lt_mul_iff {a b c : Ordinal} : a < b * c ↔ ∃ q < c, ∃ r < b, a = b * q + r
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hb₀ := eq_or_ne b 0; · simp
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨_, (lt_mul_iff_div_lt hb₀).1 h, _, mod_lt a hb₀, (div_add_mod ..).symm⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨q, hq, r, hr, rfl⟩
  grw [hr, ← mul_add_one, add_one_le_iff.2 hq]

name: forall_lt_mul
statement:
theorem forall_lt_mul {b c : Ordinal} {P : Ordinal → Prop} :
    (∀ a < b * c, P a) ↔ ∀ q < c, ∀ r < b, P (b * q + r)

name: exists_lt_mul
statement:
theorem exists_lt_mul {b c : Ordinal} {P : Ordinal → Prop} :
    (∃ a < b * c, P a) ↔ ∃ q < c, ∃ r < b, P (b * q + r)

name: one_add_natCast
statement:
@[deprecated Nat.cast_add_one_comm (since := "2026-05-10")]
theorem one_add_natCast (m : ℕ) : 1 + (m : Ordinal) = succ m

name: one_add_ofNat
statement:
@[deprecated Nat.cast_add_one_comm (since := "2026-05-10")]
theorem one_add_ofNat (m : ℕ) [m.AtLeastTwo] :
    1 + (ofNat(m) : Ordinal) = Order.succ (OfNat.ofNat m : Ordinal)

name: natCast_mul
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem natCast_mul (m : ℕ) : ∀ n : ℕ, ((m * n : ℕ) : Ordinal) = m * n
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.cast_add, natCast_mul m n, Nat.cast_succ, mul_add_one]

@[simp, norm_cast]

name: natCast_sub
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem natCast_sub (m n : ℕ) : ((m - n : ℕ) : Ordinal) = m - n
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total m n with h | h
  · rw [tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.2 h, Ordinal.sub_eq_zero_iff_le.2 (Nat.cast_le.2 h), Nat.cast_zero]
  · rw [← add_left_cancel_iff (a := ↑n), ← Nat.cast_add, add_tsub_cancel_of_le h,
      Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le (Nat.cast_le.2 h)]

name: natCast_div
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem natCast_div (m n : ℕ) : ((m / n : ℕ) : Ordinal) = m / n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn)
  · simp
  · have hn' : (n : Ordinal) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hn
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← mul_le_iff_le_div hn', ← natCast_mul, Nat.cast_le, mul_comm]
      apply Nat.div_mul_le_self
    · rw [div_le hn', succ_eq_add_one, ← Nat.cast_succ, ← natCast_mul, Nat.cast_lt, mul_comm,
        ← Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)]
      apply Nat.lt_succ_self

name: natCast_mod
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem natCast_mod (m n : ℕ) : ((m % n : ℕ) : Ordinal) = m % n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_left_cancel_iff, div_add_mod, ← natCast_div, ← natCast_mul, ← Nat.cast_add,
    Nat.div_add_mod]

name: lift_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_natCast : ∀ n : ℕ, lift.{u, v} n = n
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by simp [lift_natCast n]

@[simp]

name: lift_ofNat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_ofNat (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] :
    lift.{u, v} ofNat(n) = OfNat.ofNat n

name: typein_lt_nat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem typein_lt_nat (x : ℕ) : typein LT.lt x = x
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype <| Iio x := Nat.fintypeIio x
  rw [← type_Iio_lt, type_fintype, Nat.cast_inj]
  nth_rw 2 [← Fintype.card_fin x]
  exact Fintype.card_congr Fin.equivSubtype.symm

name: typein_lt_fin
statement:
@[simp]
theorem typein_lt_fin {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n) : typein LT.lt x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← type_Iio_lt, type_fintype, Nat.cast_inj]
  exact Fintype.card_fin_lt_of_le x.is_le'

name: enum_lt_fin
statement:
@[simp]
theorem enum_lt_fin {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n) : enum LT.lt ⟨x, by simp⟩ = x

name: lt_omega0
statement: theorem lt_omega0 {o : Ordinal} : o < ω ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, o = n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Cardinal.ord_aleph0, Cardinal.lt_ord, lt_aleph0, card_eq_nat]

name: natCast_lt_omega0
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natCast_lt_omega0 (n : ℕ) : ↑n < ω

name: enum_lt_nat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem enum_lt_nat (x : ℕ) : enum LT.lt ⟨x, by simp⟩ = x

name: eq_natCast_of_le_natCast
statement: theorem eq_natCast_of_le_natCast {a : Ordinal} {b : ℕ} (h : a ≤ b) : ∃ c : ℕ, a = c

name: eq_natCast_or_omega0_le
statement: theorem eq_natCast_or_omega0_le (o : Ordinal) : (∃ n : ℕ, o = n) ∨ ω ≤ o
proof:
:= by
  obtain ho | ho := lt_or_ge o ω
  · exact Or.inl <| lt_omega0.1 ho
  · exact Or.inr ho

name: natCast_image_Iio
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natCast_image_Iio (n : ℕ) : Nat.cast '' Set.Iio n = Set.Iio (n : Ordinal)
proof:
:= by
  ext o
  have := @eq_natCast_of_le_natCast o
  grind [Nat.cast_lt]

name: omega0_pos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem omega0_pos : 0 < ω

name: omega0_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem omega0_ne_zero : ω ≠ 0

name: one_lt_omega0
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_lt_omega0 : 1 < ω

name: isSuccLimit_omega0
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isSuccLimit_omega0 : IsSuccLimit ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSuccLimit_iff, isSuccPrelimit_iff_succ_lt]
  refine ⟨omega0_ne_zero, fun o h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := lt_omega0.1 h
  exact natCast_lt_omega0 (n + 1)

name: omega0_le
statement: theorem omega0_le {o : Ordinal} : ω ≤ o ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, ↑n ≤ o
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h n => (natCast_lt_omega0 _).le.trans h, fun H =>
    le_of_forall_lt fun a h => by
      let ⟨n, e⟩ := lt_omega0.1 h
      rw [e, ← succ_le_iff]; exact H (n + 1)⟩

name: omega0_le_of_isSuccLimit
statement: theorem omega0_le_of_isSuccLimit {o} (h : IsSuccLimit o) : ω ≤ o
proof:
:=
  omega0_le.2 fun n => le_of_lt <| natCast_lt_of_isSuccLimit h n

name: natCast_add_omega0
statement: theorem natCast_add_omega0 (n : ℕ) : n + ω = ω
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_of_forall_lt fun a ha ↦ ?_) le_add_self
  obtain ⟨b, hb', hb⟩ := (lt_add_iff omega0_ne_zero).1 ha
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := lt_omega0.1 hb'
  apply hb.trans_lt
  exact_mod_cast natCast_lt_omega0 (n + m)

name: one_add_omega0
statement: theorem one_add_omega0 : 1 + ω = ω

name: add_omega0
statement: theorem add_omega0 {a : Ordinal} (h : a < ω) : a + ω = ω
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := lt_omega0.1 h
  exact natCast_add_omega0 n

name: natCast_add_of_omega0_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natCast_add_of_omega0_le {o} (h : ω ≤ o) (n : ℕ) : n + o = o
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le h, ← add_assoc, natCast_add_omega0]

name: one_add_of_omega0_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_add_of_omega0_le {o} (h : ω ≤ o) : 1 + o = o

name: isSuccPrelimit_iff_omega0_dvd
statement: theorem isSuccPrelimit_iff_omega0_dvd {a : Ordinal} : IsSuccPrelimit a ↔ ω ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun l => ⟨a / ω, le_antisymm ?_ (mul_div_le _ _)⟩, fun h => ?_⟩
  · refine l.le_iff_forall_le.2 fun x hx => le_of_lt ?_
    rw [lt_mul_iff_div_lt omega0_ne_zero, ← succ_le_iff, ← mul_le_iff_le_div omega0_ne_zero,
      mul_succ, add_le_iff_of_isSuccLimit isSuccLimit_omega0]
    intro b hb
    rcases lt_omega0.1 hb with ⟨n, rfl⟩
    grw [mul_div_le]
    exact (lt_sub.1 <| natCast_lt_of_isSuccLimit (isSuccLimit_sub l hx) _).le
  · rcases h with ⟨a0, b, rfl⟩
    exact isSuccPrelimit_mul_left isSuccLimit_omega0

name: natCast_mod_omega0
statement:
@[simp]
theorem natCast_mod_omega0 (n : ℕ) : n % ω = n

name: add_one_of_aleph0_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_one_of_aleph0_le {c} (h : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : c + 1 = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, ← card_ord c, ← card_one, ← card_add, one_add_of_omega0_le]
  rwa [← ord_aleph0, ord_le_ord]

name: isSuccLimit_ord
statement: theorem isSuccLimit_ord {c} (hc : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : IsSuccLimit (ord c)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa using (aleph0_pos.trans_le hc).ne'
  · simp_rw [isSuccPrelimit_iff_succ_lt, succ_eq_add_one, lt_ord, card_add_one]
    refine fun a ha ↦ ?_
    contrapose! ha
    rwa [add_one_of_aleph0_le] at ha
    rw [← ord_le, ← IsSuccLimit.le_succ_iff, succ_eq_add_one, ord_le, card_add_one]
    · exact hc.trans ha
    · simp

name: noMaxOrder
statement: theorem noMaxOrder {c} (h : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : NoMaxOrder c.ord.ToType
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isSuccPrelimit_type_lt_iff, type_toType]
  exact (isSuccLimit_ord h).isSuccPrelimit

name: addCommute_iff_eq_mul_natCast
statement:
theorem addCommute_iff_eq_mul_natCast {o₁ o₂ : Ordinal} :
    AddCommute o₁ o₂ ↔ ∃ (o : Ordinal) (n₁ n₂ : ℕ), o * n₁ = o₁ ∧ o * n₂ = o₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hcomm ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
  · induction h : o₁ + o₂ using WellFoundedLT.induction generalizing o₁ o₂ with | ind o ih
    subst h
    wlog hle : o₁ ≤ o₂
    · grind [hcomm.symm]
    rcases eq_or_ne o₁ 0 with (rfl | h₁)
    · exact ⟨o₂, 0, 1, by simp, by simp⟩
    let o₃ := o₂ - o₁
    have hsub : o₁ + o₃ = o₂ := Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le hle
    have hcomm' : AddCommute o₁ o₃ := add_left_cancel (a := o₁) <| by grind
    have hlt : o₁ + o₃ < o₁ + o₂ := by simpa [hsub, hcomm.eq] using h₁.pos
    rcases ih _ hlt hcomm' rfl with ⟨o, n₁, n₃, hn₁, hn₃⟩
    use o, n₁, n₁ + n₃, hn₁
    rw [Nat.cast_add, mul_add, hn₁, hn₃, hsub]
  · rintro ⟨o, n₁, n₂, rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [addCommute_iff_eq, ← mul_add, ← mul_add, ← Nat.cast_add, add_comm, Nat.cast_add]

name: type_eq
statement:
theorem type_eq {α β} {r : α → α → Prop} {s : β → β → Prop} [IsWellOrder α r] [IsWellOrder β s] :
    type r = type s ↔ Nonempty (r ≃r s)

name: _root_.RelIso.ordinalType_congr
statement:
theorem _root_.RelIso.ordinalType_congr {α β} {r : α → α → Prop} {s : β → β → Prop}
    [IsWellOrder α r] [IsWellOrder β s] (h : r ≃r s) : type r = type s

name: _root_.OrderIso.ordinalType_congr
statement:
theorem _root_.OrderIso.ordinalType_congr {α β} [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β]

proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> refine fun ⟨f⟩ ↦ ⟨?_⟩
  · exact (RelIso.preimage Equiv.ulift r).symm.toInitialSeg.trans
      (f.trans (RelIso.preimage Equiv.ulift s).toInitialSeg)

  · exact (RelIso.preimage Equiv.ulift r).symm.trans <| f.trans (RelIso.preimage Equiv.ulift s)

  · exact (f.relIsoTrans (RelIso.preimage Equiv.ulift r).symm).transInitial
      (RelIso.preimage Equiv.ulift s).toInitialSeg

      (RelIso.preimage Equiv.ulift s).symm.toInitialSeg

name: type_lt_mem_range_succ_iff
statement:
theorem type_lt_mem_range_succ_iff [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] :
    typeLT α ∈ range succ ↔ ∃ x : α, IsMax x
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← isTop_iff_isMax]
  constructor <;> intro ⟨a, ha⟩
  · refine ⟨enum (α := α) (· < ·) ⟨a, ?_⟩, fun b ↦ ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_Iio, ← ha, lt_succ_iff]
    · rw [← enum_typein (α := α) (· < ·) b, ← not_lt, enum_le_enum (r := (· < ·)),
        Subtype.mk_le_mk, ← lt_succ_iff, ha]
      exact typein_lt_type ..
  · refine ⟨typein (α := α) (· < ·) a, eq_of_forall_lt_iff fun o ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [lt_succ_iff]
    refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.trans_lt (typein_lt_type _ _), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← typein_enum _ h, typein_le_typein, not_lt]
    apply ha

name: gc_ord_card
statement: theorem gc_ord_card : GaloisConnection ord card
proof:
:= by
  refine fun c o ↦ c.inductionOn fun α ↦ o.inductionOn fun β s _ ↦ ?_
  let ⟨r, _, e⟩ := exists_ord_eq α
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rw [e] at h
    exact card_le_card h
  · obtain ⟨f⟩ := h
    have g := RelEmbedding.preimage f s
    have := RelEmbedding.isWellOrder g
    exact (ord_le_type _).trans g.ordinal_type_le

name: List.SortedGT.lt_ord_of_lt
statement:
theorem List.SortedGT.lt_ord_of_lt [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] {l m : List α}
    {o : Ordinal} (hl : l.SortedGT) (hm : m.SortedGT) (hmltl : m < l)
    (hlt : ∀ i ∈ l, Ordinal.typein (α := α) (· < ·) i < o) :
      ∀ i ∈ m, Ordinal.typein (α := α) (· < ·) i < o
proof:
:= by
  replace hmltl : List.Lex (· < ·) m l := hmltl
  cases l with
  | nil => simp at hmltl
  | cons a as =>
    cases m with
    | nil => intro i hi; simp at hi
    | cons b bs =>
      intro i hi
      suffices h : i ≤ a by refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (hlt a mem_cons_self); simpa
      cases hi with
      | head as => exact List.head_le_of_lt hmltl
      | tail b hi => exact le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le (List.rel_of_pairwise_cons hm.pairwise hi)
          (List.head_le_of_lt hmltl))

name: eq_of_cmp_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_cmp_eq : ∀ {o₁ o₂}, cmp o₁ o₂ = Ordering.eq → o₁ = o₂
  | 0, 0, _ => rfl
  | oadd e n a, 0, h => by injection h
  | 0, oadd e n a, h => by injection h
  | oadd e₁ n₁ a₁, oadd e₂ n₂ a₂, h => by
    revert h; simp only [cmp]
    cases h₁ : cmp e₁ e₂ <;> intro h <;> try cases h
    obtain rfl
proof:
:= eq_of_cmp_eq h₁
    revert h; cases h₂ : _root_.cmp (n₁ : ℕ) n₂ <;> intro h <;> try cases h
    obtain rfl := eq_of_cmp_eq h
    rw [_root_.cmp, cmpUsing_eq_eq, not_lt, not_lt, ← le_antisymm_iff] at h₂
    obtain rfl := Subtype.ext h₂
    simp

    ⟨fun h => (not_le_of_gt h.lt).elim zero_le, fun e => e.symm ▸ NFBelow.zero⟩

name: NF.zero_of_zero
statement: theorem NF.zero_of_zero {e n a} (h : NF (ONote.oadd e n a)) (e0 : e = 0) : a = 0

name: NFBelow.repr_lt
statement: theorem NFBelow.repr_lt {o b} (h : NFBelow o b) : repr o < ω ^ b
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero => exact opow_pos _ omega0_pos
  | oadd' _ _ h₃ _ IH =>
    rw [repr]
    apply (add_lt_add_right IH _).trans_le
    grw [← mul_succ, succ_le_of_lt (natCast_lt_omega0 _), ← opow_add_one]
    exact opow_le_opow_right omega0_pos (by simpa [succ_eq_add_one] using succ_le_of_lt h₃)

name: NFBelow.mono
statement: theorem NFBelow.mono {o b₁ b₂} (bb : b₁ ≤ b₂) (h : NFBelow o b₁) : NFBelow o b₂
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | zero => exact zero
  | oadd' h₁ h₂ h₃ _ _ => constructor; exacts [h₁, h₂, lt_of_lt_of_le h₃ bb]

name: NF.below_of_lt
statement:
theorem NF.below_of_lt {e n a b} (H : repr e < b) :
    NF (ONote.oadd e n a) → NFBelow (ONote.oadd e n a) b
  | ⟨⟨b', h⟩⟩ => by (obtain - | ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ := h; exact NFBelow.oadd' h₁ h₂ H)

name: NF.below_of_lt'
statement:
theorem NF.below_of_lt' : ∀ {o b}, repr o < ω ^ b → NF o → NFBelow o b
  | 0, _, _, _ => NFBelow.zero
  | ONote.oadd _ _ _, _, H, h =>
    h.below_of_lt <|
      (opow_lt_opow_iff_right one_lt_omega0).1 <| lt_of_le_of_lt (omega0_le_oadd _ _ _) H

name: nfBelow_ofNat
statement:
theorem nfBelow_ofNat : ∀ n, NFBelow (ofNat n) 1
  | 0 => NFBelow.zero
  | Nat.succ _ => NFBelow.oadd NF.zero NFBelow.zero zero_lt_one

instance nf_ofNat (n) : NF (ofNat n)

name: oadd_lt_oadd_1
statement:
theorem oadd_lt_oadd_1 {e₁ n₁ o₁ e₂ n₂ o₂} (h₁ : NF (oadd e₁ n₁ o₁)) (h : e₁ < e₂) :
    oadd e₁ n₁ o₁ < oadd e₂ n₂ o₂

name: oadd_lt_oadd_2
statement:
theorem oadd_lt_oadd_2 {e o₁ o₂ : ONote} {n₁ n₂ : ℕ+} (h₁ : NF (oadd e n₁ o₁)) (h : (n₁ : ℕ) < n₂) :
    oadd e n₁ o₁ < oadd e n₂ o₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lt_def, repr]
  grw [h₁.snd'.repr_lt, ← le_self_add]
  rwa [← mul_succ, mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (opow_pos _ omega0_pos), succ_le_iff, Nat.cast_lt]

name: oadd_lt_oadd_3
statement: theorem oadd_lt_oadd_3 {e n a₁ a₂} (h : a₁ < a₂) : oadd e n a₁ < oadd e n a₂

name: cmp_compares
statement:
theorem cmp_compares : ∀ (a b : ONote) [NF a] [NF b], (cmp a b).Compares a b
  | 0, 0, _, _ => rfl
  | oadd _ _ _, 0, _, _ => oadd_pos _ _ _
  | 0, oadd _ _ _, _, _ => oadd_pos _ _ _
  | o₁@(oadd e₁ n₁ a₁), o₂@(oadd e₂ n₂ a₂), h₁, h₂ => by 
    rw [cmp]
    have IHe
proof:
:= @cmp_compares _ _ h₁.fst h₂.fst
    simp only [Ordering.Compares, gt_iff_lt] at IHe; revert IHe
    cases cmp e₁ e₂
    case lt => intro IHe; exact oadd_lt_oadd_1 h₁ IHe
    case gt => intro IHe; exact oadd_lt_oadd_1 h₂ IHe
    case eq =>
      intro IHe; dsimp at IHe; subst IHe
      unfold _root_.cmp; cases nh : cmpUsing (· < ·) (n₁ : ℕ) n₂ <;>
      rw [cmpUsing, ite_eq_iff, not_lt] at nh
      case lt =>
        rcases nh with nh | nh
        · exact oadd_lt_oadd_2 h₁ nh.left
        · rw [ite_eq_iff] at nh; rcases nh.right with nh | nh <;> cases nh <;> contradiction
      case gt =>
        rcases nh with nh | nh
        · cases nh; contradiction
        · obtain ⟨_, nh⟩ := nh
          rw [ite_eq_iff] at nh; rcases nh with nh | nh
          · exact oadd_lt_oadd_2 h₂ nh.left
          · cases nh; contradiction
      rcases nh with nh | nh
      · cases nh; contradiction
      obtain ⟨nhl, nhr⟩ := nh
      rw [ite_eq_iff] at nhr
      rcases nhr with nhr | nhr
      · cases nhr; contradiction
      obtain rfl := Subtype.ext (nhl.eq_of_not_lt nhr.1)
      have IHa := @cmp_compares _ _ h₁.snd h₂.snd
      revert IHa; cases cmp a₁ a₂ <;> intro IHa <;> dsimp at IHa
      case lt => exact oadd_lt_oadd_3 IHa
      case gt => exact oadd_lt_oadd_3 IHa
      subst IHa; exact rfl

name: repr_inj
statement: theorem repr_inj {a b} [NF a] [NF b] : repr a = repr b ↔ a = b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun e => match cmp a b, cmp_compares a b with
    | Ordering.lt, (h : repr a < repr b) => (ne_of_lt h e).elim
    | Ordering.gt, (h : repr a > repr b)=> (ne_of_gt h e).elim
    | Ordering.eq, h => h,
    congr_arg _⟩

name: NF.of_dvd_omega0_opow
statement:
theorem NF.of_dvd_omega0_opow {b e n a} (h : NF (ONote.oadd e n a))
    (d : ω ^ b ∣ repr (ONote.oadd e n a)) :
    b ≤ repr e ∧ ω ^ b ∣ repr a
proof:
:= by
  have := mt repr_inj.1 (fun h => by injection h : ONote.oadd e n a ≠ 0)
  have L := le_of_not_gt fun l => not_le_of_gt (h.below_of_lt l).repr_lt (le_of_dvd this d)
  simp only [repr] at d
  exact ⟨L, (dvd_add_iff <| (opow_dvd_opow _ L).mul_right _).1 d⟩

name: NF.of_dvd_omega0
statement:
theorem NF.of_dvd_omega0 {e n a} (h : NF (ONote.oadd e n a)) :
    ω ∣ repr (ONote.oadd e n a) → repr e ≠ 0 ∧ ω ∣ repr a
proof:
:= by
  (rw [← opow_one ω, ← one_le_iff_ne_zero]; exact h.of_dvd_omega0_opow)

name: nfBelow_iff_topBelow
statement:
theorem nfBelow_iff_topBelow {b} [NF b] : ∀ {o}, NFBelow o (repr b) ↔ NF o ∧ TopBelow b o
  | 0 => ⟨fun h => ⟨⟨⟨_, h⟩⟩, trivial⟩, fun _ => NFBelow.zero⟩
  | oadd _ _ _ =>
    ⟨fun h => ⟨⟨⟨_, h⟩⟩, (@cmp_compares _ b h.fst _).eq_lt.2 h.lt⟩, fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ =>
      h₁.below_of_lt <| (@cmp_compares _ b h₁.fst _).eq_lt.1 h₂⟩

instance decidableNF : DecidablePred NF
  | 0 => isTrue NF.zero
  | oadd e n a => by
    have
proof:
:= decidableNF e
    have := decidableNF a
    apply decidable_of_iff (NF e ∧ NF a ∧ TopBelow e a)
    rw [← and_congr_right fun h => @nfBelow_iff_topBelow _ h _]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ => NF.oadd h₁ n h₂, fun h => ⟨h.fst, h.snd'⟩⟩

name: zero_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_add (o : ONote) : 0 + o = o

name: oadd_add
statement: theorem oadd_add (e n a o) : oadd e n a + o = addAux e n (a + o)

name: add_nfBelow
statement:
theorem add_nfBelow {b} : ∀ {o₁ o₂}, NFBelow o₁ b → NFBelow o₂ b → NFBelow (o₁ + o₂) b
  | 0, _, _, h₂ => h₂
  | oadd e n a, o, h₁, h₂ => by
    have h'
proof:
:= add_nfBelow (h₁.snd.mono <| le_of_lt h₁.lt) h₂
    simp only [oadd_add]; revert h'; obtain - | ⟨e', n', a'⟩ := a + o <;> intro h'
    · exact NFBelow.oadd h₁.fst NFBelow.zero h₁.lt
    have : ((e.cmp e').Compares e e') := @cmp_compares _ _ h₁.fst h'.fst
    cases h : cmp e e' <;> dsimp [addAux] <;> simp only [h]
    · exact h'
    · simp only [h] at this
      subst e'
      exact NFBelow.oadd h'.fst h'.snd h'.lt
    · simp only [h] at this
      exact NFBelow.oadd h₁.fst (NF.below_of_lt this ⟨⟨_, h'⟩⟩) h₁.lt

name: repr_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem repr_add : ∀ (o₁ o₂) [NF o₁] [NF o₂], repr (o₁ + o₂) = repr o₁ + repr o₂
  | 0, o, _, _ => by simp
  | oadd e n a, o, h₁, h₂ => by
    have
proof:
:= h₁.snd; have h' := repr_add a o
    conv_lhs at h' => simp [HAdd.hAdd, Add.add]
    have nf := ONote.add_nf a o
    conv at nf => simp [HAdd.hAdd, Add.add]
    conv in _ + o => simp [HAdd.hAdd, Add.add]
    rcases h : add a o with - | ⟨e', n', a'⟩ <;>
      simp only [add, addAux, h'.symm, h, add_assoc, repr] at nf h₁ ⊢
    have := h₁.fst; have := nf.fst; have ee := cmp_compares e e'
    cases he : cmp e e' <;> simp only [he, Ordering.compares_gt, Ordering.compares_lt,
        Ordering.compares_eq, repr, gt_iff_lt, PNat.add_coe, Nat.cast_add] at ee ⊢
    · rw [← add_assoc, @add_of_omega0_opow_le _ (repr e') (ω ^ repr e' * (n' : ℕ))]
      · have := (h₁.below_of_lt ee).repr_lt
        simp only [repr] at this
        cases he' : e' <;>
          simp only [he', zero_def, opow_zero, repr, repr_zero, gt_iff_lt] at this ⊢ <;>
          exact lt_of_le_of_lt le_self_add this
      · simpa using (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ <| opow_pos (repr e') omega0_pos).2
          (Nat.cast_le.2 n'.pos)
    · rw [ee, ← add_assoc, ← mul_add]

name: sub_nfBelow
statement:
theorem sub_nfBelow : ∀ {o₁ o₂ b}, NFBelow o₁ b → NF o₂ → NFBelow (o₁ - o₂) b
  | 0, o, b, _, h₂ => by cases o <;> exact NFBelow.zero
  | oadd _ _ _, 0, _, h₁, _ => h₁
  | oadd e₁ n₁ a₁, oadd e₂ n₂ a₂, b, h₁, h₂ => by
    have h'
proof:
:= sub_nfBelow h₁.snd h₂.snd
    simp only [HSub.hSub, Sub.sub, sub] at h' ⊢
    have := @cmp_compares _ _ h₁.fst h₂.fst
    cases h : cmp e₁ e₂
    · apply NFBelow.zero
    · rw [Nat.sub_eq]
      simp only [h, Ordering.compares_eq] at this
      subst e₂
      cases (n₁ : ℕ) - n₂
      · by_cases en : n₁ = n₂ <;> simp only [en, ↓reduceIte]
        · exact h'.mono (le_of_lt h₁.lt)
        · exact NFBelow.zero
      · exact NFBelow.oadd h₁.fst h₁.snd h₁.lt
    · exact h₁

name: repr_sub
statement:
@[simp]
theorem repr_sub : ∀ (o₁ o₂) [NF o₁] [NF o₂], repr (o₁ - o₂) = repr o₁ - repr o₂
  | 0, o, _, h₂ => by cases o <;> exact (Ordinal.zero_sub _).symm
  | oadd _ _ _, 0, _, _ => (Ordinal.sub_zero _).symm
  | oadd e₁ n₁ a₁, oadd e₂ n₂ a₂, h₁, h₂ => by
    have
proof:
:= h₁.snd; have := h₂.snd; have h' := repr_sub a₁ a₂
    conv_lhs at h' => dsimp [HSub.hSub, Sub.sub, sub]
    conv_lhs => dsimp only [HSub.hSub, Sub.sub]; dsimp only [sub]
    have ee := @cmp_compares _ _ h₁.fst h₂.fst
    cases h : cmp e₁ e₂ <;> simp only [h] at ee
    · rw [Ordinal.sub_eq_zero_iff_le.2]
      · rfl
      exact le_of_lt (oadd_lt_oadd_1 h₁ ee)
    · change e₁ = e₂ at ee
      subst e₂
      dsimp only
      cases mn : (n₁ : ℕ) - n₂ <;> dsimp only
      · by_cases en : n₁ = n₂
        · simpa [en]
        · simp only [en, ite_false]
          exact
            (Ordinal.sub_eq_zero_iff_le.2 <|
                le_of_lt <|
                  oadd_lt_oadd_2 h₁ <|
                    lt_of_le_of_ne (tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.1 mn) (mt PNat.eq en)).symm
      · simp only [Nat.succPNat, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, repr, PNat.mk_coe, ← succ_eq_add_one]
        rw [(tsub_eq_iff_eq_add_of_le <| le_of_lt <| Nat.lt_of_sub_eq_succ mn).1 mn, add_comm,
          Nat.cast_add, mul_add, add_assoc, add_sub_add_cancel]
        refine
          (Ordinal.sub_eq_of_add_eq <|
              add_of_omega0_opow_le h₂.snd'.repr_lt <| le_trans ?_ le_self_add).symm
        exact Ordinal.le_mul_left _ (Nat.cast_lt.2 <| Nat.succ_pos _)
    · exact
        (Ordinal.sub_eq_of_add_eq <|
            add_of_omega0_opow_le (h₂.below_of_lt ee).repr_lt <| omega0_le_oadd _ _ _).symm

name: oadd_mul
oadd_mul_nfBelow
statement:
theorem oadd_mul_nfBelow {e₁ n₁ a₁ b₁} (h₁ : NFBelow (oadd e₁ n₁ a₁) b₁) :
    ∀ {o₂ b₂}, NFBelow o₂ b₂ → NFBelow (oadd e₁ n₁ a₁ * o₂) (repr e₁ + b₂)
  | 0, _, _ => NFBelow.zero
  | oadd e₂ n₂ a₂, b₂, h₂ => by
    have IH
proof:
:= oadd_mul_nfBelow h₁ h₂.snd
    by_cases e0 : e₂ = 0 <;> simp only [e0, oadd_mul, ↓reduceIte]
    · apply NFBelow.oadd h₁.fst h₁.snd
      grw [← h₂.lt.pos, add_zero]
    · have := h₁.fst
      have := h₂.fst
      apply NFBelow.oadd
      · infer_instance
      · rwa [repr_add]
      · grw [repr_add, h₂.lt]

name: repr_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem repr_mul : ∀ (o₁ o₂) [NF o₁] [NF o₂], repr (o₁ * o₂) = repr o₁ * repr o₂
  | 0, o, _, h₂ => by cases o <;> exact (zero_mul _).symm
  | oadd _ _ _, 0, _, _ => (mul_zero _).symm
  | oadd e₁ n₁ a₁, oadd e₂ n₂ a₂, h₁, h₂ => by
    have IH : repr (mul _ _) = _
proof:
:= @repr_mul _ _ h₁ h₂.snd
    conv =>
      lhs
      simp [(· * ·)]
    have ao : repr a₁ + ω ^ repr e₁ * (n₁ : ℕ) = ω ^ repr e₁ * (n₁ : ℕ) := by
      apply add_of_omega0_opow_le h₁.snd'.repr_lt
      simpa using! (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ <| opow_pos _ omega0_pos).2 (Nat.cast_le.2 n₁.2)
    by_cases e0 : e₂ = 0
    · obtain ⟨x, xe⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero n₂.ne_zero
      simp only [Mul.mul, mul, e0, ↓reduceIte, repr, repr_zero, PNat.mul_coe, natCast_mul,
        opow_zero, one_mul]
      simp only [xe, h₂.zero_of_zero e0, repr_zero, add_zero]
      rw [Nat.cast_add_one x, add_mul_add_one _ ao, mul_assoc]
    · simp only [repr]
      have := h₁.fst
      have := h₂.fst
      simp only [Mul.mul, mul, e0, ite_false, repr.eq_2, repr_add, opow_add, IH, repr, mul_add]
      rw [← mul_assoc]
      congr 2
      have := mt repr_inj.1 e0
      rw [add_mul_of_isSuccLimit ao (isSuccLimit_opow_left isSuccLimit_omega0 this), mul_assoc,
        mul_omega0_dvd (Nat.cast_pos'.2 n₁.pos) (natCast_lt_omega0 _)]
      simpa using! opow_dvd_opow ω (one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 this)

name: opow_def
statement: theorem opow_def (o₁ o₂ : ONote) : o₁ ^ o₂ = opowAux2 o₂ (split o₁)

name: split_eq_scale_split'
statement:
theorem split_eq_scale_split' : ∀ {o o' m} [NF o], split' o = (o', m) → split o = (scale 1 o', m)
  | 0, o', m, _, p => by injection p; subst o' m; rfl
  | oadd e n a, o', m, h, p => by
    by_cases e0 : e = 0 <;> simp only [split', e0, ↓reduceIte, Prod.mk.injEq, split] at p ⊢
    · rcases p with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · revert p
      rcases h' : split' a with ⟨a', m'⟩
      have
proof:
:= h.fst
      have := h.snd
      simp only [split_eq_scale_split' h', and_imp]
      have : 1 + (e - 1) = e := by
        refine repr_inj.1 ?_
        simp only [repr_add, repr_one, Nat.cast_one, repr_sub]
        have := mt repr_inj.1 e0
        exact Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le <| one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 this
      intros
      subst o' m
      simp [scale, this]

name: nf_repr_split'
statement:
theorem nf_repr_split' : ∀ {o o' m} [NF o], split' o = (o', m) → NF o' ∧ repr o = ω * repr o' + m
  | 0, o', m, _, p => by injection p; subst o' m; simp [NF.zero]
  | oadd e n a, o', m, h, p => by
    by_cases e0 : e = 0 <;>
      simp only [split', e0, ↓reduceIte, Prod.mk.injEq, repr, repr_zero, opow_zero, one_mul] at p ⊢
    · rcases p with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      simp [h.zero_of_zero e0, NF.zero]
    · revert p
      rcases h' : split' a with ⟨a', m'⟩
      have
proof:
:= h.fst
      have := h.snd
      obtain ⟨IH₁, IH₂⟩ := nf_repr_split' h'
      simp only [IH₂, and_imp]
      intros
      subst o' m
      have : (ω : Ordinal.{0}) ^ repr e = ω ^ (1 : Ordinal.{0}) * ω ^ (repr e - 1) := by
        have := mt repr_inj.1 e0
        rw [← opow_add, Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le (one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 this)]
      refine ⟨NF.oadd (by infer_instance) _ ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [opow_one, repr_sub, repr_one, Nat.cast_one] at this ⊢
        refine IH₁.below_of_lt' <| (mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ omega0_pos).1 <|
          (le_self_add (α := Ordinal) (b := m')).trans_lt ?_
        rw [← this, ← IH₂]
        exact h.snd'.repr_lt
      · rw [this]
        simp [mul_add, mul_assoc, add_assoc]

name: scale_eq_mul
statement:
theorem scale_eq_mul (x) [NF x] : ∀ (o) [NF o], scale x o = oadd x 1 0 * o
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | oadd e n a, h => by
    simp only [HMul.hMul]; simp only [scale]
    have
proof:
:= h.snd
    by_cases e0 : e = 0
    · simp_rw [scale_eq_mul]
      simp [Mul.mul, mul, e0, h.zero_of_zero,
        show x + 0 = x from repr_inj.1 (by simp)]
    · simp [e0, Mul.mul, mul, scale_eq_mul, (· * ·)]

name: repr_scale
statement:
@[simp]
theorem repr_scale (x) [NF x] (o) [NF o] : repr (scale x o) = ω ^ repr x * repr o
proof:
:= by
  simp only [scale_eq_mul, repr_mul, repr, PNat.one_coe, Nat.cast_one, mul_one, add_zero]

name: nf_repr_split
statement: theorem nf_repr_split {o o' m} [NF o] (h : split o = (o', m)) : NF o' ∧ repr o = repr o' + m
proof:
:= by
  rcases e : split' o with ⟨a, n⟩
  obtain ⟨s₁, s₂⟩ := nf_repr_split' e
  rw [split_eq_scale_split' e] at h
  injection h; subst o' n
  simp only [repr_scale, repr_one, Nat.cast_one, opow_one, ← s₂, and_true]
  infer_instance

name: split_dvd
statement: theorem split_dvd {o o' m} [NF o] (h : split o = (o', m)) : ω ∣ repr o'
proof:
:= by
  rcases e : split' o with ⟨a, n⟩
  rw [split_eq_scale_split' e] at h
  injection h; subst o'
  cases nf_repr_split' e; simp

name: split_add_lt
statement:
theorem split_add_lt {o e n a m} [NF o] (h : split o = (oadd e n a, m)) :
    repr a + m < ω ^ repr e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := nf_repr_split h
  obtain ⟨e0, d⟩ := h₁.of_dvd_omega0 (split_dvd h)
  apply isPrincipal_add_omega0_opow _ h₁.snd'.repr_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le (natCast_lt_omega0 _) _)
  simpa using opow_le_opow_right omega0_pos (one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 e0)

name: mulNat_eq_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mulNat_eq_mul (n o) : mulNat o n = o * ofNat n
proof: := by cases o <;> cases n <;> rfl

name: scale_opowAux
statement:
theorem scale_opowAux (e a0 a : ONote) [NF e] [NF a0] [NF a] :
    ∀ k m, repr (opowAux e a0 a k m) = ω ^ repr e * repr (opowAux 0 a0 a k m)
  | 0, m => by cases m <;> simp [opowAux]
  | k + 1, m => by
    by_cases h : m = 0 <;> simp only [h, opowAux, mulNat_eq_mul, repr_add, repr_scale, repr_mul,
      repr_ofNat, zero_add, mul_add, repr_zero, mul_zero, scale_opowAux e, opow_add, mul_assoc]

name: repr_opow_aux
statement:
theorem repr_opow_aux₁ {e a} [Ne : NF e] [Na : NF a] {a' : Ordinal} (e0 : repr e ≠ 0)
    (h : a' < (ω : Ordinal.{0}) ^ repr e) (aa : repr a = a') (n : ℕ+) :
    ((ω : Ordinal.{0}) ^ repr e * (n : ℕ) + a') ^ (ω : Ordinal.{0}) =
      (ω ^ repr e) ^ (ω : Ordinal.{0})
proof:
:= by
  subst aa
  have No := Ne.oadd n (Na.below_of_lt' h)
  have := omega0_le_oadd e n a
  rw [repr] at this
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (opow_le_opow_left _ this)
  apply (opow_le_of_isSuccLimit ((opow_pos _ omega0_pos).trans_le this).ne' isSuccLimit_omega0).2
  intro b l
  have := (No.below_of_lt (lt_succ _)).repr_lt
  rw [repr] at this
  apply (opow_le_opow_left b <| this.le).trans
  rw [← opow_mul, ← opow_mul]
  rcases le_or_gt ω (repr e) with h | h
  · grw [le_succ b, show succ b = b + 1 by rw [succ_eq_add_one],
      show succ (repr e) = repr e + 1 by rw [succ_eq_add_one],
      add_mul_add_one _ (one_add_of_omega0_le h)]
    · gcongr
      · exact omega0_pos
      · exact succ_le_iff.2 <| by gcongr; exact isSuccLimit_omega0.succ_lt l
    · exact omega0_pos
  · grw [show _ * _ < _ from isPrincipal_mul_omega0 (isSuccLimit_omega0.succ_lt h) l]
    · simpa using mul_le_mul_left (one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 e0) ω
    · exact omega0_pos

name: repr_opow_aux
statement:
theorem repr_opow_aux₂ {a0 a'} [N0 : NF a0] [Na' : NF a'] (m : ℕ) (d : ω ∣ repr a')
    (e0 : repr a0 ≠ 0) (h : repr a' + m < (ω ^ repr a0)) (n : ℕ+) (k : ℕ) :
    let R
proof:
:= repr (opowAux 0 a0 (oadd a0 n a' * ofNat m) k m)
    (k ≠ 0 → R < ((ω ^ repr a0) ^ succ (k : Ordinal))) ∧
      ((ω ^ repr a0) ^ (k : Ordinal)) * ((ω ^ repr a0) * (n : ℕ) + repr a') + R =
        ((ω ^ repr a0) * (n : ℕ) + repr a' + m) ^ succ (k : Ordinal) := by
  intro R'
  have No : NF (oadd a0 n a') :=
    N0.oadd n (Na'.below_of_lt' <| lt_of_le_of_lt le_self_add h)
  induction k with
  | zero => cases m <;> simp [R', opowAux]
  | succ k IH =>
  let R := repr (opowAux 0 a0 (oadd a0 n a' * ofNat m) k m)
  let ω0 := ω ^ repr a0
  let α' := ω0 * n + repr a'
  change (k ≠ 0 → R < (ω0 ^ succ (k : Ordinal))) ∧ (ω0 ^ (k : Ordinal)) * α' + R
    = (α' + m) ^ (succ ↑k : Ordinal) at IH
  have RR : R' = ω0 ^ (k : Ordinal) * (α' * m) + R := by
    by_cases h : m = 0
    · simp only [R, R', h, ONote.ofNat, Nat.cast_zero, ONote.repr_zero,
        mul_zero, ONote.opowAux, add_zero]
    · simp only [α', ω0, R, R', ONote.repr_scale, ONote.repr,
        ONote.mulNat_eq_mul, ONote.opowAux, ONote.repr_ofNat, ONote.repr_mul, ONote.repr_add,
        Ordinal.opow_mul, ONote.zero_add]
  have α0 : 0 < α' := by simpa [lt_def, repr] using oadd_pos a0 n a'
  have ω00 : 0 < ω0 ^ (k : Ordinal) := opow_pos _ (opow_pos _ omega0_pos)
  have Rl : R < ω ^ (repr a0 * succ ↑k) := by
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, succ_eq_add_one, _root_.zero_add, mul_one, R]
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (opow_le_opow_right omega0_pos (one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 e0))
      cases m with
      | zero => simp [opowAux, omega0_pos]
      | succ m => simpa [opowAux] using natCast_lt_omega0 (m + 1)
    | succ k =>
      rw [opow_mul]
      exact IH.1 (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)
  refine ⟨fun _ => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [RR, ← opow_mul _ _ (succ k.succ)]
    have e0 := pos_iff_ne_zero.2 e0
    apply isPrincipal_add_omega0_opow
    · simp only [Nat.cast_add_one, succ_eq_add_one, opow_add_one, opow_mul, mul_assoc]
      gcongr ?_ * ?_
      rw [← Ordinal.opow_add]
      have : _ < ω ^ (repr a0 + repr a0) := (No.below_of_lt ?_).repr_lt
      · exact mul_lt_omega0_opow (lt_of_lt_of_le e0 le_add_self) this (natCast_lt_omega0 _)
      · simpa using (add_lt_add_iff_left (repr a0)).2 e0
    · exact Rl.trans_le <| opow_le_opow_right omega0_pos <|
        mul_le_mul_right (succ_le_succ_iff.2 (Nat.cast_le.2 (Nat.le_succ k))) _
  calc
    (ω0 ^ (k.succ : Ordinal)) * α' + R'
    _ = (ω0 ^ succ (k : Ordinal)) * α' + ((ω0 ^ (k : Ordinal)) * α' * m + R) := by
        rw [Nat.cast_add_one, RR, ← mul_assoc, succ_eq_add_one]
    _ = ((ω0 ^ (k : Ordinal)) * α' + R) * α' + ((ω0 ^ (k : Ordinal)) * α' + R) * m := ?_
    _ = (α' + m) ^ succ (k.succ : Ordinal) := by
        rw [← mul_add, succ_eq_add_one, opow_add_one, Nat.cast_add_one, IH.2, succ_eq_add_one]
  congr 1
  · have αd : ω ∣ α' :=
      dvd_add (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (by simpa using opow_dvd_opow ω (one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 e0)) _) d
    have α0 : ¬IsMin α' := by simpa [isMin_iff_eq_bot] using α0.ne'
    rw [mul_add (ω0 ^ (k : Ordinal)), add_assoc, ← mul_assoc, ← opow_add_one,
      ← succ_eq_add_one (k : Ordinal),
      add_mul_of_isSuccLimit _ ⟨α0, isSuccPrelimit_iff_omega0_dvd.2 αd⟩, mul_assoc,
      @mul_omega0_dvd n (Nat.cast_pos'.2 n.pos) (natCast_lt_omega0 _) _ αd]
    apply @add_of_omega0_opow_le _ (repr a0 * succ ↑k)
    · refine isPrincipal_add_omega0_opow _ ?_ Rl
      rw [opow_mul, succ_eq_add_one, opow_add_one]
      gcongr
      exact No.snd'.repr_lt
    · rw [opow_mul]
      simpa using
        mul_le_mul_right (one_le_iff_pos.2 <| Nat.cast_pos'.2 n.pos) (ω0 ^ succ (k : Ordinal))
  · cases m
    · cases k <;> simp [R, opowAux]
    · rw [Nat.cast_add_one, add_mul_add_one]
      apply add_of_omega0_opow_le Rl
      rw [opow_mul, succ_eq_add_one, opow_add_one]
      gcongr
      simpa [repr] using omega0_le_oadd a0 n a'

name: repr_opow
statement: theorem repr_opow (o₁ o₂) [NF o₁] [NF o₂] : repr (o₁ ^ o₂) = repr o₁ ^ repr o₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases e₁ : split o₁ with ⟨a, m⟩
  obtain ⟨N₁, r₁⟩ := nf_repr_split e₁
  obtain - | ⟨a0, n, a'⟩ := a
  · rcases m with - | m
    · by_cases h : o₂ = 0
      · simp [opow_def, opowAux2, e₁, h, r₁]
      · simpa [opow_def, opowAux2, e₁, h, r₁, eqComm] using mt repr_inj.1 h
    · rcases e₂ : split' o₂ with ⟨b', k⟩
      obtain ⟨_, r₂⟩ := nf_repr_split' e₂
      by_cases h : m = 0
      · simp only [opowAux2, opow_def, e₁, h, r₁, r₂, OfNat.ofNat, Zero.zero, One.one,
          repr]
        simp [opow_add, opow_mul]
      simp only [opow_def, opowAux2, e₁, r₁, e₂, r₂, repr,
          Nat.cast_succ, _root_.zero_add, add_zero]
      rw [opow_add, opow_mul, opow_omega0 (by simpa [Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero])
        (by rw [← Nat.cast_succ, lt_omega0]; exact ⟨_, rfl⟩)]
      simp
  · have := N₁.fst
    have := N₁.snd
    obtain ⟨a00, ad⟩ := N₁.of_dvd_omega0 (split_dvd e₁)
    have al := split_add_lt e₁
    have aa : repr (a' + ofNat m) = repr a' + m := by simp
    rcases e₂ : split' o₂ with ⟨b', k⟩
    obtain ⟨_, r₂⟩ := nf_repr_split' e₂
    simp only [opow_def, e₁, r₁, split_eq_scale_split' e₂, opowAux2, repr]
    rcases k with - | k
    · simp [r₂, opow_mul, repr_opow_aux₁ a00 al aa, add_assoc]
    · simp_rw [r₂, mulNat_eq_mul, repr_add, repr_scale, repr_add, repr_mul, repr_scale, repr_one,
        Nat.cast_one, opow_one, opow_add, repr_ofNat, repr, Nat.cast_add_one, opow_add_one,
        add_assoc, opow_mul, opow_natCast, mul_assoc]
      rw [repr_opow_aux₁ a00 al aa, scale_opowAux]
      simp only [repr_mul, repr_scale, repr_one,
        Nat.cast_one, opow_one, opow_mul]
      rw [← mul_add, ← add_assoc ((ω : Ordinal.{0}) ^ repr a0 * (n : ℕ))]
      congr 1
      simpa [opow_natCast, pow_succ] using (repr_opow_aux₂ _ ad a00 al _ _).2

name: exists_lt_add
statement:
private theorem exists_lt_add {α} [hα : Nonempty α] {o : Ordinal} {f : α → Ordinal}
    (H : ∀ ⦃a⦄, a < o → ∃ i, a < f i) {b : Ordinal} ⦃a⦄ (h : a < b + o) : ∃ i, a < b + f i
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge a b with h | h'
  · obtain ⟨i⟩ := id hα
    exact ⟨i, h.trans_le le_self_add⟩
  · rw [← Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le h', add_lt_add_iff_left] at h
    refine (H h).imp fun i H => ?_
    rwa [← Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le h', add_lt_add_iff_left]

name: exists_lt_mul_omega0'
statement:
private theorem exists_lt_mul_omega0' {o : Ordinal} ⦃a⦄ (h : a < o * ω) :
    ∃ i : ℕ, a < o * ↑i + o
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, h'⟩ := (lt_mul_iff_of_isSuccLimit isSuccLimit_omega0).1 h
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := lt_omega0.1 hi
  exact ⟨i, h'.trans_le le_self_add⟩

name: exists_lt_omega0_opow'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, h'⟩ := (lt_opow_of_isSuccLimit (zero_lt_one.trans hb).ne' ho).1 h
  exact (H hd).imp fun i hi => h'.trans <| (opow_lt_opow_iff_right hb).2 hi

name: fundamentalSequenceProp_inl_none
statement:
theorem fundamentalSequenceProp_inl_none (o) :

name: fundamentalSequenceProp_inl_some
statement:
theorem fundamentalSequenceProp_inl_some (o a) :
    FundamentalSequenceProp o (Sum.inl (some a)) ↔ o.repr = succ a.repr ∧ (o.NF → a.NF)

name: fundamentalSequenceProp_inr
statement:
theorem fundamentalSequenceProp_inr (o f) :
    FundamentalSequenceProp o (Sum.inr f) ↔
      IsSuccLimit o.repr ∧
        (∀ i, f i < f (i + 1) ∧ f i < o ∧ (o.NF → (f i).NF)) ∧
        ∀ a, a < o.repr → ∃ i, a < (f i).repr

name: fundamentalSequence_has_prop
statement: theorem fundamentalSequence_has_prop (o) : FundamentalSequenceProp o (fundamentalSequence o)
proof:
:= by
  induction o with
  | zero => rfl
  | oadd a m b iha ihb
  rw [fundamentalSequence]
  rcases e : b.fundamentalSequence with (⟨_ | b'⟩ | f) <;>
    simp only [FundamentalSequenceProp] <;>
    rw [e, FundamentalSequenceProp] at ihb
  · rcases e : a.fundamentalSequence with (⟨_ | a'⟩ | f) <;> rcases e' : m.natPred with - | m' <;>
      simp only <;>
      rw [e, FundamentalSequenceProp] at iha <;>
      (try rw [show m = 1 by
            have := PNat.natPred_add_one m; rw [e'] at this; exact PNat.coe_inj.1 this.symm]) <;>
      (try rw [show m = (m' + 1).succPNat by
              rw [← e', ← PNat.coe_inj, Nat.succPNat_coe, ← Nat.add_one, PNat.natPred_add_one]]) <;>
      simp only [repr, repr_zero, iha, ihb, opow_lt_opow_iff_right one_lt_omega0,
        add_lt_add_iff_left, add_zero, lt_add_iff_pos_right, lt_def, mul_one, Nat.cast_zero,
        Nat.cast_succ, Nat.succPNat_coe, succ_eq_add_one, opow_add_one, opow_zero, mul_add_one,
        PNat.one_coe, _root_.zero_add, zero_def]
    · exact ⟨by simp, by decide⟩
    · exact ⟨trivial, inferInstance⟩
    · have := opow_pos (repr a') omega0_pos
      refine
        ⟨isSuccLimit_mul_right this isSuccLimit_omega0, fun i =>
          ⟨this, ?_, fun H => @NF.oadd_zero _ _ (iha.2 H.fst)⟩, exists_lt_mul_omega0'⟩
      rw [← mul_add_one, ← Nat.cast_add_one]
      gcongr; exact natCast_lt_omega0 _
    · have := opow_pos (repr a') omega0_pos
      refine
        ⟨isSuccLimit_add _ (isSuccLimit_mul_right this isSuccLimit_omega0), fun i => ⟨this, ?_, ?_⟩,
          exists_lt_add exists_lt_mul_omega0'⟩
      · rw [← mul_add_one, ← Nat.cast_add_one]
        gcongr; exact natCast_lt_omega0 _
      · refine fun H => H.fst.oadd _ (NF.below_of_lt' ?_ (@NF.oadd_zero _ _ (iha.2 H.fst)))
        rw [repr, repr_zero, add_zero, iha.1, succ_eq_add_one, opow_add_one]
        gcongr; exact natCast_lt_omega0 _
    · rcases iha with ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      refine ⟨isSuccLimit_opow one_lt_omega0 h1, fun i => ?_,
        exists_lt_omega0_opow' one_lt_omega0 h1 h3⟩
      exact ⟨(h2 i).1, (h2 i).2.1, fun H => @NF.oadd_zero _ _ ((h2 i).2.2 H.fst)⟩
    · rcases iha with ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
      refine
        ⟨isSuccLimit_add _ (isSuccLimit_opow one_lt_omega0 h1), fun i => ?_,
          exists_lt_add (exists_lt_omega0_opow' one_lt_omega0 h1 h3)⟩
      obtain ⟨h4, h5, h6⟩ := h2 i
      refine ⟨h4, h5, fun H => H.fst.oadd _ (NF.below_of_lt' ?_ (@NF.oadd_zero _ _ (h6 H.fst)))⟩
      rwa [repr, repr_zero, add_zero, PNat.one_coe, Nat.cast_one, mul_one,
        opow_lt_opow_iff_right one_lt_omega0]
  · refine ⟨?_, fun H ↦ H.fst.oadd _ (NF.below_of_lt' ?_ (ihb.2 H.snd))⟩
    · rw [repr, ihb.1, succ_eq_add_one, succ_eq_add_one, ← add_assoc, repr]
    have := H.snd'.repr_lt
    rw [ihb.1] at this
    exact (lt_succ _).trans this
  · rcases ihb with ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩
    simp only [repr]
    exact
      ⟨isSuccLimit_add _ h1, fun i =>
        ⟨oadd_lt_oadd_3 (h2 i).1, oadd_lt_oadd_3 (h2 i).2.1, fun H =>
          H.fst.oadd _ (NF.below_of_lt' (lt_trans (h2 i).2.1 H.snd'.repr_lt) ((h2 i).2.2 H.snd))⟩,
        exists_lt_add h3⟩

name: fastGrowing_def
statement:
theorem fastGrowing_def {o : ONote} {x} (e : fundamentalSequence o = x) :
    fastGrowing o =
      match
        (motive := (x : Option ONote ⊕ (ℕ → ONote)) → FundamentalSequenceProp o x → ℕ → ℕ)
        x, e ▸ fundamentalSequence_has_prop o with
      | Sum.inl none, _ => Nat.succ
      | Sum.inl (some a), _ =>
        fun i => (fastGrowing a)^[i] i
      | Sum.inr f, _ => fun i =>
        fastGrowing (f i) i

    fastGrowing o = Nat.succ

name: fastGrowing_succ
statement:
theorem fastGrowing_succ (o) {a} (h : fundamentalSequence o = Sum.inl (some a)) :
    fastGrowing o = fun i => (fastGrowing a)^[i] i

name: fastGrowing_limit
statement:
theorem fastGrowing_limit (o) {f} (h : fundamentalSequence o = Sum.inr f) :
    fastGrowing o = fun i => fastGrowing (f i) i

name: fastGrowing_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fastGrowing_zero : fastGrowing 0 = Nat.succ

name: fastGrowing_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fastGrowing_one : fastGrowing 1 = fun n => 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  rw [@fastGrowing_succ 1 0 rfl]; funext i; rw [two_mul, fastGrowing_zero]
  exact Nat.succ_iterate _ _

name: fastGrowing
statement: theorem fastGrowingε₀_two : fastGrowingε₀ 2 = 2048
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [fastGrowingε₀, show oadd 0 1 0 = 1 from rfl, @fastGrowing_limit (oadd 1 1 0) _ rfl,
    show oadd 0 (2 : Nat).succPNat 0 = 3 from rfl, @fastGrowing_succ 3 2 rfl]

@[simp]
theorem ord_univ : ord univ.{u, v} = Ordinal.univ.{u, v}
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (ord_card_le _) <| le_of_forall_lt fun o h => lt_ord.2 ?_
  have := Ordinal.liftPrincipalSeg.mem_range_of_rel_top (by simpa using h)
  rcases this with ⟨o, h'⟩
  rw [← h', Ordinal.liftPrincipalSeg_coe, ← Ordinal.lift_card]
