name: lt_univ
statement: theorem lt_univ {c} : c < univ.{u, u + 1} ↔ ∃ c', c = lift.{u + 1, u} c'
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    have := ord_lt_ord.2 h
    rw [ord_univ] at this
    obtain ⟨o, e⟩ := Ordinal.liftPrincipalSeg.mem_range_of_rel_top (by simpa)
    have := card_ord c
    rw [← e, Ordinal.liftPrincipalSeg_coe, ← Ordinal.lift_card] at this
    exact ⟨_, this.symm⟩, fun ⟨_, e⟩ => e.symm ▸ lift_lt_univ _⟩

name: lt_univ'
statement: theorem lt_univ' {c} : c < univ.{u, v} ↔ ∃ c', c = lift.{max (u + 1) v, u} c'
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    let ⟨a, h', e⟩ := lt_lift_iff.1 h
    rw [mk_ordinal] at h'
    rcases lt_univ.{u}.1 h' with ⟨c', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c', by simp only [e.symm, lift_lift]⟩, fun ⟨_, e⟩ => e.symm ▸ lift_lt_univ' _⟩

name: IsStrongLimit.univ
statement: theorem IsStrongLimit.univ : IsStrongLimit univ.{u, v}
proof:
:=
  ⟨univ_ne_zero, fun c h ↦ let ⟨w, h⟩ := lt_univ'.1 h; lt_univ'.2 ⟨2 ^ w, by simp [h]⟩⟩

name: small_iff_lift_mk_lt_univ
statement:
theorem small_iff_lift_mk_lt_univ {α : Type u} :
    Small.{v} α ↔ lift.{v + 1, u} #α < univ.{v, max u (v + 1)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_univ']
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨β, e⟩
    exact ⟨#β, lift_mk_eq.{u, _, v + 1}.2 e⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact ⟨⟨c.out, lift_mk_eq.{u, _, v + 1}.1 (hc.trans (congr rfl c.mk_out.symm))⟩⟩

name: small_of_lift_mk_le_lift
statement:
theorem small_of_lift_mk_le_lift {α : Type u} {c : Cardinal.{v}}
    (hα : lift.{v} #α ≤ lift.{u} c) : Small.{v} α
proof:
:= by
  induction c using inductionOn with | mk α
  exact small_of_injective (lift_mk_le'.1 hα).some.injective

name: small_iff_exists_lift_mk_le_lift
statement:
theorem small_iff_exists_lift_mk_le_lift {α : Type u} :
    Small.{v} α ↔ ∃ c : Cardinal.{v}, lift.{v} #α ≤ lift.{u} c

name: rec_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rec_zero {C : Ordinal → Sort*} (b : Ordinal) (H0 : C 0)
    (H : ∀ o, o ≠ 0 → C (o % b ^ log b o) → C o) : CNF.rec b H0 H 0 = H0

name: rec_pos
statement:
theorem rec_pos (b : Ordinal) {o : Ordinal} {C : Ordinal → Sort*} (ho : o ≠ 0) (H0 : C 0)
    (H : ∀ o, o ≠ 0 → C (o % b ^ log b o) → C o) :
    CNF.rec b H0 H o = H o ho (@CNF.rec b C H0 H _)

name: zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_right (b : Ordinal) : CNF b 0 = []

name: ne_zero
statement:
protected theorem ne_zero {b o : Ordinal} (ho : o ≠ 0) :
    CNF b o = (log b o, o / b ^ log b o)::CNF b (o % b ^ log b o)

name: opow_mul_add
proof:
:= by
  have hb' := hb.ne_bot
  rw [CNF.ne_zero]
  · rw [log_opow_mul_add hb hx hy, log_eq_zero hxb, add_zero,
      mul_add_div _ (opow_ne_zero _ hb'), Ordinal.div_eq_zero_of_lt hy, add_zero,
      mul_add_mod_self, mod_eq_of_lt hy]
  · simp_all

name: zero_left
statement: protected theorem zero_left {o : Ordinal} (ho : o ≠ 0) : CNF 0 o = [(0, o)]

name: one_left
statement: protected theorem one_left {o : Ordinal} (ho : o ≠ 0) : CNF 1 o = [(0, o)]

name: of_le_one
statement: protected theorem of_le_one {b o : Ordinal} (hb : b ≤ 1) (ho : o ≠ 0) : CNF b o = [(0, o)]
proof:
:= by
  rcases Order.le_one_iff.1 hb with (rfl | rfl)
  exacts [CNF.zero_left ho, CNF.one_left ho]

name: of_lt
statement: protected theorem of_lt {b o : Ordinal} (ho : o ≠ 0) (hb : o < b) : CNF b o = [(0, o)]
proof:
:= by
  rw [CNF.ne_zero ho, log_eq_zero hb, opow_zero, div_one, mod_one, zero_right]

name: foldr
statement: protected theorem foldr (b o : Ordinal) : (CNF b o).foldr (fun p r ↦ b ^ p.1 * p.2 + r) 0 = o
proof:
:= by
  refine CNF.rec b ?_ ?_ o
  · rw [zero_right, foldr_nil]
  · intro o ho IH
    rw [CNF.ne_zero ho, foldr_cons, IH, div_add_mod]

name: fst_le_log
statement: theorem fst_le_log {b o : Ordinal.{u}} {x : Ordinal × Ordinal} : x ∈ CNF b o → x.1 ≤ log b o
proof:
:= by
  refine CNF.rec b ?_ (fun o ho H ↦ ?_) o
  · simp
  · rw [CNF.ne_zero ho, mem_cons]
    rintro (rfl | h)
    · rfl
    · exact (H h).trans (log_mono_right _ (mod_opow_log_lt_self b ho).le)

name: snd_pos
statement: theorem snd_pos {b o : Ordinal.{u}} {x : Ordinal × Ordinal} : x ∈ CNF b o → 0 < x.2
proof:
:= by
  refine CNF.rec b (by simp) (fun o ho IH ↦ ?_) o
  rw [CNF.ne_zero ho]
  rintro (h | ⟨_, h⟩)
  · exact div_opow_log_pos b ho
  · exact IH h

name: snd_lt
statement:
theorem snd_lt {b o : Ordinal.{u}} (hb : 1 < b) {x : Ordinal × Ordinal} :
    x ∈ CNF b o → x.2 < b
proof:
:= by
  refine CNF.rec b ?_ (fun o ho IH ↦ ?_) o
  · simp
  · rw [CNF.ne_zero ho]
    intro h
    obtain rfl | h := mem_cons.mp h
    · exact div_opow_log_lt o hb
    · exact IH h

name: sortedGT
statement: protected theorem sortedGT (b o : Ordinal) : ((CNF b o).map Prod.fst).SortedGT
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [sortedGT_iff_pairwise]
  refine CNF.rec b ?_ (fun o ho IH ↦ ?_) o
  · rw [zero_right]
    exact .nil
  · rcases le_or_gt b 1 with hb | hb
    · rw [CNF.of_le_one hb ho]
      exact pairwise_singleton _ _
    · obtain hob | hbo := lt_or_ge o b
      · rw [CNF.of_lt ho hob]
        exact pairwise_singleton _ _
      · rw [CNF.ne_zero ho, map_cons, pairwise_cons]
        refine ⟨fun a H ↦ ?_, IH⟩
        rw [mem_map] at H
        rcases H with ⟨⟨a, a'⟩, H, rfl⟩
        exact (fst_le_log H).trans_lt (log_mod_opow_log_lt_log_self hb hbo)

name: nodupKeys
statement: private theorem nodupKeys (b o : Ordinal) : (map Prod.toSigma (CNF b o)).NodupKeys
proof:
:= by
  rw [NodupKeys, List.keys, map_map, Prod.fst_comp_toSigma]
  exact (CNF.sortedGT ..).nodup

name: support_coeff
statement:
theorem support_coeff (b o : Ordinal) :
    (coeff b o).support = ((CNF b o).map Prod.fst).toFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff, lookupFinsupp_support, filter_eq_self.2]
  · simp [List.keys]
  · simp_rw [mem_map]
    rintro _ ⟨a, ⟨ha, rfl⟩⟩
    simpa using (snd_pos ha).ne'

name: coeff_of_mem_CNF
statement:
theorem coeff_of_mem_CNF {b o e c : Ordinal} (h : ⟨e, c⟩ ∈ CNF b o) :
    coeff b o e = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeff, lookupFinsupp_apply, mem_lookup_iff.2, Option.getD_some]
  simpa

name: coeff_of_notMem_CNF
statement:
theorem coeff_of_notMem_CNF {b o e : Ordinal} (h : e ∉ (CNF b o).map Prod.fst) :
    coeff b o e = 0

name: coeff_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_lt {b o e : Ordinal} (h : o < b ^ e) : coeff b o e = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply coeff_of_notMem_CNF
  intro he
  rw [mem_map] at he
  obtain ⟨⟨e, c⟩, he, rfl⟩ := he
  obtain rfl | he' := eq_or_ne e 0
  · simp_all
  · exact (opow_le_of_le_log he' (fst_le_log he)).not_gt h

name: coeff_zero_apply
statement: theorem coeff_zero_apply (b e : Ordinal) : coeff b 0 e = 0

name: coeff_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_zero_right (b : Ordinal) : coeff b 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext e
  exact coeff_zero_apply b e

name: coeff_of_le_one
statement: theorem coeff_of_le_one {b : Ordinal} (hb : b ≤ 1) (o : Ordinal) : coeff b o = single 0 o
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  obtain rfl | ho := eq_or_ne o 0
  · simp
  · obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a 0
    · apply coeff_of_mem_CNF
      rw [CNF.of_le_one hb ho]
      simp
    · rw [single_eq_of_ne ha]
      apply coeff_of_notMem_CNF
      rw [CNF.of_le_one hb ho]
      simpa using ha

name: coeff_zero_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_zero_left (o : Ordinal) : coeff 0 o = single 0 o

name: coeff_one_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_one_left (o : Ordinal) : coeff 1 o = single 0 o

name: coeff_opow_mul_add
proof:
:= by
  ext e'
  rw [add_apply]
  obtain rfl | he := eq_or_ne e e'
  · rw [single_eq_same, coeff_eq_zero_of_lt hy, add_zero]
    apply coeff_of_mem_CNF
    rw [CNF.opow_mul_add hb hx hxb hy]
    exact mem_cons_self
  · rw [single_eq_of_ne' he, zero_add]
    by_cases h : e' ∈ (CNF b y).map Prod.fst
    · rw [mem_map] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨f, c⟩, hf, rfl⟩ := h
      rw [coeff_of_mem_CNF hf]
      apply coeff_of_mem_CNF
      rw [CNF.opow_mul_add hb hx hxb hy]
      exact mem_cons_of_mem _ hf
    · rw [coeff_of_notMem_CNF h, coeff_of_notMem_CNF]
      rw [mem_map] at h ⊢
      rw [CNF.opow_mul_add hb hx hxb hy]
      simp_all

name: eval_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_zero_right (b : Ordinal) : eval b 0 = 0

name: eval_single_add'
statement:
theorem eval_single_add' (b : Ordinal) {e x : Ordinal} {f : Ordinal →₀ Ordinal}
    (h : ∀ e' ∈ f.support, e' < e) : eval b (.single e x + f) = b ^ e * x + eval b f
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx := eq_or_ne x 0; · simp
  have hf : f e = 0 := by
    rw [← notMem_support_iff]
    exact fun he ↦ (h e he).false
  rw [eval, support_single_add (by simpa) hx, Finset.sort_cons]
  · simp only [add_apply, foldr_cons, single_eq_same, hf, add_zero, add_right_inj]
    apply foldr_ext
    intro e' he' _
    congr
    rw [single_eq_of_ne, zero_add]
    aesop
  · exact fun e' he' ↦ (h e' he').le

name: eval_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_single (b e x : Ordinal) : eval b (.single e x) = b ^ e * x

name: eval_single_add
statement:
theorem eval_single_add (b : Ordinal) {e x : Ordinal} {f : Ordinal →₀ Ordinal}
    (h : ∀ e' ∈ f.support, e' ≤ e) : eval b (.single e x + f) = b ^ e * x + eval b f
proof:
:= by
  cases f using Finsupp.induction_on_max with
  | zero => simp
  | single_add e' y f hf hy =>
    obtain rfl | he' := (h e' (by simp [hy])).eq_or_lt
    · simp only [← add_assoc, ← single_add, eval_single_add' _ hf, mul_add]
    · rw [eval_single_add']
      refine fun a ha ↦ (h a ha).lt_of_ne ?_
      rintro rfl
      apply (hf a _).not_gt he'
      simpa [he'.ne'] using ha

name: eval_add
proof:
:= by
  induction f₁ using Finsupp.induction_on_max with
  | zero => simp
  | single_add e₁ x f₁ hf₁ hx IH =>
    rw [add_assoc, eval_single_add, eval_single_add' _ hf₁, IH, add_assoc]
    · simp_all
    · intro e₂ he₂
      obtain he₂ | he₂ := Finset.mem_union.1 <| support_add he₂
      · exact (hf₁ _ he₂).le
      · apply h _ _ _ he₂
        simp_all

name: eval_lt
statement:
theorem eval_lt {b e : Ordinal} {f : Ordinal →₀ Ordinal}
    (hb : ∀ e', f e' < b) (he : ∀ e' ∈ f.support, e' < e) : eval b f < b ^ e
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_on_max generalizing e with
  | zero =>
    rw [eval_zero_right]
    exact opow_pos _ (hb 0)
  | single_add e' x f hf hx IH =>
    have he' : e' ∉ f.support := fun h ↦ (hf _ h).false
    rw [eval_single_add' _ hf]
    apply opow_mul_add_lt_opow _ (IH _ hf)
    · apply he e' _
      simp [hx]
    · apply (hb e').trans_eq'
      rw [add_apply, single_eq_same, notMem_support_iff.1, add_zero]
      exact fun h ↦ (hf _ h).false
    · intro a
      by_cases ha : a ∈ f.support
      · apply (hb a).trans_eq'
        rw [add_apply, single_eq_of_ne, zero_add]
        rintro rfl
        contradiction
      · rw [notMem_support_iff.1 ha]
        exact (hb 0).pos

name: eval_coeff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eval_coeff (b o : Ordinal) : eval b (coeff b o) = o
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← CNF.foldr b o]
  rw [eval, support_coeff, (toFinset_sort _ _).2, foldr_map]
  · apply foldr_ext
    intro a ha x
    rw [coeff_of_mem_CNF ha]
  · exact (CNF.sortedGT b o).sortedGE.pairwise
  · exact (CNF.sortedGT b o).nodup

name: coeff_eval
statement:
theorem coeff_eval {b : Ordinal} (hb : 1 < b) {f : Ordinal →₀ Ordinal} (hf : ∀ e, f e < b) :
    coeff b (eval b f) = f
proof:
:= by
  induction f using Finsupp.induction_on_max with
  | zero => simp
  | single_add e x f hf' hx IH =>
    have IH' (e') : f e' < b := by
      by_cases he' : e' ∈ f.support
      · apply (hf e').trans_eq'
        rw [add_apply, single_eq_of_ne, zero_add]
        exact (hf' _ he').ne
      · rw [notMem_support_iff.1 he']
        exact hb.pos
    rw [eval_single_add' _ hf', coeff_opow_mul_add hb hx, IH IH']
    · apply (hf e).trans_eq'
      rw [add_apply, single_eq_same, notMem_support_iff.1, add_zero]
      exact fun h ↦ (hf' _ h).false
    · exact eval_lt IH' hf'

name: coeff_injective
statement: theorem coeff_injective (b : Ordinal) : Function.Injective (coeff b)

name: coeff_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_inj {b x y : Ordinal} : coeff b x = coeff b y ↔ x = y

name: isPrincipal_swap_iff
statement: theorem isPrincipal_swap_iff : IsPrincipal (Function.swap op) o ↔ IsPrincipal op o
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> exact fun h a b ha hb => h hb ha

name: not_isPrincipal_iff
statement: theorem not_isPrincipal_iff : ¬ IsPrincipal op o ↔ ∃ a < o, ∃ b < o, o ≤ op a b

name: isPrincipal_iff_of_monotone
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_iff_of_monotone
    (h₁ : ∀ a, Monotone (op a)) (h₂ : ∀ a, Monotone (Function.swap op a)) :
    IsPrincipal op o ↔ ∀ a < o, op a a < o
proof:
:= by
  use fun h a ha => h ha ha
  intro H a b ha hb
  obtain hab | hba := le_or_gt a b
  · exact (h₂ b hab).trans_lt <| H b hb
  · exact (h₁ a hba.le).trans_lt <| H a ha

name: not_isPrincipal_iff_of_monotone
statement:
theorem not_isPrincipal_iff_of_monotone
    (h₁ : ∀ a, Monotone (op a)) (h₂ : ∀ a, Monotone (Function.swap op a)) :
    ¬ IsPrincipal op o ↔ ∃ a < o, o ≤ op a a

name: isPrincipal_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma isPrincipal_zero : IsPrincipal op 0

name: isPrincipal_one_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem isPrincipal_one_iff : IsPrincipal op 1 ↔ op 0 0 = 0

name: IsPrincipal.iterate_lt
statement:
theorem IsPrincipal.iterate_lt (hao : a < o) (ho : IsPrincipal op o) (n : ℕ) :
    (op a)^[n] a < o
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rwa [Function.iterate_zero]
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ']
    exact ho hao hn

name: op_eq_self_of_isPrincipal
statement:
theorem op_eq_self_of_isPrincipal (hao : a < o) (H : IsNormal (op a))
    (ho : IsPrincipal op o) (ho' : IsSuccLimit o) : op a o = o
proof:
:= by
  apply H.strictMono.le_apply.antisymm'
  rw [H.apply_of_isSuccLimit ho', Ordinal.iSup_le_iff]
  exact fun ⟨b, hbo⟩ ↦ (ho hao hbo).le

name: nfp_le_of_isPrincipal
statement: theorem nfp_le_of_isPrincipal (hao : a < o) (ho : IsPrincipal op o) : nfp (op a) a ≤ o

name: IsPrincipal.sSup
statement:
protected theorem IsPrincipal.sSup {s : Set Ordinal} (H : ∀ x ∈ s, IsPrincipal op x) :
    IsPrincipal op (sSup s)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsPrincipal op (sSup ∅) := by simp
  by_cases hs : BddAbove s
  · obtain rfl | hs' := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty
    · assumption
    simp only [IsPrincipal, lt_csSup_iff hs hs', forall_exists_index, and_imp]
    intro x y a has ha b hbs hb
    have h : max a b ∈ s := max_rec' _ has hbs
    exact ⟨_, h, H (max a b) h (lt_max_of_lt_left ha) (lt_max_of_lt_right hb)⟩
  · rwa [csSup_of_not_bddAbove hs]

name: IsPrincipal.iSup
statement:
protected theorem IsPrincipal.iSup {ι} {f : ι → Ordinal} (H : ∀ i, IsPrincipal op (f i)) :
    IsPrincipal op (⨆ i, f i)

name: isPrincipal_nfp_iSup
statement:
private theorem isPrincipal_nfp_iSup (op : Ordinal → Ordinal → Ordinal) (o : Ordinal) :
    IsPrincipal op (nfp (fun x ↦ ⨆ y : Set.Iio x ×ˢ Set.Iio x, succ (op y.1.1 y.1.2)) o)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b ha hb
  rw [lt_nfp_iff] at *
  obtain ⟨m, ha⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨n, hb⟩ := hb
  obtain h | h := le_total
    ((fun x ↦ ⨆ y : Set.Iio x ×ˢ Set.Iio x, succ (op y.1.1 y.1.2))^[m] o)
    ((fun x ↦ ⨆ y : Set.Iio x ×ˢ Set.Iio x, succ (op y.1.1 y.1.2))^[n] o)
  · use n + 1
    rw [Function.iterate_succ']
    apply (lt_succ _).trans_le
    exact Ordinal.le_iSup (fun y : Set.Iio _ ×ˢ Set.Iio _ ↦ succ (op y.1.1 y.1.2))
      ⟨_, Set.mk_mem_prod (ha.trans_le h) hb⟩
  · use m + 1
    rw [Function.iterate_succ']
    apply (lt_succ _).trans_le
    exact Ordinal.le_iSup (fun y : Set.Iio _ ×ˢ Set.Iio _ ↦ succ (op y.1.1 y.1.2))
      ⟨_, Set.mk_mem_prod ha (hb.trans_le h)⟩

name: not_bddAbove_setOfPred_isPrincipal
statement:
theorem not_bddAbove_setOfPred_isPrincipal (op : Ordinal → Ordinal → Ordinal) :
    ¬ BddAbove { o | IsPrincipal op o }
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
  exact ((le_nfp _ _).trans (ha (isPrincipal_nfp_iSup op (succ a)))).not_gt (lt_succ a)

name: isPrincipal_add_iff_add_self_lt
statement: theorem isPrincipal_add_iff_add_self_lt : IsPrincipal (· + ·) a ↔ ∀ b < a, b + b < a
proof:
:=
  isPrincipal_iff_of_monotone
    (fun x _ _ h ↦ add_le_add_right h x) (fun x _ _ h ↦ add_le_add_left h x)

name: IsPrincipal.mul_natCast_lt
statement:
theorem IsPrincipal.mul_natCast_lt (ho : IsPrincipal (· + ·) o) (ha : a < o) (n : ℕ) :
    a * n < o
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using ha.pos
  | succ n h =>
    rw [Nat.cast_add_one, mul_add_one]
    exact ho h ha

name: isPrincipal_add_one
statement: theorem isPrincipal_add_one : IsPrincipal (· + ·) 1

name: isPrincipal_add_of_le_one
statement: theorem isPrincipal_add_of_le_one (ho : o ≤ 1) : IsPrincipal (· + ·) o
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_one_iff.1 ho with (rfl | rfl)
  · exact isPrincipal_zero
  · exact isPrincipal_add_one

name: isSuccLimit_of_isPrincipal_add
statement:
theorem isSuccLimit_of_isPrincipal_add (ho₁ : 1 < o) (ho : IsPrincipal (· + ·) o) :
    IsSuccLimit o
proof:
:= by
  rw [isSuccLimit_iff, isSuccPrelimit_iff_succ_lt]
  exact ⟨ho₁.ne_bot, fun _ ha ↦ ho ha ho₁⟩

name: isPrincipal_add_iff_add_left_eq_self
statement: theorem isPrincipal_add_iff_add_left_eq_self : IsPrincipal (· + ·) o ↔ ∀ a < o, a + o = o
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ho a hao => ?_, fun h a b hao hbo => ?_⟩
  · rcases lt_or_ge 1 o with ho₁ | ho₁
    · exact op_eq_self_of_isPrincipal hao (isNormal_add_right a) ho
        (isSuccLimit_of_isPrincipal_add ho₁ ho)
    · cases le_one_iff.1 ho₁ <;> simp_all
  · rw [← h a hao]
    exact (isNormal_add_right a).strictMono hbo

name: IsPrincipal.add_eq_right
statement: theorem IsPrincipal.add_eq_right (ho : IsPrincipal (· + ·) o) (ha : a < o) : a + o = o

name: IsPrincipal.add_eq_right_of_le
statement:
theorem IsPrincipal.add_eq_right_of_le (hb : IsPrincipal (· + ·) b)
    (hab : a < b) (hbc : b ≤ c) : a + c = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le hbc, ← add_assoc, hb.add_eq_right hab,
    Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le hbc]

name: exists_lt_add_of_not_isPrincipal_add
statement:
theorem exists_lt_add_of_not_isPrincipal_add (ha : ¬ IsPrincipal (· + ·) a) :
    ∃ b < a, ∃ c < a, b + c = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [not_isPrincipal_iff] at ha
  rcases ha with ⟨b, hb, c, hc, H⟩
  refine
    ⟨b, hb, _, lt_of_le_of_ne (sub_le_self a b) fun hab => ?_, Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le hb.le⟩
  rw [← sub_le, hab] at H
  exact H.not_gt hc

name: isPrincipal_add_iff_add_lt_ne_self
statement: theorem isPrincipal_add_iff_add_lt_ne_self : IsPrincipal (· + ·) a ↔ ∀ b < a, ∀ c < a, b + c ≠ a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ha _ hb _ hc => (ha hb hc).ne, fun H => by
    by_contra ha
    rcases exists_lt_add_of_not_isPrincipal_add ha with ⟨b, hb, c, hc, rfl⟩
    exact (H b hb c hc).irrefl⟩

name: isPrincipal_add_omega0
statement: theorem isPrincipal_add_omega0 : IsPrincipal (· + ·) ω

name: add_of_omega0_le
statement: theorem add_of_omega0_le : a < ω → ω ≤ b → a + b = b

name: isPrincipal_add_omega0_opow
statement: theorem isPrincipal_add_omega0_opow (o : Ordinal) : IsPrincipal (· + ·) (ω ^ o)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha' := eq_or_ne o 0
  · rw [opow_zero, isPrincipal_one_iff, add_zero]
  · rw [isPrincipal_add_iff_add_self_lt]
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨c, hc, m, hm⟩ := (lt_omega0_opow ha').1 ha
    apply (add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt hm.le hm).trans_le
    rw [← mul_add, ← Nat.cast_add]
    exact (opow_mul_lt_opow (natCast_lt_omega0 _) hc).le

name: add_omega0_opow
statement: theorem add_omega0_opow (h : a < ω ^ b) : a + ω ^ b = ω ^ b

name: add_of_omega0_opow_le
statement: theorem add_of_omega0_opow_le (h₁ : a < ω ^ b) (h₂ : ω ^ b ≤ c) : a + c = c

name: isLeast_sub_lt_omega0_opow_log
statement: theorem isLeast_sub_lt_omega0_opow_log (h : a ≠ 0) : IsLeast {b | a - b < a} (ω ^ log ω a)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨sub_omega0_opow_log_lt h, fun c (hc : a - _ < _) ↦ ?_⟩
  contrapose! hc
  exact le_sub_of_add_le (add_of_omega0_opow_le hc (opow_log_le_self ω h)).le

name: isPrincipal_add_iff_zero_or_omega0_opow
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_add_iff_zero_or_omega0_opow :
    IsPrincipal (· + ·) o ↔ o = 0 ∨ o ∈ Set.range (ω ^ · : Ordinal → Ordinal)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [or_iff_not_imp_left]
    refine fun H ho ↦ ⟨log ω o, (opow_log_le_self ω ho).eq_of_not_lt ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := lt_omega0_opow_succ.1 (lt_opow_succ_log_self one_lt_omega0 o)
    exact fun h ↦ hn.not_gt <| H.mul_natCast_lt h n
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨a, rfl⟩)
    exacts [isPrincipal_zero, isPrincipal_add_omega0_opow a]

name: isPrincipal_add_opow_of_isPrincipal_add
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_add_opow_of_isPrincipal_add {a} (ha : IsPrincipal (· + ·) a) (b : Ordinal) :
    IsPrincipal (· + ·) (a ^ b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases isPrincipal_add_iff_zero_or_omega0_opow.1 ha with (rfl | ⟨c, rfl⟩)
  · rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb)
    · rw [opow_zero]
      exact isPrincipal_add_one
    · rwa [zero_opow hb]
  · rw [← opow_mul]
    exact isPrincipal_add_omega0_opow _

name: isPrincipal_add_mul_of_isPrincipal_add
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_add_mul_of_isPrincipal_add (a : Ordinal.{u}) {b : Ordinal.{u}} (hb₁ : b ≠ 1)
    (hb : IsPrincipal (· + ·) b) : IsPrincipal (· + ·) (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_pos a with (rfl | _)
  · rw [zero_mul]
    exact isPrincipal_zero
  · rcases eq_zero_or_pos b with (rfl | hb₁')
    · rw [mul_zero]
      exact isPrincipal_zero
    · rw [← one_le_iff_pos] at hb₁'
      intro c d hc hd
      rw [lt_mul_iff_of_isSuccLimit
        (isSuccLimit_of_isPrincipal_add (lt_of_le_of_ne hb₁' hb₁.symm) hb)] at *
      rcases hc with ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩
      rcases hd with ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩
      use x + y, hb hx hy
      rw [mul_add]
      exact Left.add_lt_add hx' hy'

name: isPrincipal_mul_one
statement: theorem isPrincipal_mul_one : IsPrincipal (· * ·) 1

name: isPrincipal_mul_two
statement: theorem isPrincipal_mul_two : IsPrincipal (· * ·) 2
proof:
:= by
  intro a b ha hb
  rw [lt_two_iff] at *
  simpa using mul_le_mul' ha hb

name: isPrincipal_mul_of_le_two
statement: theorem isPrincipal_mul_of_le_two (ho : o ≤ 2) : IsPrincipal (· * ·) o
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | rfl | rfl := le_two_iff.1 ho
  exacts [isPrincipal_zero, isPrincipal_mul_one, isPrincipal_mul_two]

name: isPrincipal_add_of_isPrincipal_mul
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_add_of_isPrincipal_mul (ho : IsPrincipal (· * ·) o) (ho₂ : o ≠ 2) :
    IsPrincipal (· + ·) o
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ho₂ with ho₁ | ho₂
  · exact isPrincipal_add_of_le_one <| lt_two_iff.mp ho₁
  · simp_rw [isPrincipal_add_iff_add_self_lt, ← Ordinal.mul_two]
    exact fun a ha ↦ ho ha ho₂

name: isSuccLimit_of_isPrincipal_mul
statement: theorem isSuccLimit_of_isPrincipal_mul (ho₂ : 2 < o) (ho : IsPrincipal (· * ·) o) : IsSuccLimit o

name: isPrincipal_mul_iff_mul_left_eq
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_mul_iff_mul_left_eq :
    IsPrincipal (· * ·) o ↔ ∀ a, 0 < a → a < o → a * o = o
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h a ha₀ hao => ?_, fun h a b hao hbo => ?_⟩
  · rcases le_or_gt o 2 with ho | ho
    · convert! one_mul o
      apply le_antisymm
      · rw [← lt_add_one_iff, one_add_one_eq_two]
        exact hao.trans_le ho
      · rwa [one_le_iff_pos]
    · exact op_eq_self_of_isPrincipal hao (isNormal_mul_right ha₀) h
        (isSuccLimit_of_isPrincipal_mul ho h)
  · rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha)
    · dsimp only; rwa [zero_mul]
    rw [← pos_iff_ne_zero] at ha
    rw [← h a ha hao]
    exact (isNormal_mul_right ha).strictMono hbo

name: isPrincipal_mul_omega0
statement: theorem isPrincipal_mul_omega0 : IsPrincipal (· * ·) ω
proof:
:= fun a b ha hb =>
  match a, b, lt_omega0.1 ha, lt_omega0.1 hb with
  | _, _, ⟨m, rfl⟩, ⟨n, rfl⟩ => by
    dsimp only; rw [← natCast_mul]
    apply natCast_lt_omega0

name: mul_omega0
statement: theorem mul_omega0 (a0 : 0 < a) (ha : a < ω) : a * ω = ω

name: natCast_mul_omega0
statement: theorem natCast_mul_omega0 {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : n * ω = ω

name: mul_lt_omega0_opow
statement: theorem mul_lt_omega0_opow (c0 : 0 < c) (ha : a < ω ^ c) (hb : b < ω) : a * b < ω ^ c
proof:
:= by
  rcases zero_or_succ_or_isSuccLimit c with (rfl | ⟨c, rfl⟩ | l)
  · exact (lt_irrefl _).elim c0
  · rw [succ_eq_add_one, opow_add_one] at ha
    obtain ⟨n, hn, an⟩ :=
      ((isNormal_mul_right <| opow_pos _ omega0_pos).lt_iff_exists_lt isSuccLimit_omega0).1 ha
    grw [an, succ_eq_add_one, opow_add_one, mul_assoc]
    gcongr
    exacts [opow_pos _ omega0_pos, isPrincipal_mul_omega0 hn hb]
  · rcases ((isNormal_opow one_lt_omega0).lt_iff_exists_lt l).1 ha with ⟨x, hx, ax⟩
    refine (mul_le_mul' (le_of_lt ax) (le_of_lt hb)).trans_lt ?_
    rw [← opow_add_one, opow_lt_opow_iff_right one_lt_omega0]
    exact l.succ_lt hx

name: mul_omega0_opow_opow
statement: theorem mul_omega0_opow_opow (a0 : 0 < a) (h : a < ω ^ ω ^ b) : a * ω ^ ω ^ b = ω ^ ω ^ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | b0 := eq_or_ne b 0
  · rw [opow_zero, opow_one] at h ⊢
    exact mul_omega0 a0 h
  · apply le_antisymm
    · obtain ⟨x, xb, ax⟩ :=
        (lt_opow_of_isSuccLimit omega0_ne_zero (isSuccLimit_opow_left isSuccLimit_omega0 b0)).1 h
      grw [ax, ← opow_add, add_omega0_opow xb]
    · conv_lhs => rw [← one_mul (ω ^ _)]
      grw [one_le_iff_pos.2 a0]

name: isPrincipal_mul_omega0_opow_opow
statement: theorem isPrincipal_mul_omega0_opow_opow (o : Ordinal) : IsPrincipal (· * ·) (ω ^ ω ^ o)

name: isPrincipal_add_of_isPrincipal_mul_opow
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_add_of_isPrincipal_mul_opow (hb : 1 < b) (ho : IsPrincipal (· * ·) (b ^ o)) :
    IsPrincipal (· + ·) o
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hx hy
  have := ho ((opow_lt_opow_iff_right hb).2 hx) ((opow_lt_opow_iff_right hb).2 hy)
  dsimp only at *
  rwa [← opow_add, opow_lt_opow_iff_right hb] at this

name: isPrincipal_mul_iff_le_two_or_omega0_opow_opow
statement:
theorem isPrincipal_mul_iff_le_two_or_omega0_opow_opow :
    IsPrincipal (· * ·) o ↔ o ≤ 2 ∨ o ∈ Set.range (ω ^ ω ^ · : Ordinal → Ordinal)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ho => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases le_or_gt o 2 with ho₂ | ho₂
    · exact Or.inl ho₂
    · rcases isPrincipal_add_iff_zero_or_omega0_opow.1
        (isPrincipal_add_of_isPrincipal_mul ho ho₂.ne') with (rfl | ⟨a, rfl⟩)
      · exact (not_lt_zero ho₂).elim
      · rcases isPrincipal_add_iff_zero_or_omega0_opow.1
          (isPrincipal_add_of_isPrincipal_mul_opow one_lt_omega0 ho) with (rfl | ⟨b, rfl⟩)
        · simp
        · exact Or.inr ⟨b, rfl⟩
  · rintro (ho₂ | ⟨a, rfl⟩)
    · exact isPrincipal_mul_of_le_two ho₂
    · exact isPrincipal_mul_omega0_opow_opow a

name: mul_omega0_dvd
statement:
theorem mul_omega0_dvd (a0 : 0 < a) (ha : a < ω) : ∀ {b}, ω ∣ b → a * b = b
  | _, ⟨b, rfl⟩ => by rw [← mul_assoc, mul_omega0 a0 ha]

name: mul_eq_opow_log_succ
statement:
theorem mul_eq_opow_log_succ (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : IsPrincipal (· * ·) b) (hb₂ : 2 < b) :
    a * b = b ^ succ (log b a)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hbl := isSuccLimit_of_isPrincipal_mul hb₂ hb
    rw [(isNormal_mul_right (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 ha)).apply_of_isSuccLimit hbl,
      Ordinal.iSup_le_iff]
    intro ⟨c, hcb⟩
    have hb₁ : 1 < b := one_lt_two.trans hb₂
    have hbo₀ : b ^ log b a ≠ 0 := pos_iff_ne_zero.1 (opow_pos _ (zero_lt_one.trans hb₁))
    apply (mul_le_mul_left (le_of_lt (lt_mul_succ_div a hbo₀)) c).trans
    rw [mul_assoc]
    conv_rhs => rw [succ_eq_add_one, opow_add_one]
    gcongr
    refine (hb (hbl.succ_lt ?_) hcb).le
    rw [← lt_mul_iff_div_lt hbo₀, ← opow_add_one]
    simpa [succ_eq_add_one] using lt_opow_succ_log_self hb₁ _
  · grw [succ_eq_add_one, opow_add_one, opow_log_le_self b ha]

name: isPrincipal_opow_omega0
statement: theorem isPrincipal_opow_omega0 : IsPrincipal (· ^ ·) ω
proof:
:= fun a b ha hb =>
  match a, b, lt_omega0.1 ha, lt_omega0.1 hb with
  | _, _, ⟨m, rfl⟩, ⟨n, rfl⟩ => by simp [← natCast_pow]

name: opow_omega0
statement: theorem opow_omega0 (a1 : 1 < a) (h : a < ω) : a ^ ω = ω
proof:
:=
  ((opow_le_of_isSuccLimit (one_le_iff_ne_zero.1 <| le_of_lt a1) isSuccLimit_omega0).2 fun _ hb =>
      (isPrincipal_opow_omega0 h hb).le).antisymm
  (right_le_opow _ a1)

name: natCast_opow_omega0
statement: theorem natCast_opow_omega0 {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) : n ^ ω = ω

name: iSup_add_one_eq
statement: theorem iSup_add_one_eq (hf : IsFundamentalSeq f) : ⨆ i, (f i).1 + 1 = o
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simp_rw [Ordinal.iSup_le_iff, add_one_le_iff]
    exact fun i ↦ (f i).2
  · refine le_of_forall_lt fun b hb ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨c, rfl⟩, hc : b ≤ _⟩ := hf.isCofinal_range ⟨b, hb⟩
    apply hc.trans_lt
    rw [← add_one_le_iff]
    apply Ordinal.le_iSup

name: ord_cof
statement: theorem ord_cof (hf : IsFundamentalSeq f) : o.cof.ord = a
proof:
:= by
  apply hf.le_ord_cof.antisymm'
  rw [← hf.iSup_add_one_eq, cof_iSup_Iio_add_one hf.strictMono]
  exact ord_cof_le a

name: iSup_eq
statement: theorem iSup_eq (hf : IsFundamentalSeq f) (ha : 1 < a) : ⨆ i, (f i).1 = o
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_Iio_add_one hf.strictMono, hf.iSup_add_one_eq]
  rw [← hf.ord_cof]
  apply (isSuccLimit_ord _).isSuccPrelimit
  rwa [aleph0_le_cof_iff, ← ord_lt_ord, hf.ord_cof, ord_one]

name: id
statement:
protected theorem id (ho : o ≤ o.cof.ord) : IsFundamentalSeq (o := o) id where
  strictMono
proof:
:= strictMono_id
  isCofinal_range := by simp
  le_ord_cof := ho

name: zero
statement:
protected theorem zero (f : Iio 0 → Iio 0) : IsFundamentalSeq f where
  strictMono _
proof:
:= by simp
  le_ord_cof := by simp
  isCofinal_range := .of_isEmpty

name: add_one
proof:
:= by simp
  le_ord_cof := by simp
  isCofinal_range := by simp [IsTop]

name: comp
statement:
protected theorem comp (hf : IsFundamentalSeq f) (hg : IsFundamentalSeq g) :
    IsFundamentalSeq (f ∘ g) where
  strictMono
proof:
:= hf.strictMono.comp hg.strictMono
  le_ord_cof := by rw [hf.ord_cof, ← hg.ord_cof]; exact a.ord_cof_le
  isCofinal_range := by
    rw [range_comp]
    exact hg.isCofinal_range.image hf.strictMono.monotone hf.isCofinal_range

name: comp_isNormal
statement:
theorem comp_isNormal {g : Ordinal → Ordinal} (hg : IsNormal g) (hf : IsFundamentalSeq f)
    (ho : IsSuccLimit o) : IsFundamentalSeq fun i ↦ ⟨g (f i), hg.strictMono (f i).2⟩ where
  strictMono
proof:
:= hg.strictMono.comp hf.strictMono
  le_ord_cof := by rw [cof_map_of_isNormal hg ho, hf.ord_cof]
  isCofinal_range := by
    rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    rw [mem_Iio, hg.lt_iff_exists_lt ho] at hb
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩ := hb
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨d, rfl⟩, hd⟩ := hf.isCofinal_range ⟨c, hc⟩
    refine ⟨⟨_, hg.strictMono (f d).2⟩, ?_, hc'.le.trans (hg.monotone hd)⟩
    simp

name: exists_isFundamentalSeq
statement: theorem exists_isFundamentalSeq (ha : o.cof.ord = a) : ∃ f : Iio a → Iio o, IsFundamentalSeq f
proof:
:= by
  subst ha
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ := exists_ord_cof_eq o.ToType
  rw [cof_toType] at hs'
  let g := (Set.orderIsoOfEq _ _ (congrArg _ hs'.symm)).trans <|
    .ofRelIsoLT (enum (α := s) (· < ·))
  refine ⟨fun i ↦ g i, le_rfl, fun _ ↦ by simp, ?_⟩
  rw [range_comp', OrderIso.map_isCofinal_iff, range_comp', g.range_eq]
  simpa

name: cof_eq
statement:
@[deprecated IsFundamentalSeq.ord_cof (since := "2026-03-23")]
protected theorem cof_eq (hf : IsFundamentalSequence a o f) : a.cof.ord = o
proof:
:=
  hf.1.antisymm' <| by
    rw [← hf.2.2]
    exact (ord_le_ord.2 (cof_blsub_le f)).trans (ord_card_le o)

name: strict_mono
statement:
@[deprecated IsFundamentalSeq.strictMono (since := "2026-03-23")]
protected theorem strict_mono (hf : IsFundamentalSequence a o f) {i j} :
    ∀ hi hj, i < j → f i hi < f j hj

name: blsub_eq
statement:
@[deprecated IsFundamentalSeq.iSup_add_one_eq (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem blsub_eq (hf : IsFundamentalSequence a o f) : blsub.{u, u} o f = a

name: ord_cof
statement:
@[deprecated IsFundamentalSeq (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem ord_cof (hf : IsFundamentalSequence a o f) :
    IsFundamentalSequence a a.cof.ord fun i hi => f i (hi.trans_le (by rw [hf.cof_eq]))
proof:
:= by
  have H := hf.cof_eq
  subst H
  exact hf

name: id_of_le_cof
statement:
@[deprecated IsFundamentalSeq.id (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem id_of_le_cof (h : o ≤ o.cof.ord) : IsFundamentalSequence o o fun a _ => a

name: zero
statement:
@[deprecated IsFundamentalSeq.zero (since := "2026-03-23")]
protected theorem zero {f : ∀ b < (0 : Ordinal), Ordinal} : IsFundamentalSequence 0 0 f
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rw [cof_zero, ord_zero], @fun i _ hi => (not_lt_zero hi).elim, blsub_zero f⟩

name: succ
statement:
@[deprecated IsFundamentalSeq.add_one (since := "2026-03-23")]
protected theorem succ : IsFundamentalSequence (succ o) 1 fun _ _ => o
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, @fun i j hi hj h => ?_, blsub_const Ordinal.one_ne_zero o⟩
  · rw [cof_succ, ord_one]
  · rw [lt_one_iff_zero] at hi hj
    rw [hi, hj] at h
    exact h.false.elim

name: monotone
statement:
@[deprecated IsFundamentalSeq.strictMono (since := "2026-03-23")]
protected theorem monotone (hf : IsFundamentalSequence a o f) {i j : Ordinal} (hi : i < o)
    (hj : j < o) (hij : i ≤ j) : f i hi ≤ f j hj
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hij with (hij | rfl)
  · exact (hf.2.1 hi hj hij).le
  · rfl

name: trans
statement:
@[deprecated IsFundamentalSeq.comp (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem trans {a o o' : Ordinal.{u}} {f : ∀ b < o, Ordinal.{u}} (hf : IsFundamentalSequence a o f)
    {g : ∀ b < o', Ordinal.{u}} (hg : IsFundamentalSequence o o' g) :
    IsFundamentalSequence a o' fun i hi =>
      f (g i hi) (by rw [← hg.2.2]; apply lt_blsub)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, @fun i j _ _ h => hf.2.1 _ _ (hg.2.1 _ _ h), ?_⟩
  · rw [hf.cof_eq]
    exact hg.1.trans (ord_cof_le o)
  · rw [@blsub_comp.{u, u, u} o _ f (@IsFundamentalSequence.monotone _ _ f hf)]
    · exact hf.2.2
    · exact hg.2.2

name: lt
exists_fundamental_sequence
statement:
@[deprecated exists_isFundamentalSeq (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem exists_fundamental_sequence (a : Ordinal.{u}) :
    ∃ f, IsFundamentalSequence a a.cof.ord f
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∃ o f, IsFundamentalSequence a o f by
    rcases h with ⟨o, f, hf⟩
    exact ⟨_, hf.ord_cof⟩
  rcases exists_lsub_cof a with ⟨ι, f, hf, hι⟩
  rcases ord_eq ι with ⟨r, wo, hr⟩
  let r' := Subrel r fun i ↦ ∀ j, r j i → f j < f i
  let hrr' : r' ↪r r := Subrel.relEmbedding _ _
  have := hrr'.isWellOrder
  refine
    ⟨_, _, hrr'.ordinal_type_le.trans ?_, @fun i j _ h _ => (enum r' ⟨j, h⟩).prop _ ?_,
      le_antisymm (blsub_le fun i hi => lsub_le_iff.1 hf.le _) ?_⟩
  · rw [← hι, hr]
  · change r (hrr'.1 _) (hrr'.1 _)
    rwa [hrr'.2, @enum_lt_enum _ r']
  · rw [← hf, lsub_le_iff]
    intro i
    suffices h : ∃ i' hi', f i ≤ bfamilyOfFamily' r' (fun i => f i) i' hi' by
      rcases h with ⟨i', hi', hfg⟩
      exact hfg.trans_lt (lt_blsub _ _ _)
    by_cases! h : ∀ j, r j i → f j < f i
    · refine ⟨typein r' ⟨i, h⟩, typein_lt_type _ _, ?_⟩
      rw [bfamilyOfFamily'_typein]
    · obtain ⟨hji, hij⟩ := wo.wf.min_mem _ h
      refine ⟨typein r' ⟨_, fun k hkj => lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ hij⟩, typein_lt_type _ _, ?_⟩
      · by_contra! H
        exact (wo.wf.not_lt_min {j | r j i ∧ f i ≤ f j} ⟨IsTrans.trans _ _ _ hkj hji, H⟩) hkj
      · rwa [bfamilyOfFamily'_typein]

name: IsFundamentalSequence.of_isNormal
statement:
@[deprecated IsFundamentalSeq.comp_isNormal (since := "2026-03-23")]
theorem IsFundamentalSequence.of_isNormal {f : Ordinal.{u} → Ordinal.{u}} (hf : IsNormal f)
    {a o} (ha : IsSuccLimit a) {g} (hg : IsFundamentalSequence a o g) :
    IsFundamentalSequence (f a) o fun b hb => f (g b hb)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, @fun i j _ _ h => hf.strictMono (hg.2.1 _ _ h), ?_⟩
  · grind [Ordinal.IsFundamentalSequence, cof_map_of_isNormal]
  · rw [@blsub_comp.{u, u, u} a _ (fun b _ => f b) (@fun i j _ _ h => hf.strictMono.monotone h) g
        hg.2.2]
    exact IsNormal.blsub_eq.{u, u} hf ha

name: enumOrd_le_of_forall_lt
statement: theorem enumOrd_le_of_forall_lt (ha : a ∈ s) (H : ∀ b < o, enumOrd s b < a) : enumOrd s o ≤ a

name: enumOrd_nonempty
statement:
private theorem enumOrd_nonempty (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) (o : Ordinal) :
    (s ∩ { b | ∀ c, c < o → enumOrd s c < b }).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [not_bddAbove_iff] at hs
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := bddAbove_of_small (s := enumOrd s '' Iio o)
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := hs a
  exact ⟨b, hb, fun c hc ↦ (ha (mem_image_of_mem _ hc)).trans_lt hba⟩

name: enumOrd_mem_aux
statement:
private theorem enumOrd_mem_aux (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) (o : Ordinal) :
    enumOrd s o ∈ s ∩ { b | ∀ c, c < o → enumOrd s c < b }
proof:
:= by
  rw [enumOrd]
  exact csInf_mem (enumOrd_nonempty hs o)

name: enumOrd_mem
statement: theorem enumOrd_mem (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) (o : Ordinal) : enumOrd s o ∈ s

name: enumOrd_strictMono
statement: theorem enumOrd_strictMono (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) : StrictMono (enumOrd s)
proof:
:=
  fun a b ↦ (enumOrd_mem_aux hs b).2 a

name: enumOrd_injective
statement: theorem enumOrd_injective (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) : Function.Injective (enumOrd s)

name: enumOrd_inj
statement: theorem enumOrd_inj (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) {a b : Ordinal} : enumOrd s a = enumOrd s b ↔ a = b

name: enumOrd_le_enumOrd
statement:
theorem enumOrd_le_enumOrd (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) {a b : Ordinal} :
    enumOrd s a ≤ enumOrd s b ↔ a ≤ b

name: enumOrd_lt_enumOrd
statement:
theorem enumOrd_lt_enumOrd (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) {a b : Ordinal} :
    enumOrd s a < enumOrd s b ↔ a < b

name: id_le_enumOrd
statement: theorem id_le_enumOrd (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) : id ≤ enumOrd s

name: le_enumOrd_self
statement: theorem le_enumOrd_self (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) {a} : a ≤ enumOrd s a

name: enumOrd_succ_le
statement:
theorem enumOrd_succ_le (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : enumOrd s b < a) :
    enumOrd s (succ b) ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  apply enumOrd_le_of_forall_lt ha
  intro c hc
  rw [lt_succ_iff] at hc
  exact ((enumOrd_strictMono hs).monotone hc).trans_lt hb

name: range_enumOrd
statement: theorem range_enumOrd (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) : range (enumOrd s) = s
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  let t := { b | a ≤ enumOrd s b }
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact enumOrd_mem hs b
  · intro ha
    refine ⟨sInf t, (enumOrd_le_of_forall_lt ha ?_).antisymm ?_⟩
    · intro b hb
      by_contra! hb'
      exact hb.not_ge (csInf_le' hb')
    · exact csInf_mem (s := t) ⟨a, (enumOrd_strictMono hs).id_le a⟩

name: enumOrd_surjective
statement:
theorem enumOrd_surjective (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) {b : Ordinal} (hb : b ∈ s) :
    ∃ a, enumOrd s a = b
proof:
:= by
  rwa [← range_enumOrd hs] at hb

name: enumOrd_le_of_subset
statement:
theorem enumOrd_le_of_subset {t : Set Ordinal} (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    enumOrd t ≤ enumOrd s
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  rw [enumOrd, enumOrd]
  gcongr with b c
  exacts [enumOrd_nonempty hs a, enumOrd_le_of_subset hs hst c]

name: eq_enumOrd
statement:
theorem eq_enumOrd (f : Ordinal → Ordinal) (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) :
    enumOrd s = f ↔ StrictMono f ∧ range f = s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨enumOrd_strictMono hs, range_enumOrd hs⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    rwa [← (enumOrd_strictMono hs).range_inj_of_wellFoundedLT h₁, range_enumOrd hs, eq_comm]

name: enumOrd_range
statement: theorem enumOrd_range {f : Ordinal → Ordinal} (hf : StrictMono f) : enumOrd (range f) = f

name: isNormal_enumOrd
statement:
theorem isNormal_enumOrd (H : ∀ t ⊆ s, t.Nonempty → BddAbove t → sSup t ∈ s) (hs : ¬ BddAbove s) :
    IsNormal (enumOrd s)
proof:
:= by
  refine isNormal_iff.2 ⟨enumOrd_strictMono hs, fun o ho a ha ↦ ?_⟩
  trans ⨆ b : Iio o, enumOrd s b
  · refine enumOrd_le_of_forall_lt ?_ (fun b hb ↦ (enumOrd_strictMono hs (lt_succ b)).trans_le ?_)
    · have : Nonempty (Iio o) := ⟨0, ho.bot_lt⟩
      apply H _ _ (range_nonempty _) bddAbove_of_small
      rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
      exact enumOrd_mem hs c
    · exact Ordinal.le_iSup _ (⟨_, ho.succ_lt hb⟩ : Iio o)
  · exact Ordinal.iSup_le fun x ↦ ha _ x.2

name: enumOrd_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem enumOrd_univ : enumOrd Set.univ = id
proof:
:= by
  rw [← range_id]
  exact enumOrd_range strictMono_id

name: enumOrd_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma enumOrd_zero : enumOrd s 0 = sInf s

name: foldr_le_nfpFamily
statement:
theorem foldr_le_nfpFamily [Small.{u} ι] (f : ι → Ordinal.{u} → Ordinal.{u}) (a l) :
    List.foldr f a l ≤ nfpFamily f a

name: le_nfpFamily
statement: theorem le_nfpFamily [Small.{u} ι] (f : ι → Ordinal.{u} → Ordinal.{u}) (a) : a ≤ nfpFamily f a

name: lt_nfpFamily_iff
statement: theorem lt_nfpFamily_iff [Small.{u} ι] {a b} : a < nfpFamily f b ↔ ∃ l, a < List.foldr f b l

name: nfpFamily_le_iff
statement: theorem nfpFamily_le_iff [Small.{u} ι] {a b} : nfpFamily f a ≤ b ↔ ∀ l, List.foldr f a l ≤ b

name: nfpFamily_le
statement: theorem nfpFamily_le {a b} : (∀ l, List.foldr f a l ≤ b) → nfpFamily f a ≤ b

name: nfpFamily_monotone
statement: theorem nfpFamily_monotone [Small.{u} ι] (hf : ∀ i, Monotone (f i)) : Monotone (nfpFamily f)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h ↦ nfpFamily_le <| fun l ↦ (List.foldr_monotone hf l h).trans (foldr_le_nfpFamily _ _ l)

name: apply_lt_nfpFamily
statement:
theorem apply_lt_nfpFamily [Small.{u} ι] (H : ∀ i, IsNormal (f i)) {a b}
    (hb : b < nfpFamily f a) (i) : f i b < nfpFamily f a
proof:
:=
  let ⟨l, hl⟩ := lt_nfpFamily_iff.1 hb
  lt_nfpFamily_iff.2 ⟨i::l, (H i).strictMono hl⟩

name: apply_lt_nfpFamily_iff
statement:
theorem apply_lt_nfpFamily_iff [Nonempty ι] [Small.{u} ι] (H : ∀ i, IsNormal (f i)) {a b} :
    (∀ i, f i b < nfpFamily f a) ↔ b < nfpFamily f a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, apply_lt_nfpFamily H⟩
  let ⟨l, hl⟩ := lt_nfpFamily_iff.1 (h (Classical.arbitrary ι))
  exact lt_nfpFamily_iff.2 <| ⟨l, (H _).strictMono.le_apply.trans_lt hl⟩

name: nfpFamily_le_apply
statement:
theorem nfpFamily_le_apply [Nonempty ι] [Small.{u} ι] (H : ∀ i, IsNormal (f i)) {a b} :
    (∃ i, nfpFamily f a ≤ f i b) ↔ nfpFamily f a ≤ b

name: nfpFamily_le_fp
statement:
theorem nfpFamily_le_fp (H : ∀ i, Monotone (f i)) {a b} (ab : a ≤ b) (h : ∀ i, f i b ≤ b) :
    nfpFamily f a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  apply Ordinal.iSup_le fun l ↦ ?_
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil => exact ab
  | cons i l IH => exact (H i (IH ab)).trans (h i)

name: nfpFamily_fp
statement:
theorem nfpFamily_fp [Small.{u} ι] {i} (H : IsNormal (f i)) (a) :
    f i (nfpFamily f a) = nfpFamily f a
proof:
:= by
  rw [nfpFamily, H.map_iSup bddAbove_of_small]
  apply le_antisymm <;> refine Ordinal.iSup_le fun l => ?_
  · exact Ordinal.le_iSup _ (i::l)
  · exact H.strictMono.le_apply.trans (Ordinal.le_iSup _ _)

name: apply_le_nfpFamily
statement:
theorem apply_le_nfpFamily [Small.{u} ι] [hι : Nonempty ι] (H : ∀ i, IsNormal (f i)) {a b} :
    (∀ i, f i b ≤ nfpFamily f a) ↔ b ≤ nfpFamily f a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h i => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨i⟩ := hι
    exact (H i).strictMono.le_apply.trans (h i)
  · rw [← nfpFamily_fp (H i)]
    exact (H i).monotone h

name: nfpFamily_eq_self
statement: theorem nfpFamily_eq_self [Small.{u} ι] {a} (h : ∀ i, f i a = a) : nfpFamily f a = a
proof:
:= by
  apply (Ordinal.iSup_le ?_).antisymm (le_nfpFamily f a)
  intro l
  rw [List.foldr_fixed' h l]

name: not_bddAbove_fp_family
statement:
theorem not_bddAbove_fp_family [Small.{u} ι] (H : ∀ i, IsNormal (f i)) :
    ¬ BddAbove (⋂ i, Function.fixedPoints (f i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [not_bddAbove_iff]
  refine fun a ↦ ⟨nfpFamily f (succ a), ?_, (lt_succ a).trans_le (le_nfpFamily f _)⟩
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact nfpFamily_fp (H i) _

name: derivFamily_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivFamily_zero (f : ι → Ordinal → Ordinal) :
    derivFamily f 0 = nfpFamily f 0

name: derivFamily_add_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivFamily_add_one (f : ι → Ordinal → Ordinal) (o) :
    derivFamily f (o + 1) = nfpFamily f (derivFamily f o + 1)

name: derivFamily_succ
statement:
@[deprecated derivFamily_add_one (since := "2026-06-17")]
theorem derivFamily_succ (f : ι → Ordinal → Ordinal) (o) :
    derivFamily f (succ o) = nfpFamily f (succ (derivFamily f o))

name: derivFamily_limit
statement:
theorem derivFamily_limit (f : ι → Ordinal → Ordinal) {o} :
    IsSuccLimit o → derivFamily f o = ⨆ b : Set.Iio o, derivFamily f b

name: isNormal_derivFamily
statement:
theorem isNormal_derivFamily [Small.{u} ι] (f : ι → Ordinal.{u} → Ordinal.{u}) :
    IsNormal (derivFamily f)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsNormal.of_succ_lt (fun o ↦ ?_) @fun o h ↦ ?_
  · rw [succ_eq_add_one, derivFamily_add_one, ← succ_le_iff]
    exact le_nfpFamily _ _
  · rw [derivFamily_limit _ h, Set.image_eq_range]
    have := h.nonempty_Iio.to_subtype
    exact isLUB_ciSup bddAbove_of_small

name: derivFamily_strictMono
statement:
theorem derivFamily_strictMono [Small.{u} ι] (f : ι → Ordinal.{u} → Ordinal.{u}) :
    StrictMono (derivFamily f)

name: derivFamily_fp
statement:
theorem derivFamily_fp [Small.{u} ι] {i} (H : IsNormal (f i)) (o : Ordinal) :
    f i (derivFamily f o) = derivFamily f o
proof:
:= by
  induction o using limitRecOn with
  | zero =>
    rw [derivFamily_zero]
    exact nfpFamily_fp H 0
  | add_one =>
    rw [derivFamily_add_one]
    exact nfpFamily_fp H _
  | limit o l IH =>
    have := l.nonempty_Iio.to_subtype
    rw [derivFamily_limit _ l, H.map_iSup bddAbove_of_small]
    refine eq_of_forall_ge_iff fun c => ?_
    rw [Ordinal.iSup_le_iff, Ordinal.iSup_le_iff]
    refine forall_congr' fun a ↦ ?_
    rw [IH _ a.2]

name: le_iff_derivFamily
statement:
theorem le_iff_derivFamily [Small.{u} ι] (H : ∀ i, IsNormal (f i)) {a} :
    (∀ i, f i a ≤ a) ↔ ∃ o, derivFamily f o = a
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ha => by
    suffices ∀ (o), a ≤ derivFamily f o → ∃ o, derivFamily f o = a from
      this a (isNormal_derivFamily _).strictMono.le_apply
    intro o
    induction o using limitRecOn with
    | zero =>
      intro h₁
      refine ⟨0, le_antisymm ?_ h₁⟩
      rw [derivFamily_zero]
      exact nfpFamily_le_fp (fun i => (H i).monotone) zero_le ha
    | add_one o IH =>
      intro h₁
      rcases le_or_gt a (derivFamily f o) with h | h
      · exact IH h
      refine ⟨o + 1, le_antisymm ?_ h₁⟩
      rw [derivFamily_add_one]
      exact nfpFamily_le_fp (fun i => (H i).monotone) (succ_le_of_lt h) ha
    | limit o l IH =>
      intro h₁
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h₁ with h | h
      · exact ⟨_, h.symm⟩
      rw [derivFamily_limit _ l, ← not_le, Ordinal.iSup_le_iff, not_forall] at h
      obtain ⟨o', h⟩ := h
      exact IH o' o'.2 (le_of_not_ge h),
    fun ⟨_, e⟩ i => e ▸ (derivFamily_fp (H i) _).le⟩

name: fp_iff_derivFamily
statement:
theorem fp_iff_derivFamily [Small.{u} ι] (H : ∀ i, IsNormal (f i)) {a} :
    (∀ i, f i a = a) ↔ ∃ o, derivFamily f o = a
proof:
:=
  Iff.trans ⟨fun h i => le_of_eq (h i), fun h i => (H i).strictMono.le_apply.ge_iff_eq'.1 (h i)⟩
    (le_iff_derivFamily H)

name: mem_range_derivFamily
statement:
theorem mem_range_derivFamily [Small.{u} ι] (H : ∀ i, IsNormal (f i)) {a} :
    a ∈ Set.range (derivFamily f) ↔ ∀ i, f i a = a

name: derivFamily_eq_enumOrd
statement:
theorem derivFamily_eq_enumOrd [Small.{u} ι] (H : ∀ i, IsNormal (f i)) :
    derivFamily f = enumOrd (⋂ i, Function.fixedPoints (f i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, eq_enumOrd _ (not_bddAbove_fp_family H)]
  use (isNormal_derivFamily f).strictMono
  rw [Set.range_eq_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  · rintro a S ⟨i, hi⟩
    rw [← hi]
    exact derivFamily_fp (H i) a
  rw [Set.mem_iInter] at ha
  rwa [← fp_iff_derivFamily H]

statement: theorem nfp_eq_nfpFamily (f : Ordinal → Ordinal) : nfp f = nfpFamily fun _ : Unit => f

name: iSup_iterate_eq_nfp
statement:
theorem iSup_iterate_eq_nfp (f : Ordinal.{u} → Ordinal.{u}) (a : Ordinal.{u}) :
    ⨆ n : ℕ, f^[n] a = nfp f a
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ordinal.iSup_le_iff]
    intro n
    rw [← List.length_replicate (n := n) (a := Unit.unit), ← List.foldr_const f a]
    exact Ordinal.le_iSup _ _
  · apply Ordinal.iSup_le
    intro l
    rw [List.foldr_const f a l]
    exact Ordinal.le_iSup _ _

name: iterate_le_nfp
statement: theorem iterate_le_nfp (f a n) : f^[n] a ≤ nfp f a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_iterate_eq_nfp]
  exact Ordinal.le_iSup (fun n ↦ f^[n] a) n

name: iterate_lt_nfp

  exact ⟨fun h _ => h, fun h => h Unit.unit⟩

name: nfp_zero_left
statement:
@[deprecated "do not depend on the junk values of `nfp`" (since := "2026-05-13")]
theorem nfp_zero_left (a) : nfp 0 a = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_iterate_eq_nfp]
  apply (Ordinal.iSup_le ?_).antisymm (Ordinal.le_iSup _ 0)
  intro n
  cases n
  · rfl
  · rw [Function.iterate_succ']
    simp

name: nfp_zero
statement:
@[deprecated "do not depend on the junk values of `nfp`" (since := "2026-05-13")]
theorem nfp_zero : nfp 0 = id

@[deprecated "do not depend on the junk values of `deriv`" (since := "2026-05-13")]
theorem deriv_zero_left (a) : deriv 0 a = a
proof:

name: nfp_add_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nfp_add_zero (a) : nfp (a + ·) 0 = a * ω

name: nfp_add_eq_mul_omega0
statement: theorem nfp_add_eq_mul_omega0 {a b} (hba : b ≤ a * ω) : nfp (a + ·) b = a * ω
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (nfp_le_fp (isNormal_add_right a).monotone hba _)
  · rw [← nfp_add_zero]
    exact nfp_monotone (isNormal_add_right a).monotone zero_le
  · rw [← mul_one_add, one_add_omega0]

name: add_eq_right_iff_mul_omega0_le
statement: theorem add_eq_right_iff_mul_omega0_le {a b : Ordinal} : a + b = b ↔ a * ω ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · rw [← nfp_add_zero a, ← deriv_zero_right]
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (mem_range_deriv (isNormal_add_right a)).2 h
    rw [← hc]
    exact (isNormal_deriv _).monotone zero_le
  · have := Ordinal.add_sub_cancel_of_le h
    nth_rw 1 [← this]
    rwa [← add_assoc, ← mul_one_add, one_add_omega0]

name: add_le_right_iff_mul_omega0_le
statement: theorem add_le_right_iff_mul_omega0_le {a b : Ordinal} : a + b ≤ b ↔ a * ω ≤ b

name: deriv_add_eq_mul_omega0_add
statement: theorem deriv_add_eq_mul_omega0_add (a b : Ordinal.{u}) : deriv (a + ·) b = a * ω + b
proof:
:= by
  revert b
  rw [← funext_iff, IsNormal.ext_iff (isNormal_deriv _) (isNormal_add_right _)]
  refine ⟨?_, fun a h => ?_⟩
  · rw [bot_eq_zero, deriv_zero_right, add_zero]
    exact nfp_add_zero a
  · rw [succ_eq_add_one, deriv_add_one, h, ← add_assoc]
    exact nfp_eq_self (add_eq_right_iff_mul_omega0_le.2 (le_self_add.trans (le_succ _)))

name: nfp_mul_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nfp_mul_one {a : Ordinal} (ha : 0 < a) : nfp (a * ·) 1 = a ^ ω

name: nfp_mul_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nfp_mul_zero (a : Ordinal) : nfp (a * ·) 0 = 0

name: nfp_mul_eq_opow_omega0
statement:
theorem nfp_mul_eq_opow_omega0 {a b : Ordinal} (hb : 0 < b) (hba : b ≤ a ^ ω) :
    nfp (a * ·) b = a ^ ω
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_pos a with rfl | ha
  · rw [zero_opow omega0_ne_zero] at hba
    cases hba.not_gt hb
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply nfp_le_fp (isNormal_mul_right ha).monotone hba
    rw [← opow_one_add, one_add_omega0]
  rw [← nfp_mul_one ha]
  exact nfp_monotone (isNormal_mul_right ha).monotone (one_le_iff_pos.2 hb)

name: eq_zero_or_opow_omega0_le_of_mul_eq_right
statement:
theorem eq_zero_or_opow_omega0_le_of_mul_eq_right {a b : Ordinal} (hab : a * b = b) :
    b = 0 ∨ a ^ ω ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_pos a with ha | ha
  · rw [ha, zero_opow omega0_ne_zero]
    exact .inr zero_le
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_left]
  intro hb
  rw [← nfp_mul_one ha]
  rw [← Ne, ← one_le_iff_ne_zero] at hb
  exact nfp_le_fp (isNormal_mul_right ha).monotone hb (le_of_eq hab)

name: mul_eq_right_iff_opow_omega0_dvd
statement: theorem mul_eq_right_iff_opow_omega0_dvd {a b : Ordinal} : a * b = b ↔ a ^ ω ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_pos a with ha | ha
  · rw [ha, zero_mul, zero_opow omega0_ne_zero, zero_dvd_iff]
    exact eq_comm
  refine ⟨fun hab => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · rw [dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero]
    rw [← div_add_mod b (a ^ ω), mul_add, ← mul_assoc, ← opow_one_add, one_add_omega0,
      add_left_cancel_iff] at hab
    rcases eq_zero_or_opow_omega0_le_of_mul_eq_right hab with hab | hab
    · exact hab
    refine (not_lt_of_ge hab (mod_lt b (opow_ne_zero ω ?_))).elim
    rwa [← pos_iff_ne_zero]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h
  rw [hc, ← mul_assoc, ← opow_one_add, one_add_omega0]

name: mul_le_right_iff_opow_omega0_dvd
statement:
theorem mul_le_right_iff_opow_omega0_dvd {a b : Ordinal} (ha : 0 < a) :
    a * b ≤ b ↔ (a ^ ω) ∣ b

name: nfp_mul_opow_omega0_add
statement:
theorem nfp_mul_opow_omega0_add {a c : Ordinal} (b) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hca : c ≤ a ^ ω) : nfp (a * ·) (a ^ ω * b + c) = a ^ ω * succ b
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply nfp_le_fp (isNormal_mul_right ha).monotone
    · rw [mul_succ]
      gcongr
    · rw [← mul_assoc, ← opow_one_add, one_add_omega0]
  · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ :=
      mul_eq_right_iff_opow_omega0_dvd.1 (nfp_fp (isNormal_mul_right ha) (a ^ ω * b + c))
    rw [hd]
    apply mul_le_mul_right
    have := le_nfp (a * ·) (a ^ ω * b + c)
    rw [hd] at this
    have := (add_lt_add_right hc (a ^ ω * b)).trans_le this
    rw [add_zero, mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ (opow_pos ω ha)] at this
    rwa [succ_le_iff]

name: deriv_mul_eq_opow_omega0_mul
statement:
theorem deriv_mul_eq_opow_omega0_mul {a : Ordinal.{u}} (ha : 0 < a) (b) :
    deriv (a * ·) b = a ^ ω * b
proof:
:= by
  revert b
  rw [← funext_iff,
    IsNormal.ext_iff (isNormal_deriv _) (isNormal_mul_right (opow_pos ω ha))]
  refine ⟨?_, fun c h => ?_⟩
  · rw [bot_eq_zero, deriv_zero_right, nfp_mul_zero, mul_zero]
  · rw [succ_eq_add_one, deriv_add_one, h]
    exact nfp_mul_opow_omega0_add c ha zero_lt_one (one_le_iff_pos.2 (opow_pos _ ha))

name: card_fun
statement:
@[simp]
lemma card_fun {α β : Type*} : card (α → β) = card β ^ card α
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty α with α_emp | α_emp
  · simp [(card_eq_zero_iff_empty α).2 α_emp]
  rcases finite_or_infinite α
  · rcases finite_or_infinite β
    · let := Fintype.ofFinite α
      let := Fintype.ofFinite β
      simp
    · simp only [card_eq_top_of_infinite]
      rw [top_epow]
      rwa [card_ne_zero_iff_nonempty]
  · rw [card_eq_top_of_infinite (α := α)]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (card β) 1 with b_0 | b_1 | b_2
    · rw [Order.lt_one_iff, card_eq_zero_iff_empty] at b_0
      rw [(card_eq_zero_iff_empty β).2 b_0, zero_epow_top, card_eq_zero_iff_empty]
      simp [b_0]
    · rw [b_1, one_epow]
      apply le_antisymm
      · let := (card_le_one_iff_subsingleton β).1 b_1.le
        exact (card_le_one_iff_subsingleton (α → β)).2 Pi.instSubsingleton
      · let := (one_le_card_iff_nonempty β).1 b_1.ge
        exact (one_le_card_iff_nonempty (α → β)).2 Pi.instNonempty
    · rw [epow_top b_2, card_eq_top]
      rw [one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial β] at b_2
      exact Pi.infinite_of_left

statement: theorem isRegular_succ {c : Cardinal} (hc : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : IsRegular (succ c)
proof:

  use hc₀

  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := exists_isFundamentalSeq (o := (succ c).ord) rfl

name: derivFamily_lt_ord_lift
statement:
theorem derivFamily_lt_ord_lift {ι : Type u} {f : ι → Ordinal → Ordinal} {c} (hc : IsRegular c)
    (hι : lift.{v} #ι < c) (hc' : c ≠ ℵ₀) (hf : ∀ i, ∀ b < c.ord, f i b < c.ord) {a} :
    a < c.ord → derivFamily f a < c.ord
proof:
:= by
  have hω : ℵ₀ < c.ord.cof := by
    rw [hc.cof_ord]
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hc.1 hc'.symm
  induction a using limitRecOn with
  | zero =>
    rw [derivFamily_zero]
    exact nfpFamily_lt_ord_lift hω (by rwa [hc.cof_ord]) hf
  | add_one b hb =>
    intro hb'
    rw [derivFamily_add_one]
    exact
      nfpFamily_lt_ord_lift hω (by rwa [hc.cof_ord]) hf
        ((isSuccLimit_ord hc.1).succ_lt (hb ((lt_succ b).trans hb')))
  | limit b hb H =>
    intro hb'
    rw [derivFamily_limit f hb]
    apply Ordinal.lift_iSup_lt_of_lt_cof
    · rwa [← lift_cof, hc.cof_ord, mk_Iio_ordinal, lift_lift, lift_lt, ← lt_ord]
    · exact fun i ↦ H i.1 i.2 <| i.2.trans hb'

proof:

  derivFamily_lt_ord_lift hc
    (by simpa using Cardinal.one_lt_aleph0.trans (lt_of_le_of_ne hc.1 hc'.symm)) hc' fun _ => hf

name: schroeder_bernstein_of_rel
statement:
theorem schroeder_bernstein_of_rel {f : α → β} {g : β → α} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hg : Function.Injective g) (R : α → β → Prop) (hp₁ : ∀ a : α, R a (f a))
    (hp₂ : ∀ b : β, R (g b) b) :
    ∃ h : α → β, Bijective h ∧ ∀ a : α, R a (h a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty β with hβ | hβ
  · have : IsEmpty α := Function.isEmpty f
    exact ⟨_, ((Equiv.equivEmpty α).trans (Equiv.equivEmpty β).symm).bijective, by simp⟩
  set F : Set α →o Set α :=
    { toFun := fun s => (g '' (f '' s)ᶜ)ᶜ
      monotone' := fun s t hst => by dsimp at hst ⊢; gcongr }
  set s : Set α := F.lfp
  have hs : (g '' (f '' s)ᶜ)ᶜ = s := F.map_lfp
  have hns : g '' (f '' s)ᶜ = sᶜ := compl_injective (by simp [hs])
  set g' := invFun g
  have g'g : LeftInverse g' g := leftInverse_invFun hg
  have hg'ns : g' '' sᶜ = (f '' s)ᶜ := by rw [← hns, g'g.image_image]
  set h : α → β := s.piecewise f g'
  have : Surjective h := by rw [← range_eq_univ, range_piecewise, hg'ns, union_compl_self]
  have : Injective h := by
    refine (injective_piecewise_iff _).2 ⟨hf.injOn, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x hx y hy hxy
      obtain ⟨x', _, rfl⟩ : x ∈ g '' (f '' s)ᶜ := by rwa [hns]
      obtain ⟨y', _, rfl⟩ : y ∈ g '' (f '' s)ᶜ := by rwa [hns]
      rw [g'g _, g'g _] at hxy
      rw [hxy]
    · intro x hx y hy hxy
      obtain ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩ : y ∈ g '' (f '' s)ᶜ := by rwa [hns]
      rw [g'g _] at hxy
      exact hy' ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
  refine ⟨h, ⟨‹Injective h›, ‹Surjective h›⟩, fun a ↦ ?_⟩
  simp only [h, Set.piecewise, g']
  split
  · exact hp₁ a
  · have : g (invFun g a) = a := by
      have : a ∈ g '' (f '' s)ᶜ := by grind
      obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := mem_image _ _ _ |>.mp this
      exact Function.invFun_eq ⟨x, hx⟩
    grind

name: schroeder_bernstein
statement:
theorem schroeder_bernstein {f : α → β} {g : β → α} (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hg : Function.Injective g) : ∃ h : α → β, Bijective h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, _⟩ := schroeder_bernstein_of_rel hf hg (fun x y ↦ True) (by simp) (by simp)
  exact ⟨f, hf⟩

name: min_injective
statement: theorem min_injective [I : Nonempty ι] : ∃ i, Nonempty (∀ j, β i ↪ β j)
proof:
:=
  let ⟨s, hs⟩ := show ∃ s, Maximal (· ∈ sets β) s by
    refine zorn_subset _ fun c hc hcc ↦
      ⟨⋃₀ c, fun i x ⟨p, hpc, hxp⟩ y ⟨q, hqc, hyq⟩ hi ↦ ?_, fun _ ↦ subset_sUnion_of_mem⟩
    exact (hcc.total hpc hqc).elim (fun h ↦ hc hqc i (h hxp) hyq hi)
      fun h ↦ hc hpc i hxp (h hyq) hi
  let ⟨i, e⟩ :=
    show ∃ i, Surjective fun x : s => x.val i from
      Classical.by_contradiction fun h =>
        have h : ∀ i, ∃ y, ∀ x ∈ s, (x : ∀ i, β i) i ≠ y := by
          simpa [Surjective] using h
        let ⟨f, hf⟩ := Classical.axiom_of_choice h
        have : f ∈ s :=
          have : insert f s ∈ sets β := fun i x hx y hy => by
            rcases hx with hx | hx <;> rcases hy with hy | hy; · simp [hx, hy]
            · subst x
              exact fun e => (hf i y hy e.symm).elim
            · subst y
              exact fun e => (hf i x hx e).elim
            · exact hs.prop i hx hy
          hs.eq_of_subset this (subset_insert _ _) ▸ mem_insert ..
        let ⟨i⟩ := I
        hf i f this rfl
  ⟨i, ⟨fun j => ⟨s.domRestrict (fun x => x j) ∘ surjInv e,
    ((hs.1 j).injective).comp (injective_surjInv _)⟩⟩⟩

name: total
statement: theorem total (α : Type u) (β : Type v) : Nonempty (α ↪ β) ∨ Nonempty (β ↪ α)
proof:
:=
  match @min_injective Bool (fun b => cond b (ULift α) (ULift.{max u v, v} β)) ⟨true⟩
    with
  | ⟨true, ⟨h⟩⟩ =>
    let ⟨f, hf⟩ := h false
    Or.inl ⟨Embedding.congr Equiv.ulift Equiv.ulift ⟨f, hf⟩⟩
  | ⟨false, ⟨h⟩⟩ =>
    let ⟨f, hf⟩ := h true
    Or.inr ⟨Embedding.congr Equiv.ulift Equiv.ulift ⟨f, hf⟩⟩

theorem of_not_isCofinal_rangeSplitting [Nonempty α] (hf : Monotone f)

proof:
:= by
  rw [eventuallyConst_atTop]
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := not_isCofinal_iff.1 hf'
  refine ⟨i, fun j hij ↦ (hf hij).antisymm' <| (hf (hi _ ⟨⟨f j, j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩).le).trans' ?_⟩
  rw [apply_rangeSplitting f]

name: cardinalMk_closure_le_max
statement: lemma cardinalMk_closure_le_max : #(closure s) ≤ max #s ℵ₀
proof:
:=
  (Cardinal.mk_le_of_surjective <| surjective_ofWType s).trans <| by
    convert! WType.cardinalMk_le_max_aleph0_of_finite' using 1
    · rw [lift_uzero, mk_sum, lift_uzero]
      have : lift.{u, 0} #(Fin 6) < ℵ₀ := lift_lt_aleph0.mpr (lt_aleph0_of_finite _)
      obtain h | h := lt_or_ge #s ℵ₀
      · rw [max_eq_right h.le, max_eq_right]
        exact (add_lt_aleph0 this h).le
      · rw [max_eq_left h, add_eq_right h (this.le.trans h), max_eq_left h]
    rintro (n | _)
    · fin_cases n <;> (dsimp only [id_eq]; infer_instance)
    infer_instance

:= by
  simp_rw [univLE_iff, small_iff_lift_mk_lt_univ]
  contrapose!
  
  refine ⟨fun ⟨α, le⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [univ_umax.{v, u}, ← lift_le.{u + 1}, lift_univ, lift_lift] at le
    exact le.trans_lt (lift_lt_univ'.{u, v + 1} #α)
  · obtain ⟨⟨α⟩, h⟩ := lt_univ'.mp h; use α
    rw [univ_umax.{v, u}, ← lift_le.{u + 1}, lift_univ, lift_lift]

name: lt_wf
statement: protected theorem lt_wf : @WellFounded Cardinal.{u} (· < ·)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun a =>
    by_contradiction fun h => by
      let ι := { c : Cardinal // ¬Acc (· < ·) c }
      let f : ι → Cardinal := Subtype.val
      have hι : Nonempty ι := ⟨⟨_, h⟩⟩
      obtain ⟨⟨c : Cardinal, hc : ¬Acc (· < ·) c⟩, ⟨h_1 : ∀ j, (f ⟨c, hc⟩).out ↪ (f j).out⟩⟩ :=
        Embedding.min_injective fun i => (f i).out
      refine hc (Acc.intro _ fun j h' => by_contradiction fun hj => h'.2 ?_)
      have : #_ ≤ #_ := ⟨h_1 ⟨j, hj⟩⟩
      simpa only [mk_out] using this⟩

    #α ≤ #β * c
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← mk_congr (@Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv α β f), mk_sigma, ← sum_const'] using!

name: lift_mk_le_lift_mk_mul_of_lift_mk_preimage_le

theorem lift_mk_le_lift_mk_mul_of_lift_mk_preimage_le {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {c : Cardinal}
    (f : α → β) (hf : ∀ b : β, lift.{v} #(f ⁻¹' {b}) ≤ c) : lift.{v} #α ≤ lift.{u} #β * c
proof:
:=
  (mk_le_mk_mul_of_mk_preimage_le fun x : ULift.{v} α => ULift.up.{u} (f x.1)) <|
    ULift.forall.2 fun b =>
      (mk_congr <|
            (Equiv.ulift.image _).trans
              (Equiv.trans
                (by
                  rw [Equiv.image_eq_preimage_symm]
                  simp only [preimage, mem_singleton_iff, ULift.up_inj, mem_ofPred_eq, coe_ofPred]
                  exact Equiv.refl _)
                Equiv.ulift.symm)).trans_le
        (hf b)

name: nonempty_embedding_to_cardinal
statement: theorem nonempty_embedding_to_cardinal : Nonempty (α ↪ Cardinal.{u})
proof:

  (Embedding.total _ _).resolve_left fun ⟨⟨f, hf⟩⟩ =>
    let g : α → Cardinal.{u} := invFun f
    let ⟨x, (hx : g x = 2 ^ sum g)⟩ := invFun_surjective hf (2 ^ sum g)
    have : g x ≤ sum g := le_sum.{u, u} g x
    not_le_of_gt (by rw [hx]; exact cantor _) this

name: sum_lt_prod
statement: theorem sum_lt_prod {ι} (f g : ι → Cardinal) (H : ∀ i, f i < g i) : sum f < prod g
proof:
:=
  lt_of_not_ge fun ⟨F⟩ => by
    have : Inhabited (∀ i : ι, (g i).out) := by
      refine ⟨fun i => Classical.choice <| mk_ne_zero_iff.1 ?_⟩
      rw [mk_out]
      exact (H i).ne_bot
    let G := invFun F
    have sG : Surjective G := invFun_surjective F.2
    choose C hc using
      show ∀ i, ∃ b, ∀ a, G ⟨i, a⟩ i ≠ b by
        intro i
        simp only [not_exists.symm, not_forall.symm]
        refine fun h => (H i).not_ge ?_
        rw [← mk_out (f i), ← mk_out (g i)]
        exact ⟨Embedding.ofSurjective _ h⟩
    let ⟨⟨i, a⟩, h⟩ := sG C
    exact hc i a (congr_fun h _)

name: mul_eq_self
statement: theorem mul_eq_self {c : Cardinal} (hc : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : c * c = c
proof:
:= by
  
  induction c using WellFoundedLT.induction with | ind c IH
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (by simpa using mul_le_mul_right (one_le_aleph0.trans hc) c)
  
  induction c using Cardinal.inductionOn with | mk α
  obtain ⟨_, _, hα⟩ := exists_ord_eq_type_lt α
  have : NoMaxOrder α := by
    rw [← isSuccPrelimit_type_lt_iff, ← hα]
    exact (isSuccLimit_ord hc).isSuccPrelimit
  
  let g : α × α → α := uncurry max
  let f : α × α ↪ α ×ₗ (α ×ₗ α) := ⟨fun p ↦ toLex (g p, toLex p), fun p q ↦ congrArg Prod.snd⟩
  let s := f ⁻¹'o (· < ·)
  have : IsWellOrder _ s := (RelEmbedding.preimage ..).isWellOrder
  
  
  
  refine @card_le_card (type s) (typeLT α) <| le_of_forall_lt fun o h ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := typein_surj s h
  obtain ⟨q, hq'⟩ := exists_gt (g p)
  rw [← hα, lt_ord]
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (b := #(Iio q) * #(Iio q))
  · apply (Set.embeddingOfSubset { x | s x p } ..).cardinal_le.trans_eq (mk_setProd ..)
    simp [s, f, Prod.Lex.lt_iff, subset_def]
    grind
  rcases lt_or_ge #(Iio q) ℵ₀ with hq | hq
  · exact (mul_lt_aleph0 hq hq).trans_le hc
  · have := mk_Iio_lt q hα
    rwa [IH _ this hq]

name: mul_eq_max
statement: theorem mul_eq_max {a b : Cardinal} (ha : ℵ₀ ≤ a) (hb : ℵ₀ ≤ b) : a * b = max a b
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
      (mul_eq_self (ha.trans (le_max_left a b)) ▸
        mul_le_mul' (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)) <|
    max_le (by simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_right (one_le_aleph0.trans hb) a)
      (by simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_left (one_le_aleph0.trans ha) b)

name: mul_lt_of_lt
statement: theorem mul_lt_of_lt {a b c : Cardinal} (hc : ℵ₀ ≤ c) (ha : a < c) (hb : b < c) : a * b < c
proof:
:= by
  apply (mul_le_mul' (le_max_left a b) (le_max_right a b)).trans_lt
  obtain h | h := lt_or_ge (max a b) ℵ₀
  · exact (mul_lt_aleph0 h h).trans_le hc
  · rw [mul_eq_self h]
    exact max_lt ha hb

:= by

name: mul_eq_max_of_aleph0_le_left
statement:
theorem mul_eq_max_of_aleph0_le_left {a b : Cardinal} (h : ℵ₀ ≤ a) (h' : b ≠ 0) :
    a * b = max a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt ℵ₀ b with hb | hb
  · exact mul_eq_max h hb
  refine (mul_le_max_of_aleph0_le_left h).antisymm ?_
  have : b ≤ a := hb.le.trans h
  rw [max_eq_left this]
  convert! mul_le_mul_right (Cardinal.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr h') a
  rw [mul_one]

proof:

name: mul_le_max
statement: theorem mul_le_max (a b : Cardinal) : a * b ≤ max (max a b) ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha0); · simp
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb0); · simp
  rcases le_or_gt ℵ₀ a with ha | ha
  · rw [mul_eq_max_of_aleph0_le_left ha hb0]
    exact le_max_left _ _
  · rcases le_or_gt ℵ₀ b with hb | hb
    · rw [mul_comm, mul_eq_max_of_aleph0_le_left hb ha0, max_comm]
      exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact le_max_of_le_right (mul_lt_aleph0 ha hb).le

name: mul_eq_left
statement: theorem mul_eq_left {a b : Cardinal} (ha : ℵ₀ ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ a) (hb' : b ≠ 0) : a * b = a

name: mul_eq_left_iff
statement: theorem mul_eq_left_iff {a b : Cardinal} : a * b = a ↔ max ℵ₀ b ≤ a ∧ b ≠ 0 ∨ b = 1 ∨ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [max_le_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases le_or_gt ℵ₀ a with ha | ha
    · have : a ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl
        exact ha.not_gt aleph0_pos
      left
      rw [and_assoc]
      use ha
      constructor
      · rw [← not_lt]
        exact fun hb => ne_of_gt (hb.trans_le (le_mul_left this)) h
      · rintro rfl
        apply this
        rw [mul_zero] at h
        exact h.symm
    right
    by_cases h2a : a = 0
    · exact Or.inr h2a
    have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      apply h2a
      rw [mul_zero] at h
      exact h.symm
    left
    rw [← h, mul_lt_aleph0_iff, lt_aleph0, lt_aleph0] at ha
    rcases ha with (rfl | rfl | ⟨⟨n, rfl⟩, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩)
    · contradiction
    · contradiction
    rw [← Ne] at h2a
    rw [← Cardinal.one_le_iff_ne_zero] at h2a hb
    norm_cast at h2a hb h ⊢
    apply le_antisymm _ hb
    rw [← not_lt]
    apply fun h2b => ne_of_gt _ h
    conv_rhs => left; rw [← mul_one n]
    rw [Nat.mul_lt_mul_left]
    · exact id
    apply Nat.lt_of_succ_le h2a
  · rintro (⟨⟨ha, hab⟩, hb⟩ | rfl | rfl)
    · rw [mul_eq_max_of_aleph0_le_left ha hb, max_eq_left hab]
    all_goals simp

name: add_eq_self
statement: theorem add_eq_self {c : Cardinal} (h : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : c + c = c
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm

    (self_le_add_left c c)

    (lt_or_ge (max a b) ℵ₀).elim (fun h => (add_lt_aleph0 h h).trans_le hc) fun h => by

name: add_eq_left_iff
statement: theorem add_eq_left_iff {a b : Cardinal} : a + b = a ↔ max ℵ₀ b ≤ a ∨ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [max_le_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases le_or_gt ℵ₀ a with ha | ha
    · left
      use ha
      rw [← not_lt]
      apply fun hb => ne_of_gt _ h
      intro hb
      exact hb.trans_le (self_le_add_left b a)
    right
    rw [← h, add_lt_aleph0_iff, lt_aleph0, lt_aleph0] at ha
    rcases ha with ⟨⟨n, rfl⟩, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩

    rw [← add_right_inj, h, add_zero]

name: eq_of_add_eq_add_left
statement:
protected theorem eq_of_add_eq_add_left {a b c : Cardinal} (h : a + b = a + c) (ha : a < ℵ₀) :
    b = c
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt ℵ₀ b with hb | hb
  · have : a < b := ha.trans_le hb
    rw [add_eq_right hb this.le, eq_comm] at h
    rw [eq_of_add_eq_of_aleph0_le h this hb]
  · have hc : c < ℵ₀ := by
      rw [← not_le]
      intro hc
      apply lt_irrefl ℵ₀
      apply (hc.trans (self_le_add_left _ a)).trans_lt
      rw [← h]
      apply add_lt_aleph0 ha hb
    rw [lt_aleph0] at *
    rcases ha with ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rcases hb with ⟨m, rfl⟩
    rcases hc with ⟨k, rfl⟩
    norm_cast at h ⊢
    apply add_left_cancel h

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨α, _, hα⟩ := exists_ord_eq_type_lt α
  refine ⟨LT.lt, fun x ↦ ?_, fun y ↦ mk_Iio_lt _ hα⟩
  simpa using! mk_Iic_lt _ hα (aleph0_le_mk _)

name: ciSup_add
statement:
protected theorem ciSup_add (hf : BddAbove (range f)) (c : Cardinal.{v}) :
    (⨆ i, f i) + c = ⨆ i, f i + c
proof:
:= by
  have (i : ι) : f i + c ≤ (⨆ i, f i) + c := by grw [le_ciSup hf i]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (ciSup_le' this)
  have bdd : BddAbove (range (f · + c)) := ⟨_, forall_mem_range.mpr this⟩
  obtain hs | hs := lt_or_ge (⨆ i, f i) ℵ₀
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_not_isSuccLimit hf (not_isSuccLimit_of_lt_aleph0 hs)
    exact hi ▸ le_ciSup bdd i
  rw [add_eq_max hs, max_le_iff]
  exact ⟨ciSup_mono bdd fun i ↦ self_le_add_right _ c,
    (self_le_add_left _ _).trans (le_ciSup bdd <| Classical.arbitrary ι)⟩

statement:

    c + (⨆ i, f i) = ⨆ i, c + f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, Cardinal.ciSup_add f hf]; simp_rw [add_comm]

name: ciSup_add_ciSup
statement:

    (hg : BddAbove (range g)) :
    (⨆ i, f i) + (⨆ j, g j) = ⨆ (i) (j), f i + g j
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Cardinal.ciSup_add f hf, Cardinal.add_ciSup g hg]

name: ciSup_mul
statement: protected theorem ciSup_mul (c : Cardinal.{v}) : (⨆ i, f i) * c = ⨆ i, f i * c
proof:
:= by
  cases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι; · simp
  obtain rfl | h0 := eq_or_ne c 0; · simp
  by_cases hf : BddAbove (range f); swap
  · have hfc : ¬ BddAbove (range (f · * c)) := fun bdd ↦ hf
      ⟨⨆ i, f i * c, forall_mem_range.mpr fun i ↦ (le_mul_right h0).trans (le_ciSup bdd i)⟩
    simp [iSup, csSup_of_not_bddAbove, hf, hfc]
  have (i : ι) : f i * c ≤ (⨆ i, f i) * c := by grw [← le_ciSup hf i]
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (ciSup_le' this)
  have bdd : BddAbove (range (f · * c)) := ⟨_, forall_mem_range.mpr this⟩
  obtain hs | hs := lt_or_ge (⨆ i, f i) ℵ₀
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_eq_ciSup_of_not_isSuccLimit hf (not_isSuccLimit_of_lt_aleph0 hs)
    exact hi ▸ le_ciSup bdd i
  rw [mul_eq_max_of_aleph0_le_left hs h0, max_le_iff]
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_ciSup' (one_lt_aleph0.trans_le hs)
  exact ⟨ciSup_mono bdd fun i ↦ le_mul_right h0,
    (le_mul_left (zero_lt_one.trans hi).ne').trans (le_ciSup bdd i)⟩

name: mul_ciSup
statement: protected theorem mul_ciSup (c : Cardinal.{v}) : c * (⨆ i, f i) = ⨆ i, c * f i

name: sum_eq_lift_iSup_of_lift_mk_le_lift_iSup
statement:
theorem sum_eq_lift_iSup_of_lift_mk_le_lift_iSup [Small.{v} ι] {f : ι → Cardinal.{v}} (hι : ℵ₀ ≤ #ι)
    (h : lift.{v} #ι ≤ lift.{u} (⨆ i, f i)) : sum f = lift (⨆ i, f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_iSup bddAbove_of_small] at h
  apply (lift_iSup_le_sum f).antisymm'
  convert! sum_le_lift_mk_mul_iSup_lift f
  rw [mul_eq_max (aleph0_le_lift.mpr hι) ((aleph0_le_lift.mpr hι).trans h), max_eq_right h,
    lift_iSup bddAbove_of_small]

name: sum_eq_iSup_of_lift_mk_le_iSup

theorem sum_eq_iSup_of_lift_mk_le_iSup {f : ι → Cardinal.{max u v}} (hι : ℵ₀ ≤ #ι)
    (h : lift.{v} #ι ≤ ⨆ i, f i) : sum f = ⨆ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_id'.{u, v} (iSup _)]
  apply sum_eq_lift_iSup_of_lift_mk_le_lift_iSup hι
  rwa [lift_umax, lift_id'.{u, v}]

name: add_lt_add
statement:
protected lemma add_lt_add {κ₁ κ₂ μ₁ μ₂ : Cardinal}
    (hκ : κ₁ < κ₂) (hμ : μ₁ < μ₂) : κ₁ + μ₁ < κ₂ + μ₂
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt ℵ₀ (κ₂ + μ₂) with hinf | hfin
  · refine add_lt_of_lt hinf ?_ ?_ <;> apply lt_of_lt_of_le <;> solve | assumption | simp
  · have hfin_ : κ₂ < ℵ₀ ∧ μ₂ < ℵ₀ := add_lt_aleph0_iff.1 hfin
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt
    · exact (add_le_add_iff_of_lt_aleph0 (hμ.trans hfin_.right)).mpr hκ.le
    · simpa [add_comm] using (add_lt_add_iff_of_right_lt_aleph0 hfin_.left).mpr hμ

name: natCast_mul_strictMono
statement: lemma natCast_mul_strictMono {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : StrictMono fun a : Cardinal ↦ n * a
proof:
:= by
  match n, hn with
  | 1, _ => simpa using! strictMono_id
  | (n + 1) + 1, hneq1 =>
    intro a μ hlt
    push_cast
    conv_lhs => rw [add_mul, one_mul]
    conv_rhs => rw [add_mul, one_mul]
    refine Cardinal.add_lt_add ?_ hlt
    simpa using! (natCast_mul_strictMono (Nat.succ_ne_zero n) hlt)

name: pow_le
statement: theorem pow_le {κ μ : Cardinal.{u}} (H1 : ℵ₀ ≤ κ) (H2 : μ < ℵ₀) : κ ^ μ ≤ κ
proof:
:=
  let ⟨n, H3⟩ := lt_aleph0.1 H2
  H3.symm ▸
    Quotient.inductionOn κ
      (fun α H1 =>
        Nat.recOn n
          (by grw [Nat.cast_zero, power_zero, one_lt_aleph0, H1])
          fun n ih => by grw [Nat.cast_succ, power_add, power_one, ih, mul_eq_self H1])
      H1

statement: theorem pow_eq {κ μ : Cardinal.{u}} (H1 : ℵ₀ ≤ κ) (H2 : 1 ≤ μ) (H3 : μ < ℵ₀) : κ ^ μ = κ

name: power_self_eq
statement: theorem power_self_eq {c : Cardinal} (h : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : c ^ c = 2 ^ c
proof:
:= by
  apply ((power_le_power_right <| (cantor c).le).trans _).antisymm
  · exact power_le_power_right (natCast_le_aleph0.trans h)
  · rw [← power_mul, mul_eq_self h]

name: prod_eq_two_power
statement:
theorem prod_eq_two_power {ι : Type u} [Infinite ι] {c : ι → Cardinal.{v}} (h₁ : ∀ i, 2 ≤ c i)
    (h₂ : ∀ i, lift.{u} (c i) ≤ lift.{v} #ι) : prod c = 2 ^ lift.{v} #ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_id'.{u, v} (prod.{u, v} c), lift_prod, ← lift_two_power]
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (prod_le_prod _ _ h₂).trans_eq ?_
    rw [prod_const, lift_lift, ← lift_power, power_self_eq (aleph0_le_mk ι), lift_umax.{u, v}]
  · rw [← prod_const', lift_prod]
    refine prod_le_prod _ _ fun i => ?_
    rw [lift_two, ← lift_two.{u, v}, lift_le]
    exact h₁ i

proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt ℵ₀ c with hc | hc
  · exact le_max_of_le_left (power_nat_le hc)
  · exact le_max_of_le_right (power_lt_aleph0 hc natCast_lt_aleph0).le

statement: lemma power_le_aleph0 {a b : Cardinal.{u}} (ha : a ≤ ℵ₀) (hb : b < ℵ₀) : a ^ b ≤ ℵ₀

:= by
  lift b to ℕ using hb; simpa [ha] using power_nat_le_max (c := a)

name: powerlt_aleph0
statement: theorem powerlt_aleph0 {c : Cardinal} (h : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : c ^< ℵ₀ = c
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [powerlt_le]
    exact fun _ a ↦ pow_le h a
  convert! le_powerlt c one_lt_aleph0; rw [power_one]

name: powerlt_aleph0_le
statement: theorem powerlt_aleph0_le (c : Cardinal) : c ^< ℵ₀ ≤ max c ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt ℵ₀ c with h | h
  · rw [powerlt_aleph0 h]
    apply le_max_left
  rw [powerlt_le]
  exact fun c' hc' => (power_lt_aleph0 h hc').le.trans (le_max_right _ _)

name: mk_perm_eq_self_power
statement: theorem mk_perm_eq_self_power : #(Equiv.Perm α) = #α ^ #α
proof:
:=
  ((mk_equiv_le_embedding α α).trans (mk_embedding_le_arrow α α)).antisymm <| by
    suffices Nonempty ((α → Bool) ↪ Equiv.Perm (α × Bool)) by
      obtain ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (α ≃ α × Bool) := by simp [← Cardinal.eq, mul_two]
      simp only [← le_def, mk_pi, mk_fintype, Fintype.card_bool, Nat.cast_ofNat,
        prod_const, lift_ofNat, lift_uzero] at this
      rwa [← power_def, power_self_eq (aleph0_le_mk α), e.permCongr.cardinal_eq]
    refine ⟨⟨fun f ↦ Involutive.toPerm (fun x ↦ ⟨x.1, xor (f x.1) x.2⟩) fun x ↦ ?_, fun f g h ↦ ?_⟩⟩
    · simp_rw [← Bool.xor_assoc, Bool.xor_self, Bool.false_xor]
    · ext a; rw [← (f a).xor_false, ← (g a).xor_false]; exact congr(($h ⟨a, false⟩).2)

statement: theorem mk_perm_eq_two_power : #(Equiv.Perm α) = 2 ^ #α

name: mk_equiv_eq_arrow_of_lift_eq
statement:
theorem mk_equiv_eq_arrow_of_lift_eq (leq : lift.{v} #α = lift.{u} #β') :
    #(α ≃ β') = #(α → β')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := lift_mk_eq'.mp leq
  have e₁ := lift_mk_eq'.mpr ⟨.equivCongr (.refl α) e⟩
  have e₂ := lift_mk_eq'.mpr ⟨.arrowCongr (.refl α) e⟩
  rw [lift_id'.{u, v}] at e₁ e₂
  rw [← e₁, ← e₂, lift_inj, mk_perm_eq_self_power, power_def]

name: mk_embedding_eq_arrow_of_lift_le
statement:
theorem mk_embedding_eq_arrow_of_lift_le (lle : lift.{u} #β' ≤ lift.{v} #α) :
    #(β' ↪ α) = #(β' → α)
proof:
:=
  (mk_embedding_le_arrow _ _).antisymm <| by
    conv_rhs => rw [← (Equiv.embeddingCongr (.refl _)
      (Cardinal.eq.mp <| mul_eq_self <| aleph0_le_mk α).some).cardinal_eq]
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := lift_mk_le'.mp lle
    exact ⟨⟨fun f ↦ ⟨fun b ↦ ⟨e b, f b⟩, fun _ _ h ↦ e.injective congr(Prod.fst $h)⟩,
      fun f g h ↦ funext fun b ↦ congr(Prod.snd <| $h b)⟩⟩

name: mk_embedding_eq_arrow_of_le
statement: theorem mk_embedding_eq_arrow_of_le (le : #β ≤ #α) : #(β ↪ α) = #(β → α)

name: mk_surjective_eq_arrow_of_lift_le
statement:
theorem mk_surjective_eq_arrow_of_lift_le (lle : lift.{u} #β' ≤ lift.{v} #α) :
    #{f : α → β' | Surjective f} = #(α → β')
proof:
:=
  (mk_set_le _).antisymm <|
    have ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (α ≃ α ⊕ β') := by
      simp_rw [← lift_mk_eq', mk_sum, lift_add, lift_lift]; rw [lift_umax.{u, v}, eq_comm]
      exact add_eq_left (aleph0_le_lift.mpr <| aleph0_le_mk α) lle
    ⟨⟨fun f ↦ ⟨fun a ↦ (e a).elim f id, fun b ↦ ⟨e.symm (.inr b), congr_arg _ (e.right_inv _)⟩⟩,
      fun f g h ↦ funext fun a ↦ by
        simpa only [e.apply_symm_apply] using! congr_fun (Subtype.ext_iff.mp h) (e.symm <| .inl a)⟩⟩

statement: theorem mk_surjective_eq_arrow_of_le (le : #β ≤ #α) : #{f : α → β | Surjective f} = #(α → β)

name: mk_list_eq_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_list_eq_mk (α : Type u) [Infinite α] : #(List α) = #α
proof:
:=
  have H1 : ℵ₀ ≤ #α := aleph0_le_mk α
  Eq.symm <|
    le_antisymm ((le_def _ _).2 ⟨⟨fun a => [a], fun _ => by simp⟩⟩) <|
      calc
        #(List α) = sum fun n : ℕ => #α ^ (n : Cardinal.{u}) := mk_list_eq_sum_pow α
        _ ≤ sum fun _ : ℕ => #α := sum_le_sum _ _ fun n => pow_le H1 natCast_lt_aleph0
        _ = #α := by simp [H1]

name: mk_list_eq_aleph0
statement: theorem mk_list_eq_aleph0 (α : Type u) [Countable α] [Nonempty α] : #(List α) = ℵ₀

name: mk_list_eq_max
statement: theorem mk_list_eq_max (α : Type u) [Nonempty α] : #(List α) = max ℵ₀ #α
proof:
:= by
  cases finite_or_infinite α
  · rw [mk_list_eq_aleph0, eq_comm, max_eq_left]
    exact mk_le_aleph0
  · rw [mk_list_eq_mk, eq_comm, max_eq_right]
    exact aleph0_le_mk α

name: mk_list_eq_max_mk_aleph0
statement: theorem mk_list_eq_max_mk_aleph0 (α : Type u) [Nonempty α] : #(List α) = max #α ℵ₀
