statement: theorem sum_pow_eq_max_aleph0 {x : Cardinal} (h : x ≠ 0) : sum (fun n ↦ x ^ n) = max ℵ₀ x
proof:
:= by
  have := nonempty_out h
  conv_lhs => rw [← x.mk_out, ← mk_list_eq_sum_pow, mk_list_eq_max, mk_out]

name: mk_list_le_max
statement: theorem mk_list_le_max (α : Type u) : #(List α) ≤ max ℵ₀ #α
proof:
:= by
  cases finite_or_infinite α
  · exact mk_le_aleph0.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · rw [mk_list_eq_mk]
    apply le_max_right

name: sum_pow_le_max_aleph0
statement: theorem sum_pow_le_max_aleph0 (x : Cardinal) : sum (fun n ↦ x ^ n) ≤ max ℵ₀ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← x.mk_out, ← mk_list_eq_sum_pow]
  exact mk_list_le_max _

name: mk_finset_of_infinite
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_finset_of_infinite (α : Type u) [Infinite α] : #(Finset α) = #α
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Eq.symm <|
    le_antisymm (mk_le_of_injective fun _ _ => Finset.singleton_inj.1) <|
      calc
        #(Finset α) ≤ #(List α) := mk_le_of_surjective List.toFinset_surjective
        _ = #α := mk_list_eq_mk α

name: mk_bounded_set_le_of_infinite
statement:
theorem mk_bounded_set_le_of_infinite (α : Type u) [Infinite α] (c : Cardinal) :
    #{ t : Set α // #t ≤ c } ≤ #α ^ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← add_one_eq (aleph0_le_mk α)]
  induction c using Cardinal.inductionOn with | _ β
  fapply mk_le_of_surjective
  · intro f
    use Sum.inl ⁻¹' range f
    refine le_trans (mk_preimage_of_injective _ _ fun x y => Sum.inl.inj) ?_
    apply mk_range_le
  rintro ⟨s, ⟨g⟩⟩
  classical
  use fun y => if h : ∃ x : s, g x = y then Sum.inl (Classical.choose h).val
               else Sum.inr (ULift.up 0)
  apply Subtype.ext; ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, h⟩
    dsimp only at h
    by_cases h' : ∃ z : s, g z = y
    · rw [dite_eq_left h'] at h
      cases Sum.inl.inj h
      exact (Classical.choose h').2
    · rw [dite_eq_right h'] at h
      cases h
  · intro h
    have : ∃ z : s, g z = g ⟨x, h⟩ := ⟨⟨x, h⟩, rfl⟩
    use g ⟨x, h⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [dite_eq_left this]
    congr
    suffices Classical.choose this = ⟨x, h⟩ from congr_arg Subtype.val this
    apply g.2
    exact Classical.choose_spec this

name: mk_bounded_set_le
statement:
theorem mk_bounded_set_le (α : Type u) (c : Cardinal) :
    #{ t : Set α // #t ≤ c } ≤ max #α ℵ₀ ^ c
proof:
:= by
  trans #{ t : Set ((ULift.{u} ℕ) ⊕ α) // #t ≤ c }
  · refine ⟨Embedding.subtypeMap ?_ ?_⟩
    · apply Embedding.image
      use Sum.inr
      apply Sum.inr.inj
    intro s hs
    exact mk_image_le.trans hs
  apply (mk_bounded_set_le_of_infinite ((ULift.{u} ℕ) ⊕ α) c).trans
  rw [max_comm, ← add_eq_max] <;> rfl

name: mk_bounded_subset_le
statement:
theorem mk_bounded_subset_le {α : Type u} (s : Set α) (c : Cardinal.{u}) :
    #{ t : Set α // t ⊆ s ∧ #t ≤ c } ≤ max #s ℵ₀ ^ c
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans ?_ (mk_bounded_set_le s c)
  refine ⟨Embedding.codRestrict _ ?_ ?_⟩
  · use fun t => (↑) ⁻¹' t.1
    rintro ⟨t, ht1, ht2⟩ ⟨t', h1t', h2t'⟩ h
    apply Subtype.ext
    dsimp only at h ⊢
    refine (preimage_eq_preimage' ?_ ?_).1 h <;> rw [Subtype.range_coe] <;> assumption
  rintro ⟨t, _, h2t⟩; exact (mk_preimage_of_injective _ _ Subtype.val_injective).trans h2t

name: mk_sdiff_eq_left'
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mk_sdiff_eq_left' (hs : s.Infinite) (hst : #(s ∩ t : Set α) < #s) :
    #(s \ t : Set α) = #s
proof:
:= by
  refine (mk_le_mk_of_subset Set.sdiff_subset).eq_of_not_lt
    fun h ↦ (add_lt_of_lt (by simpa) hst h).not_ge ?_
  grw [← mk_union_le .., Set.inter_union_sdiff]

name: mk_sdiff_eq_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mk_sdiff_eq_left (hs : s.Infinite) (hts : #t < #s) : #(s \ t : Set α) = #s

@[simp]
lemma mk_sdiff_eq_left_of_finite' (hs : s.Infinite) (hst : (s ∩ t : Set α).Finite) :

statement:
@[simp]
lemma mk_sdiff_eq_left_of_finite (hs : s.Infinite) (ht : t.Finite) : #(s \ t : Set α) = #s

name: mk_compl_of_infinite
statement:
theorem mk_compl_of_infinite {α : Type*} [Infinite α] (s : Set α) (h2 : #s < #α) :
    #(sᶜ : Set α) = #α
proof:
:= by
  rw [compl_eq_univ_sdiff, mk_sdiff_eq_left Set.infinite_univ (by rwa [mk_univ]), mk_univ]

name: mk_compl_finset_of_infinite
statement:
theorem mk_compl_finset_of_infinite {α : Type*} [Infinite α] (s : Finset α) :

proof:
:= by

name: mk_compl_eq_mk_compl_infinite
statement:
theorem mk_compl_eq_mk_compl_infinite {α : Type*} [Infinite α] {s t : Set α} (hs : #s < #α)
    (ht : #t < #α) : #(sᶜ : Set α) = #(tᶜ : Set α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_compl_of_infinite s hs, mk_compl_of_infinite t ht]

name: mk_compl_eq_mk_compl_finite_lift
statement:
theorem mk_compl_eq_mk_compl_finite_lift {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Finite α] {s : Set α}
    {t : Set β} (h1 : (lift.{v, u} #α) = (lift.{u, v} #β))
    (h2 : lift.{v, u} #s = lift.{u, v} #t) :
    lift.{v} #(sᶜ : Set α) = lift.{u} #(tᶜ : Set β)
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype α
  rcases lift_mk_eq'.1 h1 with ⟨e⟩; let : Fintype β := Fintype.ofEquiv α e
  replace h1 : Fintype.card α = Fintype.card β := (Fintype.ofEquiv_card _).symm
  classical
    lift s to Finset α using s.toFinite
    lift t to Finset β using t.toFinite
    simp only [Finset.coe_sort_coe, mk_fintype, Fintype.card_coe, lift_natCast, Nat.cast_inj] at h2
    simp only [← Finset.coe_compl, Finset.coe_sort_coe, mk_coe_finset, Finset.card_compl,
      lift_natCast, h1, h2]

name: mk_compl_eq_mk_compl_finite
statement:
theorem mk_compl_eq_mk_compl_finite {α β : Type u} [Finite α] {s : Set α} {t : Set β}
    (h1 : #α = #β) (h : #s = #t) : #(sᶜ : Set α) = #(tᶜ : Set β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_inj.{u, u}]
  apply mk_compl_eq_mk_compl_finite_lift.{u, u}
  <;> rwa [lift_inj]

name: mk_compl_eq_mk_compl_finite_same
statement:
theorem mk_compl_eq_mk_compl_finite_same {α : Type u} [Finite α] {s t : Set α} (h : #s = #t) :
    #(sᶜ : Set α) = #(tᶜ : Set α)

name: extend_function
statement:
theorem extend_function {α β : Type*} {s : Set α} (f : s ↪ β)
    (h : Nonempty ((sᶜ : Set α) ≃ ((range f)ᶜ : Set β))) : ∃ g : α ≃ β, ∀ x : s, g x = f x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := h; obtain ⟨g⟩ := this
  let h : α ≃ β :=
    (Set.sumCompl (s : Set α)).symm.trans
      ((sumCongr (Equiv.ofInjective f f.2) g).trans (Set.sumCompl (range f)))
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩; rintro ⟨x, hx⟩; simp [h, Set.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_mem, hx]

name: extend_function_finite
statement:
theorem extend_function_finite {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [Finite α] {s : Set α} (f : s ↪ β)
    (h : Nonempty (α ≃ β)) : ∃ g : α ≃ β, ∀ x : s, g x = f x
proof:
:= by
  apply extend_function.{u, v} f
  rw [← lift_mk_eq'] at h
  rw [← lift_mk_eq', mk_compl_eq_mk_compl_finite_lift h]
  rw [mk_range_eq_of_injective]; exact f.2

name: extend_function_of_lt
statement:
theorem extend_function_of_lt {α β : Type*} {s : Set α} (f : s ↪ β) (hs : #s < #α)
    (h : Nonempty (α ≃ β)) : ∃ g : α ≃ β, ∀ x : s, g x = f x
proof:
:= by
  cases fintypeOrInfinite α
  · exact extend_function_finite f h
  · apply extend_function f
    obtain ⟨g⟩ := id h
    have := Infinite.of_injective _ g.injective
    rw [← lift_mk_eq'] at h ⊢
    rwa [mk_compl_of_infinite s hs, mk_compl_of_infinite]
    rwa [← lift_lt, mk_range_eq_of_injective f.injective, ← h, lift_lt]

name: mk_preimage_down
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mk_preimage_down {s : Set α} : #(ULift.down.{v} ⁻¹' s) = lift.{v} (#s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_uLift, Cardinal.eq]
  constructor
  let f : ULift.down ⁻¹' s → ULift s := fun x ↦ ULift.up (restrictPreimage s ULift.down x)
  have : Function.Bijective f :=
    ULift.up_bijective.comp (restrictPreimage_bijective _ (ULift.down_bijective))
  exact Equiv.ofBijective f this

name: prod_eq_of_fintype
statement:
theorem prod_eq_of_fintype {α : Type u} [h : Fintype α] (f : α → Cardinal.{v}) :
    prod f = Cardinal.lift.{u} (∏ i, f i)
proof:
:= by
  revert f
  refine Fintype.induction_empty_option ?_ ?_ ?_ α (h_fintype := h)
  · intro α β hβ e h f
    let := Fintype.ofEquiv β e.symm
    rw [← e.prod_comp f, ← h]
    exact mk_congr (e.piCongrLeft _).symm
  · intro f
    rw [Fintype.univ_pempty, Finset.prod_empty, lift_one, Cardinal.prod, mk_eq_one]
  · intro α hα h f
    rw [Cardinal.prod, mk_congr Equiv.piOptionEquivProd, mk_prod, lift_umax.{v, u}, mk_out, ←
        Cardinal.prod, lift_prod, Fintype.prod_option, lift_mul, ← h fun a => f (some a)]
    simp only [lift_id]

name: sInf_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma sInf_eq_zero_iff {s : Set Cardinal} : sInf s = 0 ↔ s = ∅ ∨ ∃ a ∈ s, a = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hne
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr ⟨sInf s, csInf_mem hne, h⟩
  · rcases h with rfl | ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    · exact Cardinal.sInf_empty
    · exact eq_bot_iff.2 (csInf_le' ha)

name: bddAbove_iff_small
statement: theorem bddAbove_iff_small {s : Set Cardinal.{u}} : BddAbove s ↔ Small.{u} s
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => @small_subset _ (Iic a) s (fun _ h => ha h) _, by
    rintro ⟨ι, ⟨e⟩⟩
    use sum.{u, u} fun x ↦ e.symm x
    intro a ha
    simpa using le_sum (fun x ↦ e.symm x) (e ⟨a, ha⟩)⟩

name: bddAbove_image
statement:
theorem bddAbove_image (f : Cardinal.{u} → Cardinal.{max u v}) {s : Set Cardinal.{u}}

proof:
:= by

proof:
:= by

name: sum_le_lift_mk_mul_iSup_lift
statement:
theorem sum_le_lift_mk_mul_iSup_lift {ι : Type u} (f : ι → Cardinal.{v}) :
    sum f ≤ lift #ι * ⨆ i, lift (f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (sum f).lift_id, lift_sum, ← lift_umax.{u, v}, ← (⨆ i, lift (f i)).lift_id,
    lift_umax.{max v u, u}, ← sum_const]
  refine sum_le_sum _ _ fun i => ?_
  rw [lift_umax.{v, u}]
  exact le_ciSup bddAbove_of_small i

proof:

statement: theorem sum_le_mk_mul_iSup {ι : Type u} (f : ι → Cardinal.{u}) : sum f ≤ #ι * ⨆ i, f i

name: lift_sSup
statement:
theorem lift_sSup {s : Set Cardinal} (hs : BddAbove s) :
    lift.{u} (sSup s) = sSup (lift.{u} '' s)
proof:
:= by
  apply ((le_csSup_iff' (bddAbove_image.{_, u} _ hs)).2 fun c hc => _).antisymm (csSup_le' _)
  · intro c hc
    by_contra h
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Cardinal.mem_range_lift_of_le (not_le.1 h).le
    simp_rw [lift_le] at h hc
    rw [csSup_le_iff' hs] at h
    exact h fun a ha => lift_le.1 <| hc (mem_image_of_mem _ ha)
  · rintro i ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
    exact lift_le.2 (le_csSup hs hj)

name: lift_iSup
statement:
theorem lift_iSup {ι : Type v} {f : ι → Cardinal.{w}} (hf : BddAbove (range f)) :
    lift.{u} (iSup f) = ⨆ i, lift.{u} (f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup, iSup, lift_sSup hf, ← range_comp]
  simp [Function.comp_def]

name: lift_iSup_le
statement:
theorem lift_iSup_le {ι : Type v} {f : ι → Cardinal.{w}} {t : Cardinal} (hf : BddAbove (range f))
    (w : ∀ i, lift.{u} (f i) ≤ t) : lift.{u} (iSup f) ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_iSup hf]
  exact ciSup_le' w

name: lift_iSup_le_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_iSup_le_iff {ι : Type v} {f : ι → Cardinal.{w}} (hf : BddAbove (range f))
    {t : Cardinal} : lift.{u} (iSup f) ≤ t ↔ ∀ i, lift.{u} (f i) ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_iSup hf]
  exact ciSup_le_iff' (bddAbove_range_comp.{_, _, u} hf _)

name: lift_iSup_le_lift_iSup
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_iSup hf, lift_iSup hf']
  exact ciSup_mono_of_forall_exists' (bddAbove_range_comp.{_, _, w} hf' _) fun i => ⟨_, h i⟩

name: lift_iSup_le_lift_iSup'
lift_iSup_le_sum
statement:
theorem lift_iSup_le_sum {ι : Type u} [Small.{v} ι] (f : ι → Cardinal.{v}) :
    lift (⨆ i, f i) ≤ sum f
proof:

  exact ciSup_le' fun i => lift_le_sum f i

@[simp, norm_cast]
lemma succ_natCast (n : ℕ) : Order.succ (n : Cardinal) = n + 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (succ_le_of_lt ?_).antisymm (add_one_le_of_lt <| lt_succ _)
  rw [← Nat.cast_succ]
  exact Nat.cast_lt.2 (Nat.lt_succ_self _)

theorem exists_finset_eq_card {α} {n : ℕ} (h : n ≤ #α) :
    ∃ s : Finset α, n = s.card
proof:
:= by
  obtain hα | hα := finite_or_infinite α
  · let hα := Fintype.ofFinite α
    obtain ⟨t, -, rfl⟩ := @Finset.exists_subset_card_eq α .univ n <| by simpa using h
    exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Infinite.exists_subset_card_eq α n

proof:

  exact (cantor a).trans_le (power_le_power_right hb)

  exact ⟨⟨(↑), fun a b => Fin.ext⟩⟩

name: lt_aleph0
statement: theorem lt_aleph0 {c : Cardinal} : c < ℵ₀ ↔ ∃ n : ℕ, c = n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    rcases lt_lift_iff.1 h with ⟨c, h', rfl⟩
    rcases le_mk_iff_exists_set.1 h'.1 with ⟨S, rfl⟩
    suffices S.Finite by
      lift S to Finset ℕ using this
      simp
    contrapose! h'
    have := Infinite.to_subtype h'
    exact ⟨Infinite.natEmbedding S⟩, fun ⟨_, e⟩ => e.symm ▸ natCast_lt_aleph0⟩

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Cardinal.lt_aleph0.mp h
  rw [hn, succ_natCast]

name: aleph0_le
statement:
theorem aleph0_le {c : Cardinal} : ℵ₀ ≤ c ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, ↑n ≤ c where
  mp h _
proof:
:= natCast_le_aleph0.trans h
  mpr h := le_of_not_gt fun hn => by
    rcases lt_aleph0.1 hn with ⟨n, rfl⟩
    exact (Nat.lt_succ_self _).not_ge (Nat.cast_le.1 (h (n + 1)))

name: isSuccPrelimit_aleph0
statement: theorem isSuccPrelimit_aleph0 : IsSuccPrelimit ℵ₀
proof:
:=
  isSuccPrelimit_of_succ_lt fun a ha => by
    rcases lt_aleph0.1 ha with ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rw [succ_natCast, ← Nat.cast_add_one]
    apply natCast_lt_aleph0

name: not_isSuccLimit_natCast

lemma not_isSuccLimit_natCast : (n : ℕ) → ¬ IsSuccLimit (n : Cardinal.{u})

  | Nat.succ n, h => by
    rw [Nat.cast_succ, ← succ_natCast] at h
    exact Order.not_isSuccLimit_succ _ h

name: not_isSuccLimit_of_lt_aleph0

name: mul_lt_aleph0_iff
statement: theorem mul_lt_aleph0_iff {a b : Cardinal} : a * b < ℵ₀ ↔ a = 0 ∨ b = 0 ∨ a < ℵ₀ ∧ b < ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_cases ha : a = 0
    · exact Or.inl ha
    right
    by_cases hb : b = 0
    · exact Or.inl hb
    right
    rw [← Ne, ← Cardinal.one_le_iff_ne_zero] at ha hb
    constructor
    · rw [← mul_one a]
      exact (mul_le_mul' le_rfl hb).trans_lt h
    · rw [← one_mul b]
      exact (mul_le_mul' ha le_rfl).trans_lt h
  rintro (rfl | rfl | ⟨ha, hb⟩) <;> simp only [*, mul_lt_aleph0, aleph0_pos, zero_mul, mul_zero]

:= by
  have : ∀ {a : Cardinal.{u}}, ℵ₀ ≤ a → a ≠ 0 := fun a => ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot aleph0_ne_zero a
  simp only [aleph0_le_mul_iff, and_or_left, and_iff_right_of_imp this, @and_left_comm (a ≠ 0)]
  simp only [and_comm, or_comm]

name: mk_union_add_mk_inter
statement:
theorem mk_union_add_mk_inter {α : Type u} {S T : Set α} :
    #(S ∪ T : Set α) + #(S ∩ T : Set α) = #S + #T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Quot.sound ⟨Equiv.Set.unionSumInter S T⟩

name: mk_union_le
statement: theorem mk_union_le {α : Type u} (S T : Set α) : #(S ∪ T : Set α) ≤ #S + #T
proof:
:=
  @mk_union_add_mk_inter α S T ▸ self_le_add_right #(S ∪ T : Set α) #(S ∩ T : Set α)

name: mk_union_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem mk_union_of_disjoint {α : Type u} {S T : Set α} (H : Disjoint S T) :
    #(S ∪ T : Set α) = #S + #T

name: mk_insert
statement:
theorem mk_insert {α : Type u} {s : Set α} {a : α} (h : a ∉ s) :
    #(insert a s : Set α) = #s + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← union_singleton, mk_union_of_disjoint, mk_singleton]
  simpa

name: mk_insert_le
statement: theorem mk_insert_le {α : Type u} {s : Set α} {a : α} : #(insert a s : Set α) ≤ #s + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a ∈ s
  · simp only [insert_eq_of_mem h, self_le_add_right]
  · rw [mk_insert h]

name: mk_sum_compl
statement: theorem mk_sum_compl {α} (s : Set α) : #s + #(sᶜ : Set α) = #α

name: mk_le_iff_forall_finset_subset_card_le
statement:
theorem mk_le_iff_forall_finset_subset_card_le {α : Type u} {n : ℕ} {t : Set α} :
    #t ≤ n ↔ ∀ s : Finset α, (s : Set α) ⊆ t → s.card ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H s hs ↦ by simpa using (mk_le_mk_of_subset hs).trans H, fun H ↦ ?_⟩
  apply card_le_of (fun s ↦ ?_)
  classical
  let u : Finset α := s.image Subtype.val
  have : u.card = s.card := Finset.card_image_of_injOn Subtype.coe_injective.injOn
  grind

name: mk_subtype_mono
statement:
theorem mk_subtype_mono {p q : α → Prop} (h : ∀ x, p x → q x) :
    #{ x // p x } ≤ #{ x // q x }

name: card_lt_card_of_right_finite
statement: lemma card_lt_card_of_right_finite {A B : Set α} (hfin : B.Finite) (hlt : A ⊂ B) : #A < #B
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype A := (hfin.subset hlt.subset).fintype
  have : Fintype B := hfin.fintype
  simpa using Finset.card_lt_card <| Set.toFinset_ssubset_toFinset.mpr hlt

name: card_lt_card_of_left_finite
statement: lemma card_lt_card_of_left_finite {A B : Set α} (hfin : A.Finite) (hlt : A ⊂ B) : #A < #B
proof:
:= by
  rcases finite_or_infinite B with hfin | hinf
  · exact card_lt_card_of_right_finite hfin hlt
  · exact (lt_aleph0_iff_subtype_finite.mpr hfin).trans_le <| Cardinal.aleph0_le_mk_iff.mpr hinf

name: mk_strictMono
statement: theorem mk_strictMono [Finite α] : StrictMono (α := Set α) (mk ∘ (↑))

name: mk_strictMonoOn
statement: theorem mk_strictMonoOn : StrictMonoOn (mk ∘ (↑)) {s : Set α | s.Finite}

name: le_mk_sdiff_add_mk
statement: theorem le_mk_sdiff_add_mk (S T : Set α) : #S ≤ #(S \ T : Set α) + #T

name: mk_sdiff_add_mk
statement: theorem mk_sdiff_add_mk {S T : Set α} (h : T ⊆ S) : #(S \ T : Set α) + #T = #S
proof:
:= by
  refine (mk_union_of_disjoint <| ?_).symm.trans <| by rw [sdiff_union_of_subset h]
  exact disjoint_sdiff_self_left

name: sdiff_nonempty_of_mk_lt_mk
statement: lemma sdiff_nonempty_of_mk_lt_mk {S T : Set α} (h : #S < #T) : (T \ S).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_set_ne_zero_iff]
  intro h'
  exact h.not_ge ((le_mk_sdiff_add_mk T S).trans (by simp [h']))

name: compl_nonempty_of_mk_lt_mk
statement: lemma compl_nonempty_of_mk_lt_mk {S : Set α} (h : #S < #α) : Sᶜ.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_univ (α := α)] at h
  simpa [Set.compl_eq_univ_sdiff] using sdiff_nonempty_of_mk_lt_mk h

name: mk_union_le_aleph0
statement:
theorem mk_union_le_aleph0 {α} {P Q : Set α} :
    #(P ∪ Q : Set α) ≤ ℵ₀ ↔ #P ≤ ℵ₀ ∧ #Q ≤ ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  simp only [le_aleph0_iff_subtype_countable, ofPred_mem_eq, Set.union_def,
    ← countable_union]

name: mk_sep
statement: theorem mk_sep (s : Set α) (t : α → Prop) : #({ x ∈ s | t x } : Set α) = #{ x : s | t x.1 }

name: mk_preimage_of_injective_lift
statement:
theorem mk_preimage_of_injective_lift {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) (s : Set β)
    (h : Injective f) : lift.{v} #(f ⁻¹' s) ≤ lift.{u} #s
proof:
:= by
  rw [lift_mk_le.{0}]
  use Subtype.coind (fun x => f x.1) fun x => mem_preimage.mp x.2
  apply Subtype.coind_injective; exact h.comp Subtype.val_injective

name: mk_preimage_of_subset_range_lift
statement:
theorem mk_preimage_of_subset_range_lift {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) (s : Set β)
    (h : s ⊆ range f) : lift.{u} #s ≤ lift.{v} #(f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← image_preimage_eq_iff] at h
  nth_rewrite 1 [← h]
  apply mk_image_le_lift

name: mk_preimage_of_injective_of_subset_range_lift
statement:
theorem mk_preimage_of_injective_of_subset_range_lift {β : Type v} (f : α → β) (s : Set β)
    (h : Injective f) (h2 : s ⊆ range f) : lift.{v} #(f ⁻¹' s) = lift.{u} #s
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (mk_preimage_of_injective_lift f s h) (mk_preimage_of_subset_range_lift f s h2)

name: mk_preimage_of_injective_of_subset_range
statement:
theorem mk_preimage_of_injective_of_subset_range (f : α → β) (s : Set β) (h : Injective f)
    (h2 : s ⊆ range f) : #(f ⁻¹' s) = #s
proof:
:= by
  convert! mk_preimage_of_injective_of_subset_range_lift.{u, u} f s h h2 using 1 <;> rw [lift_id]

name: mk_preimage_equiv_lift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_preimage_equiv_lift {β : Type v} (f : α ≃ β) (s : Set β) :
    lift.{v} #(f ⁻¹' s) = lift.{u} #s
proof:
:= by
  apply mk_preimage_of_injective_of_subset_range_lift _ _ f.injective
  rw [f.range_eq_univ]
  exact fun _ _ ↦ ⟨⟩

name: mk_preimage_equiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_preimage_equiv (f : α ≃ β) (s : Set β) : #(f ⁻¹' s) = #s
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mk_preimage_equiv_lift f s

name: mk_preimage_of_injective
statement:
theorem mk_preimage_of_injective (f : α → β) (s : Set β) (h : Injective f) :
    #(f ⁻¹' s) ≤ #s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_id #(↑(f ⁻¹' s)), ← lift_id #(↑s)]
  exact mk_preimage_of_injective_lift f s h

name: mk_preimage_of_subset_range
statement:
theorem mk_preimage_of_subset_range (f : α → β) (s : Set β) (h : s ⊆ range f) :
    #s ≤ #(f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_id #(↑(f ⁻¹' s)), ← lift_id #(↑s)]
  exact mk_preimage_of_subset_range_lift f s h

name: mk_subset_ge_of_subset_image_lift
statement:
theorem mk_subset_ge_of_subset_image_lift {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β) {s : Set α}
    {t : Set β} (h : t ⊆ f '' s) : lift.{u} #t ≤ lift.{v} #({ x ∈ s | f x ∈ t } : Set α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [image_eq_range] at h
  convert! mk_preimage_of_subset_range_lift _ _ h using 1
  rw [mk_sep]
  rfl

name: mk_subset_ge_of_subset_image
statement:
theorem mk_subset_ge_of_subset_image (f : α → β) {s : Set α} {t : Set β} (h : t ⊆ f '' s) :
    #t ≤ #({ x ∈ s | f x ∈ t } : Set α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [image_eq_range] at h
  convert! mk_preimage_of_subset_range _ _ h using 1
  rw [mk_sep]
  rfl

name: le_mk_iff_exists_subset
statement:
theorem le_mk_iff_exists_subset {c : Cardinal} {α : Type u} {s : Set α} :
    c ≤ #s ↔ ∃ p : Set α, p ⊆ s ∧ #p = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_mk_iff_exists_set, ← Subtype.exists_set_subtype]
  apply exists_congr; intro t; rw [mk_image_eq]; apply Subtype.val_injective

name: mk_range_inl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_range_inl {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : #(range (@Sum.inl α β)) = lift.{v} #α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_id'.{u, v} #_, (Equiv.Set.rangeInl α β).lift_cardinal_eq, lift_umax.{u, v}]

name: mk_range_inr
statement:

theorem mk_range_inr {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : #(range (@Sum.inr α β)) = lift.{u} #β
proof:

name: mk_eq_two_iff
statement: theorem mk_eq_two_iff : #α = 2 ↔ ∃ x y : α, x ≠ y ∧ ({x, y} : Set α) = univ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [← @Nat.cast_two Cardinal, mk_eq_nat_iff_finset, Finset.card_eq_two]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, x, y, hne, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, y, hne, by simpa using ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, y, hne, h⟩
    exact ⟨{x, y}, by simpa using h, x, y, hne, rfl⟩

name: mk_eq_two_iff'
statement: theorem mk_eq_two_iff' (x : α) : #α = 2 ↔ ∃! y, y ≠ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_two_iff]; constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b, hne, h⟩
    simp only [eq_univ_iff_forall, mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff] at h
    rcases h x with (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [⟨b, hne.symm, fun z => (h z).resolve_left⟩, ⟨a, hne, fun z => (h z).resolve_right⟩]
  · rintro ⟨y, hne, hy⟩
    exact ⟨x, y, hne.symm, eq_univ_of_forall fun z => or_iff_not_imp_left.2 (hy z)⟩

name: exists_notMem_of_length_lt
statement:
theorem exists_notMem_of_length_lt {α : Type*} (l : List α) (h : ↑l.length < #α) :
    ∃ z : α, z ∉ l
proof:
:= by
  classical
  contrapose! h
  calc
    #α = #(Set.univ : Set α) := mk_univ.symm
    _ ≤ #l.toFinset := mk_le_mk_of_subset fun x _ => List.mem_toFinset.mpr (h x)
    _ = l.toFinset.card := Cardinal.mk_coe_finset
    _ ≤ l.length := Nat.cast_le.mpr (List.toFinset_card_le l)

name: exists_ne_ne_of_three_le
statement: theorem exists_ne_ne_of_three_le {α : Type*} (h : 3 ≤ #α) (x y : α) : ∃ z : α, z ≠ x ∧ z ≠ y
proof:
:= by
  have : ↑(3 : ℕ) ≤ #α := by simpa using h
  have : ↑(2 : ℕ) < #α := by rwa [← natCast_add_one_le_iff, ← Nat.cast_add_one]
  have := exists_notMem_of_length_lt [x, y] this
  simpa [not_or] using this

name: le_powerlt
statement: theorem le_powerlt {b c : Cardinal.{u}} (a) (h : c < b) : (a ^ c) ≤ a ^< b
proof:
:= by
  refine le_ciSup (f := fun y : Iio b => a ^ (y : Cardinal)) ?_ ⟨c, h⟩
  rw [← image_eq_range]
  exact bddAbove_image.{u, u} _ bddAbove_Iio

name: powerlt_le
statement: theorem powerlt_le {a b c : Cardinal.{u}} : a ^< b ≤ c ↔ ∀ x < b, a ^ x ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerlt, ciSup_le_iff']
  · simp
  · rw [← image_eq_range]
    exact bddAbove_image.{u, u} _ bddAbove_Iio

name: powerlt_le_powerlt_left
statement: theorem powerlt_le_powerlt_left {a b c : Cardinal} (h : b ≤ c) : a ^< b ≤ a ^< c
proof:
:=
  powerlt_le.2 fun _ hx => le_powerlt a <| hx.trans_le h

name: powerlt_mono_left
statement: theorem powerlt_mono_left (a) : Monotone fun c => a ^< c

name: powerlt_succ
statement: theorem powerlt_succ {a b : Cardinal} (h : a ≠ 0) : a ^< succ b = a ^ b
proof:
:=
  (powerlt_le.2 fun _ h' => power_le_power_left h <| le_of_lt_succ h').antisymm <|
    le_powerlt a (lt_succ b)

name: powerlt_min
statement: theorem powerlt_min {a b c : Cardinal} : a ^< min b c = min (a ^< b) (a ^< c)

name: powerlt_max
statement: theorem powerlt_max {a b c : Cardinal} : a ^< max b c = max (a ^< b) (a ^< c)

name: zero_powerlt
statement: theorem zero_powerlt {a : Cardinal} (h : a ≠ 0) : 0 ^< a = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (powerlt_le.2 fun c _ => zero_power_le _).antisymm
  rw [← power_zero]
  exact le_powerlt 0 (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 h)

name: powerlt_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powerlt_zero {a : Cardinal} : a ^< 0 = 0
proof:

  exact Subtype.isEmpty_of_false fun x => mem_Iio.not.mpr not_lt_zero

lemma range_ofENat : range ofENat = Iic ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  refine (range_subset_iff.2 ofENat_le_aleph0).antisymm fun x (hx : x ≤ ℵ₀) ↦ ?_
  rcases hx.lt_or_eq with hlt | rfl
  · lift x to ℕ using hlt
    exact mem_range_self (x : ℕ∞)
  · exact mem_range_self (⊤ : ℕ∞)

statement: lemma toENatAux_gc : GaloisConnection (↑) toENatAux
proof:
:= fun n x ↦ by
  cases lt_or_ge x ℵ₀ with
  | inl hx => lift x to ℕ using hx; simp
  | inr hx => simp [toENatAux_eq_top hx, (ofENat_le_aleph0 n).trans hx]

name: toENatAux_le_nat
statement: theorem toENatAux_le_nat {x : Cardinal} {n : ℕ} : toENatAux x ≤ n ↔ x ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  cases lt_or_ge x ℵ₀ with
  | inl hx => lift x to ℕ using hx; simp
  | inr hx => simp [toENatAux_eq_top hx, natCast_lt_aleph0.trans_le hx]

name: toENatAux_eq_nat

name: Nat.card_eq
statement:
theorem Nat.card_eq (α : Type*) :
    Nat.card α = if _ : Finite α then @Fintype.card α (Fintype.ofFinite α) else 0
proof:
:= by
  cases finite_or_infinite α
  · let := Fintype.ofFinite α
    simp only [this, *, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, dite_eq_left]
  · simp only [*, card_eq_zero_of_infinite, not_finite_iff_infinite.mpr, dite_false]

name: induction_subsingleton_or_nontrivial
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_subsingleton_or_nontrivial {P : Type* → Prop} (α) [Finite α]
    (hbase : ∀ (α) [Finite α] [Subsingleton α], P α)
    (hstep : ∀ (α) [Finite α] [Nontrivial α],
      (∀ (β) [Finite β], Nat.card β < Nat.card α → P β) → P α) :
    P α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n, Nat.card α = n := ⟨Nat.card α, rfl⟩
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing α with | _ n ih
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial α with hsing | hnontriv
  · apply hbase
  · apply hstep
    intro β _ hlt
    rw [hn] at hlt
    exact ih (Nat.card β) hlt _ rfl

name: card_union_le
statement: theorem card_union_le (s t : Set α) : Nat.card (↥(s ∪ t)) ≤ Nat.card s + Nat.card t
proof:
:= by
  rcases _root_.finite_or_infinite (↥(s ∪ t)) with h | h
  · rw [finite_coe_iff, finite_union, ← finite_coe_iff, ← finite_coe_iff] at h
    cases h
    rw [← @Nat.cast_le Cardinal, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_card, Nat.cast_card, Nat.cast_card]
    exact Cardinal.mk_union_le s t
  · simp

name: card_lt_card
statement: theorem card_lt_card (ht : t.Finite) (hsub : s ⊂ t) : Nat.card s < Nat.card t
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype t := Finite.fintype ht
  have : Fintype s := Finite.fintype (subset ht (subset_of_ssubset hsub))
  simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact Set.card_lt_card hsub

name: ecard_lt_ecard
statement: theorem ecard_lt_ecard (hs : s.Finite) (hsub : s ⊂ t) : ENat.card s < ENat.card t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices ENat.card t ≤ ENat.card s → t ⊆ s from
    lt_of_le_not_ge (ecard_le_ecard hsub.subset) fun hle ↦ not_subset_of_ssubset hsub <| this hle
  intro hle
  suffices ENat.card ↑(t \ s) ≤ 0 by
    rwa [← sdiff_eq_empty, ← Set.isEmpty_coe_sort, ← ENat.card_eq_zero_iff_empty,
      ← nonpos_iff_eq_zero]
  suffices ENat.card ↑(t \ s) + ENat.card ↑s ≤ 0 + ENat.card ↑s from
    WithTop.le_of_add_le_add_right (ENat.card_lt_top.mpr hs).ne this
  suffices ENat.card ↑t ≤ 0 + ENat.card ↑s by
    rwa [← ENat.card_sum, ← ENat.card_congr <| Equiv.Set.union disjoint_sdiff_left,
      sdiff_union_of_subset hsub.subset]
  exact le_add_of_le_right hle

name: mk_subtype_le_of_countable_eventually_mem_aux
statement:
lemma mk_subtype_le_of_countable_eventually_mem_aux {α ι : Type u} {a : Cardinal}
    [Countable ι] {f : ι → Set α} {l : Filter ι} [NeBot l]
    {t : Set α} (ht : ∀ x ∈ t, ∀ᶠ i in l, x ∈ f i)
    (h'f : ∀ i, #(f i) ≤ a) : #t ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge a ℵ₀ with ha | ha
  /- case `a` finite. In this case, it suffices to show that any finite subset `s` of `t` has
  cardinality at most `a`. For this, we pick `i` such that `f i` contains all the points in `s`,
  and apply the assumption that the cardinality of `f i` is at most `a`.   -/
  · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ (n : ℕ), a = n := lt_aleph0.1 ha
    apply mk_le_iff_forall_finset_subset_card_le.2 (fun s hs ↦ ?_)
    have A : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ᶠ i in l, x ∈ f i := fun x hx ↦ ht x (hs hx)
    have B : ∀ᶠ i in l, ∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ f i := (s.eventually_all).2 A
    rcases B.exists with ⟨i, hi⟩
    have : ∀ i, Fintype (f i) := fun i ↦ (lt_aleph0_iff_fintype.1 ((h'f i).trans_lt ha)).some
    let u : Finset α := (f i).toFinset
    have I1 : s.card ≤ u.card := by
      have : s ⊆ u := fun x hx ↦ by simpa only [u, Set.mem_toFinset] using hi x hx
      exact Finset.card_le_card this
    have I2 : (u.card : Cardinal) ≤ n := by
      convert! h'f i; simp only [u, Set.toFinset_card, mk_fintype]
    exact I1.trans (Nat.cast_le.1 I2)
  
  · have : t ⊆ ⋃ i, f i := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, x ∈ f i := (ht x hx).exists
      exact mem_iUnion_of_mem i hi
    calc #t ≤ #(⋃ i, f i) := mk_le_mk_of_subset this
      _ ≤ sum (fun i ↦ #(f i)) := mk_iUnion_le_sum_mk
      _ ≤ sum (fun _ ↦ a) := sum_le_sum _ _ h'f
      _ = #ι * a := by simp
      _ ≤ ℵ₀ * a := by grw [mk_le_aleph0]
      _ = a := aleph0_mul_eq ha

name: mk_subtype_le_of_countable_eventually_mem
statement:
lemma mk_subtype_le_of_countable_eventually_mem {α : Type u} {ι : Type v} {a : Cardinal}
    [Countable ι] {f : ι → Set α} {l : Filter ι} [NeBot l]
    {t : Set α} (ht : ∀ x ∈ t, ∀ᶠ i in l, x ∈ f i)
    (h'f : ∀ i, #(f i) ≤ a) : #t ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  let g : ULift.{u, v} ι → Set (ULift.{v, u} α) := (ULift.down ⁻¹' ·) ∘ f ∘ ULift.down
  suffices #(ULift.down.{v} ⁻¹' t) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v, u} a by simpa
  let l' : Filter (ULift.{u} ι) := Filter.map ULift.up l
  apply mk_subtype_le_of_countable_eventually_mem_aux (ι := ULift.{u} ι) (l := l') (f := g)
  · intro x hx
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, mem_preimage, eventually_map] using! ht _ hx
  · intro i
    simpa [g] using! h'f i.down

name: mk_le_of_countable_eventually_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_univ]
  exact mk_subtype_le_of_countable_eventually_mem (l := l) (fun x _ ↦ ht x) h'f

name: mk_of_countable_eventually_mem
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply mk_le_of_countable_eventually_mem ht (fun i ↦ (h'f i).le)
  · obtain ⟨i⟩ : Nonempty ι := nonempty_of_neBot l
    rw [← (h'f i)]
    exact mk_set_le (f i)

name: hasCardinalLT_iff_cardinal_mk_lt
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_iff_cardinal_mk_lt (X : Type u) (κ : Cardinal.{u}) :
    HasCardinalLT X κ ↔ Cardinal.mk X < κ

name: small
statement: lemma small : Small.{v} X
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [HasCardinalLT] at h
  rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, v + 1}, Cardinal.lift_lift, Cardinal.lift_lift] at h
  simpa only [Cardinal.small_iff_lift_mk_lt_univ] using h.trans (Cardinal.lift_lt_univ' κ)

name: of_le
statement:
lemma of_le {κ' : Cardinal.{v}} (hκ' : κ ≤ κ') :
    HasCardinalLT X κ'
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le h (by simpa only [Cardinal.lift_le] using hκ')

name: of_injective
statement:
lemma of_injective (f : Y → X) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    HasCardinalLT Y κ
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [HasCardinalLT] at h ⊢
  rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, u}, Cardinal.lift_lift, Cardinal.lift_lift]
  rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, u'}, Cardinal.lift_lift, Cardinal.lift_lift] at h
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Cardinal.mk_le_of_injective
    (Function.Injective.comp ULift.up_injective
      (Function.Injective.comp hf ULift.down_injective))) h

name: of_surjective
statement:
lemma of_surjective (f : X → Y) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    HasCardinalLT Y κ
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [HasCardinalLT] at h ⊢
  rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, u}, Cardinal.lift_lift, Cardinal.lift_lift]
  rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, u'}, Cardinal.lift_lift, Cardinal.lift_lift] at h
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Cardinal.mk_le_of_surjective
    (Function.Surjective.comp ULift.up_surjective (Function.Surjective.comp hf
      ULift.down_surjective))) h

name: hasCardinalLT_iff_of_equiv
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_iff_of_equiv {X : Type u} {Y : Type u'} (e : X ≃ Y) (κ : Cardinal.{v}) :
    HasCardinalLT X κ ↔ HasCardinalLT Y κ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h.of_injective _ e.symm.injective,
    fun h ↦ h.of_injective _ e.injective⟩

name: hasCardinalLT_aleph0_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma hasCardinalLT_aleph0_iff (X : Type u) :
    HasCardinalLT X Cardinal.aleph0.{v} ↔ Finite X

name: hasCardinalLT_of_finite
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_of_finite
    (X : Type*) [Finite X] (κ : Cardinal) (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ) :
    HasCardinalLT X κ

name: hasCardinalLT_lift_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma hasCardinalLT_lift_iff (X : Type v) (κ : Cardinal.{w}) :
    HasCardinalLT X (Cardinal.lift.{u} κ) ↔ HasCardinalLT X κ
proof:
:= by
  simp [HasCardinalLT, ← (Cardinal.lift_strictMono.{max v w, max u}).lt_iff_lt]

name: hasCardinalLT_ulift_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma hasCardinalLT_ulift_iff (X : Type v) (κ : Cardinal.{w}) :
    HasCardinalLT (ULift.{u} X) κ ↔ HasCardinalLT X κ

name: hasCardinalLT_sum_iff
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_sum_iff (X : Type u) (Y : Type u') (κ : Cardinal.{w})
    (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ) :
    HasCardinalLT (X ⊕ Y) κ ↔ HasCardinalLT X κ ∧ HasCardinalLT Y κ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.of_injective _ Sum.inl_injective,
      h.of_injective _ Sum.inr_injective⟩
  · rintro ⟨hX, hY⟩
    dsimp [HasCardinalLT] at hX hY ⊢
    rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, u'}, Cardinal.lift_lift, Cardinal.lift_lift] at hX
    rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, u}, Cardinal.lift_lift, Cardinal.lift_lift] at hY
    simp only [Cardinal.mk_sum, Cardinal.lift_add, Cardinal.lift_lift]
    exact Cardinal.add_lt_of_lt (by simpa using hκ) hX hY

name: hasCardinalLT_option_iff
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_option_iff (X : Type u) (κ : Cardinal.{w})
    (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ) :
    HasCardinalLT (Option X) κ ↔ HasCardinalLT X κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasCardinalLT_iff_of_equiv (Equiv.optionEquivSumPUnit.{0} X),
    hasCardinalLT_sum_iff _ _ _ hκ, and_iff_left_iff_imp]
  refine fun _ ↦ HasCardinalLT.of_le ?_ hκ
  rw [hasCardinalLT_aleph0_iff]
  infer_instance

name: hasCardinalLT_subtype_max
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_subtype_max
    {X : Type*} {P₁ P₂ : X → Prop} {κ : Cardinal} (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
    (h₁ : HasCardinalLT (Subtype P₁) κ) (h₂ : HasCardinalLT (Subtype P₂) κ) :
    HasCardinalLT (Subtype (P₁ ⊔ P₂)) κ
proof:
:= by
  have : HasCardinalLT (Subtype P₁ ⊕ Subtype P₂) κ := by
    rw [hasCardinalLT_sum_iff _ _ _ hκ]
    exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  refine this.of_surjective (Sum.elim (fun x ↦ ⟨x.1, Or.inl x.2⟩)
    (fun x ↦ ⟨x.1, Or.inr x.2⟩)) ?_
  rintro ⟨x, hx | hx⟩
  · exact ⟨Sum.inl ⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨Sum.inr ⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩

name: hasCardinalLT_union
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_union
    {X : Type*} {S₁ S₂ : Set X} {κ : Cardinal} (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
    (h₁ : HasCardinalLT S₁ κ) (h₂ : HasCardinalLT S₂ κ) :
    HasCardinalLT (S₁ ∪ S₂ : Set _) κ

name: hasCardinalLT_sigma'
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_sigma' {ι : Type w} (α : ι → Type w) (κ : Cardinal.{w}) [Fact κ.IsRegular]
    (hι : HasCardinalLT ι κ) (hα : ∀ i, HasCardinalLT (α i) κ) :
    HasCardinalLT (Σ i, α i) κ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hasCardinalLT_iff_cardinal_mk_lt] at hι hα ⊢
  rw [Cardinal.mk_sigma]
  exact Cardinal.sum_lt_lift_of_isRegular.{w, w} Fact.out (by simpa) hα

name: hasCardinalLT_sigma
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_sigma {ι : Type u} (α : ι → Type v) (κ : Cardinal.{w}) [Fact κ.IsRegular]
    (hι : HasCardinalLT ι κ) (hα : ∀ i, HasCardinalLT (α i) κ) :
    HasCardinalLT (Σ i, α i) κ
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (Cardinal.lift.{max u v} κ).IsRegular := ⟨Cardinal.IsRegular.lift Fact.out⟩
  have := hasCardinalLT_sigma'
    (fun (i : ULift.{max v w} ι) ↦ ULift.{max u w} (α (ULift.down i)))
    (Cardinal.lift.{max u v} κ) (by simpa)
    (fun i ↦ by simpa using hα (ULift.down i))
  rw [hasCardinalLT_lift_iff] at this
  exact this.of_surjective (fun ⟨i, a⟩ ↦ ⟨ULift.down i, ULift.down a⟩)
    (fun ⟨i, a⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨ULift.up i, ULift.up a⟩, rfl⟩)

name: hasCardinalLT_subtype_iSup
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_subtype_iSup
    {ι : Type*} {X : Type*} (P : ι → X → Prop) {κ : Cardinal} [Fact κ.IsRegular]
    (hι : HasCardinalLT ι κ) (hP : ∀ i, HasCardinalLT (Subtype (P i)) κ) :
    HasCardinalLT (Subtype (⨆ i, P i)) κ
proof:
:=
  (hasCardinalLT_sigma (fun i ↦ Subtype (P i)) κ hι hP).of_surjective
    (fun ⟨i, x, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨x, by simp only [iSup_apply, iSup_Prop_eq]; exact ⟨i, hx⟩⟩) (by
    rintro ⟨_, h⟩
    simp only [iSup_apply, iSup_Prop_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
    exact ⟨⟨i, _, hi⟩, rfl⟩)

name: hasCardinalLT_iUnion
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_iUnion
    {ι : Type*} {X : Type*} (S : ι → Set X) {κ : Cardinal} [Fact κ.IsRegular]
    (hι : HasCardinalLT ι κ) (hS : ∀ i, HasCardinalLT (S i) κ) :
    HasCardinalLT (⋃ i, S i) κ
proof:
:= by
  convert! show HasCardinalLT (Set.ofPred ((⨆ i, S i))) κ from hasCardinalLT_subtype_iSup S hι hS
  aesop

name: hasCardinalLT_prod'
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_prod' {T₁ T₂ : Type w} {κ : Cardinal.{w}} (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
    (h₁ : HasCardinalLT T₁ κ) (h₂ : HasCardinalLT T₂ κ) :
    HasCardinalLT (T₁ × T₂) κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasCardinalLT_iff_cardinal_mk_lt] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
  simpa using Cardinal.mul_lt_of_lt hκ h₁ h₂

name: hasCardinalLT_prod
statement:
lemma hasCardinalLT_prod {T₁ : Type u} {T₂ : Type u'}
    {κ : Cardinal.{w}} (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
    (h₁ : HasCardinalLT T₁ κ) (h₂ : HasCardinalLT T₂ κ) :
    HasCardinalLT (T₁ × T₂) κ
proof:
:= by
  have := hasCardinalLT_prod' (T₁ := ULift.{max u' w} T₁) (T₂ := ULift.{max u w} T₂)
    (κ := Cardinal.lift.{max u u'} κ) (by simpa) (by simpa) (by simpa)
  simp only [hasCardinalLT_lift_iff] at this
  exact this.of_surjective (fun ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ ↦ ⟨ULift.down x₁, ULift.down x₂⟩) (fun ⟨x₁, x₂⟩ ↦
    ⟨⟨ULift.up x₁, ULift.up x₂⟩, rfl⟩)

name: exists_regular_cardinal
statement:
lemma exists_regular_cardinal (X : Type u) [Small.{w} X] :
    ∃ (κ : Cardinal.{w}), κ.IsRegular ∧ HasCardinalLT X κ
proof:
:=
  ⟨Order.succ (max (Cardinal.mk (Shrink.{w} X)) .aleph0),
    Cardinal.isRegular_succ (le_max_right _ _), by
      simp [hasCardinalLT_iff_of_equiv (equivShrink.{w} X),
        hasCardinalLT_iff_cardinal_mk_lt]⟩

name: exists_regular_cardinal_forall
statement:
lemma exists_regular_cardinal_forall {ι : Type v} (X : ι → Type u) [Small.{w} ι]
    [∀ i, Small.{w} (X i)] :
    ∃ (κ : Cardinal.{w}), κ.IsRegular ∧ ∀ (i : ι), HasCardinalLT (X i) κ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ, h⟩ := exists_regular_cardinal.{w} (Sigma X)
  exact ⟨κ, hκ, fun i ↦ h.of_injective _ sigma_mk_injective⟩

name: infinite_pigeonhole
statement:
theorem infinite_pigeonhole {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h₁ : ℵ₀ ≤ #β) (h₂ : #α < (#β).ord.cof) :
    ∃ a : α, #(f ⁻¹' {a}) = #β
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ a, #β ≤ #(f ⁻¹' {a}) := by
    by_contra! h
    apply mk_univ.not_lt
    rw [← preimage_univ, ← iUnion_of_singleton, preimage_iUnion]
    exact
      mk_iUnion_le_sum_mk.trans_lt <| (sum_le_mk_mul_iSup _).trans_lt <|
        mul_lt_of_lt h₁ (h₂.trans_le <| cof_ord_le _) (iSup_lt_of_lt_cof_ord h₂ h)
  obtain ⟨x, h⟩ := this
  refine ⟨x, h.antisymm' ?_⟩
  rw [le_mk_iff_exists_set]
  exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: infinite_pigeonhole_card
statement:
theorem infinite_pigeonhole_card {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (θ : Cardinal) (hθ : θ ≤ #β)
    (h₁ : ℵ₀ ≤ θ) (h₂ : #α < θ.ord.cof) : ∃ a : α, θ ≤ #(f ⁻¹' {a})
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_mk_iff_exists_set.1 hθ with ⟨s, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole (f ∘ Subtype.val : s → α) h₁ h₂
  use a; rw [← ha, @preimage_comp _ _ _ Subtype.val f]
  exact mk_preimage_of_injective _ _ Subtype.val_injective

name: infinite_pigeonhole_set
statement:
theorem infinite_pigeonhole_set {β α : Type u} {s : Set β} (f : s → α) (θ : Cardinal)
    (hθ : θ ≤ #s) (h₁ : ℵ₀ ≤ θ) (h₂ : #α < θ.ord.cof) :
    ∃ (a : α) (t : Set β) (h : t ⊆ s), θ ≤ #t ∧ ∀ ⦃x⦄ (hx : x ∈ t), f ⟨x, h hx⟩ = a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole_card f θ hθ h₁ h₂
  refine ⟨a, { x | ∃ h, f ⟨x, h⟩ = a }, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro x ⟨hx, _⟩
    exact hx
  · refine
      ha.trans
        (ge_of_eq <|
          Quotient.sound ⟨Equiv.trans ?_ (Equiv.subtypeSubtypeEquivSubtypeExists _ _).symm⟩)
    simp only [coe_eq_subtype, mem_singleton_iff, mem_preimage, mem_ofPred_eq]
    rfl
  rintro x ⟨_, hx'⟩; exact hx'

name: infinite_pigeonhole_card_lt
statement:
theorem infinite_pigeonhole_card_lt {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) (hβ : ℵ₀ ≤ #β) :
    ∃ a : α, #α < #(f ⁻¹' {a})
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← succ_le_iff]
  rcases lt_or_ge #α ℵ₀ with hα | hα
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole_card f ℵ₀ hβ le_rfl
      (by rwa [isRegular_aleph0.cof_ord])
    exact ⟨a, ha.trans' (succ_le_of_lt hα)⟩
  · exact infinite_pigeonhole_card f (succ #α) (succ_le_of_lt h) (hα.trans (le_succ _))
      ((lt_succ _).trans_le (isRegular_succ hα).2.ge)

name: exists_infinite_fiber
statement:
theorem exists_infinite_fiber {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) [Infinite β] :
    ∃ a : α, Infinite (f ⁻¹' {a})
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Cardinal.infinite_iff]
  rcases lt_or_ge #α ℵ₀ with hα | hα
  · exact infinite_pigeonhole_card f ℵ₀ (aleph0_le_mk β) le_rfl
      (by rwa [isRegular_aleph0.cof_ord])
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole_card_lt f h (aleph0_le_mk β)
    exact ⟨a, hα.trans ha.le⟩

name: exists_infinite_fiber'
statement:
theorem exists_infinite_fiber' {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) [Infinite α] :
    ∃ a : α, Infinite (f ⁻¹' {a})
proof:
:= by
  suffices Infinite β from exists_infinite_fiber f h
  exact .of_cardinalMk_le h.le

name: exists_uncountable_fiber
statement:
theorem exists_uncountable_fiber {β α : Type u} (f : β → α) (h : #α < #β) [Uncountable β] :
    ∃ a : α, Uncountable (f ⁻¹' {a})
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← Cardinal.aleph0_lt_mk_iff, ← aleph_one_le_iff]
  rcases lt_or_ge #α ℵ₀ with hα | hα
  · exact infinite_pigeonhole_card f ℵ₁ (by simp) aleph0_lt_aleph_one.le
      (by rw [isRegular_aleph_one.cof_ord]; exact hα.trans aleph0_lt_aleph_one)
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := infinite_pigeonhole_card_lt f h (aleph0_le_mk β)
    rw [← Order.succ_le_succ_iff, succ_aleph0] at hα
    exact ⟨a, hα.trans (succ_le_of_lt ha)⟩

name: le_range_of_union_finset_eq_univ
statement:
theorem le_range_of_union_finset_eq_univ {α β : Type*} [Infinite β] (f : α → Finset β)
    (w : ⋃ a, (f a : Set β) = Set.univ) : #β ≤ #(range f)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  simp only [not_le] at h
  let u : ∀ b, ∃ a, b ∈ f a := fun b => by simpa using (w.ge :) (Set.mem_univ b)
  let u' : β → range f := fun b => ⟨f (u b).choose, by simp⟩
  have v' : ∀ a, u' ⁻¹' {⟨f a, by simp⟩} ≤ f a := by
    rintro a p m
    have m : f (u p).choose = f a := by simpa [u'] using m
    rw [← m]
    apply fun b => (u b).choose_spec
  obtain ⟨⟨-, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩, p⟩ := exists_infinite_fiber u' h
  exact (@Infinite.of_injective _ _ p (inclusion (v' a)) (inclusion_injective _)).false

name: count_le_cardinal
statement: theorem count_le_cardinal : (count p n : Cardinal) ≤ Cardinal.mk { k | p k }
proof:
:= by
  rw [count_eq_card_fintype, ← Cardinal.mk_fintype]
  exact Cardinal.mk_subtype_mono fun x hx ↦ hx.2

name: count_le_setENCard
statement: theorem count_le_setENCard : count p n ≤ Set.encard { k | p k }
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Set.encard, ENat.card, Set.coe_ofPred, Cardinal.natCast_le_toENat]
  exact Nat.count_le_cardinal n

name: count_le_setNCard
statement: theorem count_le_setNCard (h : { k | p k }.Finite) : count p n ≤ Set.ncard { k | p k }
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.ncard_def, ← ENat.natCast_le_natCast, ENat.natCast_toNat (by simpa)]
  exact count_le_setENCard n

@[elab_as_elim]

theorem inductionOn₂ {motive : Cardinal → Cardinal → Prop} (c₁ c₂ : Cardinal)
    (mk : ∀ α β, motive #α #β) : motive c₁ c₂

theorem map_mk (f : Type u → Type v) (hf : ∀ α β, α ≃ β → f α ≃ f β) (α : Type u) :
    map f hf #α = #(f α)

name: mk_uLift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_uLift (α) : #(ULift.{v, u} α) = lift.{v} #α

name: lift_umax
statement: theorem lift_umax : lift.{max u v, u} = lift.{v, u}
proof:
:=
  funext fun a => inductionOn a fun _ => (Equiv.ulift.trans Equiv.ulift.symm).cardinal_eq

name: lift_id'
statement: theorem lift_id' (a : Cardinal.{max u v}) : lift.{u} a = a

statement: theorem lift_id (a : Cardinal) : lift.{u, u} a = a

statement:

name: out_lift_equiv
statement: theorem out_lift_equiv (a : Cardinal.{u}) : Nonempty ((lift.{v} a).out ≃ a.out)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_out a, ← mk_uLift, mk_out]
  exact ⟨outMkEquiv.trans Equiv.ulift⟩

name: lift_mk_eq
statement:
theorem lift_mk_eq {α : Type u} {β : Type v} :
    lift.{max v w} #α = lift.{max u w} #β ↔ Nonempty (α ≃ β)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.eq'.trans
    ⟨fun ⟨f⟩ => ⟨Equiv.ulift.symm.trans <| f.trans Equiv.ulift⟩, fun ⟨f⟩ =>
      ⟨Equiv.ulift.trans <| f.trans Equiv.ulift.symm⟩⟩

name: lift_mk_eq'
statement: theorem lift_mk_eq' {α : Type u} {β : Type v} : lift.{v} #α = lift.{u} #β ↔ Nonempty (α ≃ β)

name: mk_congr_lift
statement: theorem mk_congr_lift {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (e : α ≃ β) : lift.{v} #α = lift.{u} #β

statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq_zero (α : Type u) [IsEmpty α] : #α = 0

name: lift_zero
statement:

name: lift_power_sum
statement:
theorem lift_power_sum {ι : Type u} (a : Cardinal.{v}) (f : ι → Cardinal.{v}) :
    lift.{u, v} a ^ sum f = prod fun i ↦ a ^ f i
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Cardinal.inductionOn with | _ α =>
  induction f using induction_on_pi with | _ f =>
  simp_rw [← mk_uLift, prod, sum, power_def]
  apply mk_congr
  refine (Equiv.piCurry fun _ _ => ULift α).trans ?_
  refine Equiv.piCongrRight fun b => ?_
  refine (Equiv.arrowCongr outMkEquiv Equiv.ulift).trans ?_
  exact outMkEquiv.symm

name: mk_finsupp_lift_of_infinite
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_finsupp_lift_of_infinite (α : Type u) (β : Type v) [Infinite α] [Zero β] [Nontrivial β] :
    #(α →₀ β) = max (lift.{v} #α) (lift.{u} #β)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc
      #(α →₀ β) ≤ #(Finset (α × β)) := mk_le_of_injective (Finsupp.graph_injective α β)
      _ = #(α × β) := mk_finset_of_infinite _
      _ = max (lift.{v} #α) (lift.{u} #β) := by
        rw [mk_prod, mul_eq_max_of_aleph0_le_left] <;> simp
  · apply max_le <;> rw [← lift_id #(α →₀ β), ← lift_umax]
    · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_ne (0 : β)
      exact lift_mk_le.{v}.2 ⟨⟨_, Finsupp.single_left_injective hb⟩⟩
    · inhabit α
      exact lift_mk_le.{u}.2 ⟨⟨_, Finsupp.single_injective default⟩⟩

statement:

    #(α →₀ β) = max (lift.{v} #α) (lift.{u} #β)
proof:
:= by
  cases fintypeOrInfinite α
  · rw [mk_finsupp_lift_of_fintype]
    have : ℵ₀ ≤ (#β).lift := aleph0_le_lift.2 (aleph0_le_mk β)
    rw [max_eq_right (le_trans _ this), power_nat_eq this]
    exacts [Fintype.card_pos, lift_le_aleph0.2 (lt_aleph0_of_finite _).le]
  · apply mk_finsupp_lift_of_infinite

name: toNat_eq_iff_of_lt_aleph0
statement:
lemma toNat_eq_iff_of_lt_aleph0 {a : Cardinal.{u}} (n : ℕ) (lt : a < Cardinal.aleph0) :
    a.toNat = n ↔ a = n
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← Cardinal.cast_toNat_of_lt_aleph0 lt]
  exact Nat.cast_inj.symm

name: toNat_eq_of_forall_le_iff
statement:
theorem toNat_eq_of_forall_le_iff {c : Cardinal.{u}} {d : Cardinal.{v}}
    (h : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ c ↔ n ≤ d) : c.toNat = d.toNat
proof:
:= by
  have h' := forall_congr' h
  rw [← Cardinal.aleph0_le, ← Cardinal.aleph0_le] at h'
  rcases iff_iff_and_or_not_and_not.mp h' with ⟨hc, hd⟩ | ⟨hc, hd⟩
  · simp [Cardinal.toNat_apply_of_aleph0_le, hc, hd]
  · apply eq_of_forall_le_iff
    rw [← cast_toNat_of_lt_aleph0 (not_le.mp hc), ← cast_toNat_of_lt_aleph0 (not_le.mp hd)] at h
    simpa using h

name: mk_biUnion_le_of_le_lift
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← mem_Iio, biUnion_eq_iUnion, iUnion, iSup, ← ToType.mk.symm.surjective.range_comp]
  rw [← lift_le.{u}]
  apply ((mk_iUnion_le_lift _).trans _).trans_eq (mul_eq_self (aleph0_le_lift.2 hc))
  rw [mk_toType]
  refine mul_le_mul' ho (ciSup_le' ?_)
  intro i
  simpa using hA _ i.toOrd.prop

name: mk_biUnion_le_of_le
proof:
:= by
  apply mk_biUnion_le_of_le_lift _ hc A hA
  rwa [Cardinal.lift_le]

name: lift_card_iSup_le_sum_card
statement:
theorem lift_card_iSup_le_sum_card {ι : Type u} (f : ι → Ordinal.{v}) :
    Cardinal.lift.{u} (⨆ i, f i).card ≤ Cardinal.sum fun i ↦ (f i).card
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hf : ¬ BddAbove (range f)
  · simp [ciSup_of_not_bddAbove hf]
  simp_rw [← mk_toType]
  rw [← mk_sigma, ← Cardinal.lift_id'.{v} #(Σ _, _), ← Cardinal.lift_umax.{v, u}]
  apply lift_mk_le_lift_mk_of_surjective (f := .mk ∘ (⟨·.2.toOrd,
    (mem_Iio.mp (ToType.toOrd _).2).trans_le (le_ciSup hf _)⟩))
  rw [EquivLike.comp_surjective]
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (lt_ciSup_iff' hf).mp hx
  exact ⟨⟨i, .mk ⟨x, hi⟩⟩, by simp⟩

name: card_iSup_le_sum_card
statement:
theorem card_iSup_le_sum_card {ι : Type u} (f : ι → Ordinal.{max u v}) :
    (⨆ i, f i).card ≤ Cardinal.sum fun i ↦ (f i).card
proof:
:= by
  have := lift_card_iSup_le_sum_card f
  rwa [Cardinal.lift_id'] at this

name: card_iSup_Iio_le_sum_card
statement:
theorem card_iSup_Iio_le_sum_card {o : Ordinal.{u}} (f : Iio o → Ordinal.{max u v}) :
    (⨆ a : Iio o, f a).card ≤ Cardinal.sum fun i : o.ToType ↦ (f i.toOrd).card
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_eq_of_le (congr_arg _ _).symm (card_iSup_le_sum_card _)
  simpa using ToType.mk.symm.iSup_comp (g := fun x ↦ f x)

name: card_iSup_Iio_le_card_mul_iSup
statement:
theorem card_iSup_Iio_le_card_mul_iSup {o : Ordinal.{u}} (f : Iio o → Ordinal.{max u v}) :
    (⨆ a : Iio o, f a).card ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v} o.card * ⨆ a : Iio o, (f a).card
proof:
:= by
  apply (card_iSup_Iio_le_sum_card f).trans
  convert! ← sum_le_lift_mk_mul_iSup _
  · exact mk_toType o
  · exact ToType.mk.symm.iSup_comp (g := fun x ↦ (f x).card)

name: card_iSup_le_lift
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! hc : c < ℵ₀
  · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := lt_aleph0.1 hc
    rw [card_le_nat]
    refine ciSup_le' fun i ↦ ?_
    simpa using hf i
  · rw [← Cardinal.lift_le.{u}]
    apply (lift_card_iSup_le_sum_card ..).trans ((sum_le_lift_mk_mul_iSup_lift _).trans _)
    rw [← mul_eq_self hc, Cardinal.lift_mul]
    apply mul_le_mul' hι (ciSup_le' _)
    simpa [← lift_card]

name: card_iSup_le
statement:
theorem card_iSup_le {ι : Type*} {c : Cardinal} {f : ι → Ordinal}
    (hι : #ι ≤ c) (hf : ∀ i, (f i).card ≤ c) : (⨆ i, f i).card ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Cardinal.lift_le] at hι
  simpa using card_iSup_le_lift hι hf

name: card_iSup_Iio_le_of_lift
proof:
:= by
  apply card_iSup_le_lift _ hf
  conv_rhs => rw [← Cardinal.lift_lift.{u, u + 1}]
  rwa [Cardinal.mk_Iio_ordinal, Cardinal.lift_lift, ← Cardinal.lift_lift.{v, u + 1},
    Cardinal.lift_le]

name: card_iSup_Iio_le
statement:
theorem card_iSup_Iio_le {o : Ordinal} {c : Cardinal} {f : Iio o → Ordinal}
    (hι : o.card ≤ c) (hf : ∀ i, (f i).card ≤ c) : (⨆ i, f i).card ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Cardinal.lift_le] at hι
  simpa using card_iSup_Iio_le_of_lift hι hf

name: card_sSup_le
statement:
theorem card_sSup_le {c : Cardinal} {s : Set Ordinal.{u}}
    (hs : #s ≤ Cardinal.lift.{u + 1} c) (hs' : ∀ x ∈ s, x.card ≤ c) : (sSup s).card ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [sSup_eq_iSup']
  apply card_iSup_le_lift
  · rwa [Cardinal.lift_id'.{u, u + 1}]
  · simpa

name: card_nfpFamily_le
statement:
theorem card_nfpFamily_le {ι : Type v} {f : ι → Ordinal → Ordinal}
    {c : Cardinal} (hc : ℵ₀ ≤ c) (hι : Cardinal.lift.{u} #ι ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v} c)
    (hf : ∀ i x, (f i x).card ≤ max c x.card) (o : Ordinal) :
    (nfpFamily f o).card ≤ max c o.card
proof:
:= by
  have : Small.{u} ι := small_of_lift_mk_le_lift hι
  replace hι : #(Shrink.{u} ι) ≤ c := by rwa [← Cardinal.lift_le.{v}, Cardinal.lift_mk_shrink' ι]
  set σ := equivShrink (List ι) |>.symm
  rw [nfpFamily, ← Equiv.iSup_comp σ]
  apply card_iSup_le_sum_card (List.foldr f o <| σ ·) |>.trans <|
    sum_le_lift_mk_mul_iSup _ |>.trans <|
    mul_le_mul' (b := c) ?_ (d := max c o.card) ?_ |>.trans ?_
  · simp only [Cardinal.lift_id]
    apply max_le hc hι |>.trans'
    grw [mk_congr (σ.trans (equivShrink ι).listEquivOfEquiv), mk_list_le_max (Shrink ι)]
  · have : Nonempty (Shrink (List ι)) := ⟨σ.symm []⟩
    apply ciSup_le fun i => ?_
    induction σ i with
    | nil => simp
    | cons => grind
  · rw [Cardinal.mul_eq_max hc (le_trans hc (le_max_left _ _)), ← max_assoc, max_self]

name: card_derivFamily_le
statement:
theorem card_derivFamily_le {ι : Type v} {f : ι → Ordinal → Ordinal}
    {c : Cardinal} (hc : ℵ₀ ≤ c) (hι : Cardinal.lift.{u} #ι ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v} c)
    (hf : ∀ i x, (f i x).card ≤ max c x.card) (o : Ordinal) :
    (derivFamily f o).card ≤ max c o.card
proof:
:= by
  induction o using limitRecOn with
  | zero => simpa using card_nfpFamily_le hc hι hf 0
  | add_one o ih =>
    simp only [derivFamily_add_one, card_add_one]
    grw [card_nfpFamily_le hc hι hf ((derivFamily f o) + 1), card_add_one, ih]
    suffices max c o.card + 1 ≤ c ∨ c ≤ o.card + 1 ∧ c ≤ o.card by simp [this]
    rcases lt_or_ge c o.card with ho | ho
    · simp [ho.le, hc.trans ho.le]
    · simp [ho, hc]
  | limit o ho ih =>
    rw [derivFamily_limit f ho]
    apply card_iSup_Iio_le_card_mul_iSup _ |>.trans <|
      mul_le_mul' (Cardinal.lift_le.mpr <| le_max_right c o.card)
        (ciSup_le' (a := max c o.card) ?_) |>.trans ?_
    · exact fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => ih _ hi |>.trans <| max_le_max_left _ (card_le_card hi.le)
    · grw [Cardinal.lift_id, ← sq, power_nat_le (by simp [hc])]

name: card_nfp_le_of_forall_le
statement:
theorem card_nfp_le_of_forall_le {o : Ordinal} {f : Ordinal → Ordinal}
    (hf : ∀ x, (f x).card ≤ max ℵ₀ x.card) : (nfp f o).card ≤ max ℵ₀ o.card

name: card_deriv_le_of_forall_le
statement:
theorem card_deriv_le_of_forall_le {o : Ordinal} {f : Ordinal → Ordinal}
    (hf : ∀ x, (f x).card ≤ max ℵ₀ x.card) : (deriv f o).card ≤ max ℵ₀ o.card

name: card_opow_le_of_omega0_le_left
statement:
theorem card_opow_le_of_omega0_le_left {a : Ordinal} (ha : ω ≤ a) (b : Ordinal) :
    (a ^ b).card ≤ max a.card b.card
proof:
:= by
  induction b using limitRecOn with
  | zero => simpa using one_lt_omega0.le.trans ha
  | add_one b IH =>
    rw [opow_add_one, card_mul, card_add_one, Cardinal.mul_eq_max_of_aleph0_le_right]
    · grw [IH, max_comm, ← max_assoc, max_self, ← le_self_add]
    · rw [ne_eq, card_eq_zero, opow_eq_zero]
      rintro ⟨rfl, -⟩
      cases omega0_pos.not_ge ha
    · rwa [aleph0_le_card]
  | limit b hb IH =>
    rw [(isNormal_opow (one_lt_omega0.trans_le ha)).apply_of_isSuccLimit hb]
    exact card_iSup_Iio_le (le_max_right ..) fun i ↦
      (IH i i.2).trans (max_le_max_left _ (card_le_card i.2.le))

name: card_opow_le_of_omega0_le_right
statement:
theorem card_opow_le_of_omega0_le_right (a : Ordinal) {b : Ordinal} (hb : ω ≤ b) :
    (a ^ b).card ≤ max a.card b.card
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ | ha := eq_natCast_or_omega0_le a
  · apply (card_le_card <| opow_le_opow_left b (natCast_lt_omega0 n).le).trans
    apply (card_opow_le_of_omega0_le_left le_rfl _).trans
    simp [hb]
  · exact card_opow_le_of_omega0_le_left ha b

name: card_opow_le
statement: theorem card_opow_le (a b : Ordinal) : (a ^ b).card ≤ max ℵ₀ (max a.card b.card)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ | ha := eq_natCast_or_omega0_le a
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ | hb := eq_natCast_or_omega0_le b
    · rw [opow_natCast, ← natCast_pow, card_nat]
      exact le_max_of_le_left natCast_le_aleph0
    · exact (card_opow_le_of_omega0_le_right _ hb).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  · exact (card_opow_le_of_omega0_le_left ha _).trans (le_max_right _ _)

name: card_opow_eq_of_omega0_le_left
statement:
theorem card_opow_eq_of_omega0_le_left {a b : Ordinal} (ha : ω ≤ a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    (a ^ b).card = max a.card b.card
proof:
:= by
  apply (card_opow_le_of_omega0_le_left ha b).antisymm (max_le _ _) <;> apply card_le_card
  · exact left_le_opow a hb
  · exact right_le_opow b (one_lt_omega0.trans_le ha)

name: card_opow_eq_of_omega0_le_right
statement:
theorem card_opow_eq_of_omega0_le_right {a b : Ordinal} (ha : 1 < a) (hb : ω ≤ b) :
    (a ^ b).card = max a.card b.card
proof:
:= by
  apply (card_opow_le_of_omega0_le_right a hb).antisymm (max_le _ _) <;> apply card_le_card
  · exact left_le_opow a (omega0_pos.trans_le hb)
  · exact right_le_opow b ha

name: card_omega0_opow
statement: theorem card_omega0_opow {a : Ordinal} (h : a ≠ 0) : card (ω ^ a) = max ℵ₀ a.card

name: card_opow_omega0
statement: theorem card_opow_omega0 {a : Ordinal} (h : 1 < a) : card (a ^ ω) = max ℵ₀ a.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_opow_eq_of_omega0_le_right h le_rfl, card_omega0, max_comm]

name: isPrincipal_opow_omega
statement: theorem isPrincipal_opow_omega (o : Ordinal) : IsPrincipal (· ^ ·) (ω_ o)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ho := eq_zero_or_pos o
  · rw [omega_zero]
    exact isPrincipal_opow_omega0
  · intro a b ha hb
    rw [lt_omega_iff_card_lt] at ha hb ⊢
    apply (card_opow_le a b).trans_lt (max_lt _ (max_lt ha hb))
    rwa [← aleph_zero, aleph_lt_aleph]

name: IsInitial.isPrincipal_opow
statement:
theorem IsInitial.isPrincipal_opow {o : Ordinal} (h : IsInitial o) (ho : ω ≤ o) :
    IsPrincipal (· ^ ·) o
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := mem_range_omega_iff.2 ⟨ho, h⟩
  exact isPrincipal_opow_omega a

name: isPrincipal_opow_ord
statement: theorem isPrincipal_opow_ord {c : Cardinal} (hc : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : IsPrincipal (· ^ ·) c.ord

name: isPrincipal_add_ord
statement: theorem isPrincipal_add_ord {c : Cardinal} (hc : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : IsPrincipal (· + ·) c.ord
proof:
:= by
  intro a b ha hb
  rw [lt_ord, card_add] at *
  exact add_lt_of_lt hc ha hb

name: IsInitial.isPrincipal_add
statement:
theorem IsInitial.isPrincipal_add {o : Ordinal} (h : IsInitial o) (ho : ω ≤ o) :
    IsPrincipal (· + ·) o
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.ord_card]
  apply isPrincipal_add_ord
  rwa [aleph0_le_card]

name: isPrincipal_add_omega
statement: theorem isPrincipal_add_omega (o : Ordinal) : IsPrincipal (· + ·) (ω_ o)

name: isPrincipal_mul_ord
statement: theorem isPrincipal_mul_ord {c : Cardinal} (hc : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : IsPrincipal (· * ·) c.ord
proof:
:= by
  intro a b ha hb
  rw [lt_ord, card_mul] at *
  exact mul_lt_of_lt hc ha hb

name: IsInitial.isPrincipal_mul
statement:
theorem IsInitial.isPrincipal_mul {o : Ordinal} (h : IsInitial o) (ho : ω ≤ o) :
    IsPrincipal (· * ·) o
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.ord_card]
  apply isPrincipal_mul_ord
  rwa [aleph0_le_card]

name: isPrincipal_mul_omega
statement: theorem isPrincipal_mul_omega (o : Ordinal) : IsPrincipal (· * ·) (ω_ o)

name: exists_embedding_disjoint_range_of_add_le_ENat_card
statement:
theorem exists_embedding_disjoint_range_of_add_le_ENat_card
    [Finite s] (hs : s.ncard + n ≤ ENat.card α) :
    ∃ y : Fin n ↪ α, Disjoint s (range y)
proof:
:= by
  rsuffices ⟨y⟩ : Nonempty (Fin n ↪ (sᶜ : Set α))
  · use y.trans (subtype _)
    rw [Set.disjoint_right]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    simpa only [← mem_compl_iff] using! Subtype.coe_prop (y i)
  rcases finite_or_infinite α with hα | hα
  · let _ : Fintype α := Fintype.ofFinite α
    classical
    apply nonempty_of_card_le
    rwa [Fintype.card_fin, ← add_le_add_iff_left s.ncard,
      ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_coe_set_eq,
        ncard_add_ncard_compl, ← ENat.natCast_le_natCast,
        ← ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard, ENat.natCast_add]
  · exact ⟨valEmbedding.trans s.toFinite.infinite_compl.to_subtype.natEmbedding⟩

name: exists_embedding_disjoint_range_of_add_le_Nat_card
statement:
theorem exists_embedding_disjoint_range_of_add_le_Nat_card
    [Finite α] (hs : s.ncard + n ≤ Nat.card α) :
    ∃ y : Fin n ↪ α, Disjoint s (range y)
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_embedding_disjoint_range_of_add_le_ENat_card
  rwa [← ENat.natCast_add, ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard, ENat.natCast_le_natCast]

name: restrictSurjective_of_add_le_ENatCard
statement:
theorem restrictSurjective_of_add_le_ENatCard (hn : m + n ≤ ENat.card α) :
    Surjective (fun (x : Fin (m + n) ↪ α) ↦ (Fin.castAddEmb n).trans x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ :=
    exists_embedding_disjoint_range_of_add_le_ENat_card (s := range x)
      (by simpa [← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Nat.card_range_of_injective x.injective])
  use append hxy
  ext i
  simp [trans_apply, coe_castAddEmb, append]

name: restrictSurjective_of_le_ENatCard
statement:
theorem restrictSurjective_of_le_ENatCard (hmn : m ≤ n) (hn : n ≤ ENat.card α) :
    Function.Surjective (fun x : Fin n ↪ α ↦ (castLEEmb hmn).trans x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hmn
  exact Fin.Embedding.restrictSurjective_of_add_le_ENatCard hn

name: restrictSurjective_of_add_le_natCard
statement:
theorem restrictSurjective_of_add_le_natCard [Finite α] (hn : m + n ≤ Nat.card α) :
    Surjective (fun x : Fin (m + n) ↪ α ↦ (castAddEmb n).trans x)
proof:
:= by
  apply restrictSurjective_of_add_le_ENatCard
  rwa [← ENat.natCast_add, ENat.card_eq_coe_natCard, ENat.natCast_le_natCast]

name: restrictSurjective_of_le_natCard
statement:
theorem restrictSurjective_of_le_natCard [Finite α] (hmn : m ≤ n) (hn : n ≤ Nat.card α) :
    Function.Surjective (fun x : Fin n ↪ α ↦ (castLEEmb hmn).trans x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hmn
  exact Fin.Embedding.restrictSurjective_of_add_le_natCard hn

name: isUnit_iff
statement: theorem isUnit_iff : IsUnit a ↔ a = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun h => ?_, by
      rintro rfl
      exact isUnit_one⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha)
  · exact (not_isUnit_zero h).elim
  rw [isUnit_iff_forall_dvd] at h
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h 1
  rw [eq_comm, mul_eq_one_iff_of_one_le] at ht
  · exact ht.1
  · exact Cardinal.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha
  · apply Cardinal.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr
    intro h
    rw [h, mul_zero] at ht
    exact zero_ne_one ht

name: le_of_dvd
statement: theorem le_of_dvd {a b : Cardinal} (hb : b ≠ 0) (hdiv : a ∣ b) : a ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hdiv
  apply le_mul_right
  simp_all

name: dvd_of_le_of_aleph0_le
statement: theorem dvd_of_le_of_aleph0_le (ha : a ≠ 0) (h : a ≤ b) (hb : ℵ₀ ≤ b) : a ∣ b

name: prime_of_aleph0_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prime_of_aleph0_le (ha : ℵ₀ ≤ a) : Prime a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(aleph0_pos.trans_le ha).ne', ?_, fun b c hbc => ?_⟩
  · rw [isUnit_iff]
    exact (one_lt_aleph0.trans_le ha).ne'
  rcases eq_or_ne (b * c) 0 with hz | hz
  · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with (rfl | rfl) <;> simp
  wlog h : c ≤ b
  · cases le_total c b <;> [solve_by_elim; rw [or_comm]]
    apply_assumption
    assumption'
    all_goals rwa [mul_comm]
  left
  have habc := le_of_dvd hz hbc
  rwa [mul_eq_max' <| ha.trans <| habc, max_def', ite_eq_left h] at hbc

name: not_irreducible_of_aleph0_le
statement: theorem not_irreducible_of_aleph0_le (ha : ℵ₀ ≤ a) : ¬Irreducible a
proof:
:= by
  rw [irreducible_iff, not_and_or]
  refine Or.inr fun h => ?_
  simpa [mul_aleph0_eq ha, isUnit_iff, (one_lt_aleph0.trans_le ha).ne', one_lt_aleph0.ne'] using
    @h a ℵ₀

name: nat_coe_dvd_iff
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem nat_coe_dvd_iff : (n : Cardinal) ∣ m ↔ n ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun ⟨h, ht⟩ => ⟨h, mod_cast ht⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
  have : ↑m < ℵ₀ := natCast_lt_aleph0
  rw [hk, mul_lt_aleph0_iff] at this
  rcases this with (h | h | ⟨-, hk'⟩)
  iterate 2 simp only [h, mul_zero, zero_mul, Nat.cast_eq_zero] at hk; simp [hk]
  lift k to ℕ using hk'
  exact ⟨k, mod_cast hk⟩

name: nat_is_prime_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nat_is_prime_iff : Prime (n : Cardinal) ↔ n.Prime
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Prime, Nat.prime_iff]
  refine and_congr (by simp) (and_congr ?_ ⟨fun h b c hbc => ?_, fun h b c hbc => ?_⟩)
  · simp only [isUnit_iff, Nat.isUnit_iff]
    exact mod_cast Iff.rfl
  · exact mod_cast h b c (mod_cast hbc)
  rcases lt_or_ge (b * c) ℵ₀ with h' | h'
  · rcases mul_lt_aleph0_iff.mp h' with (rfl | rfl | ⟨hb, hc⟩)
    · simp
    · simp
    lift b to ℕ using hb
    lift c to ℕ using hc
    exact mod_cast h b c (mod_cast hbc)
  rcases aleph0_le_mul_iff.mp h' with ⟨hb, hc, hℵ₀⟩
  have hn : (n : Cardinal) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, zero_dvd_iff, mul_eq_zero] at hbc
    cases hbc <;> contradiction
  wlog hℵ₀b : ℵ₀ ≤ b
  apply (this h c b _ _ hc hb hℵ₀.symm hn (hℵ₀.resolve_left hℵ₀b)).symm <;> try assumption
  · rwa [mul_comm] at hbc
  · rwa [mul_comm] at h'
  · exact Or.inl (dvd_of_le_of_aleph0_le hn (natCast_lt_aleph0.le.trans hℵ₀b) hℵ₀b)

name: is_prime_iff
statement: theorem is_prime_iff {a : Cardinal} : Prime a ↔ ℵ₀ ≤ a ∨ ∃ p : ℕ, a = p ∧ p.Prime
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt ℵ₀ a with h | h
  · simp [h]
  lift a to ℕ using id h
  simp [not_le.mpr h]

name: isPrimePow_iff
statement: theorem isPrimePow_iff {a : Cardinal} : IsPrimePow a ↔ ℵ₀ ≤ a ∨ ∃ n : ℕ, a = n ∧ IsPrimePow n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ℵ₀ ≤ a
  · simp [h, (prime_of_aleph0_le h).isPrimePow]
  simp only [h, false_or, isPrimePow_nat_iff]
  lift a to ℕ using not_le.mp h
  rw [isPrimePow_def]
  refine
    ⟨?_, fun ⟨n, han, p, k, hp, hk, h⟩ =>
          ⟨p, k, nat_is_prime_iff.2 hp, hk, by rw [han]; exact mod_cast h⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨p, k, hp, hk, hpk⟩
  have key : p ^ (1 : Cardinal) ≤ ↑a := by
    rw [← hpk]; apply power_le_power_left hp.ne_zero; exact mod_cast hk
  rw [power_one] at key
  lift p to ℕ using key.trans_lt natCast_lt_aleph0
  exact ⟨a, rfl, p, k, nat_is_prime_iff.mp hp, hk, mod_cast hpk⟩

theorem mk_freeGroup [Nonempty α] : #(FreeGroup α) = max #α ℵ₀
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (mk_le_of_injective (FreeGroup.toWord_injective (α := α))).trans_eq
    simp only [mk_list_eq_max_mk_aleph0, mk_prod, lift_uzero, mk_fintype, Fintype.card_bool,
      Nat.cast_ofNat, lift_ofNat]
    obtain hα | hα := lt_or_ge #α ℵ₀
    · simp only [hα.le, max_eq_right, max_eq_right_iff]
      exact (mul_lt_aleph0 hα natCast_lt_aleph0).le
    · rw [max_eq_left hα, max_eq_left (hα.trans <| Cardinal.le_mul_right two_ne_zero),
        Cardinal.mul_eq_left hα _ (by simp)]
      exact natCast_le_aleph0.trans hα
  · apply max_le
    · exact mk_le_of_injective FreeGroup.of_injective
    · simp

  · rw [mem_pullSub_short h'] at h; exact mem_of_prefix h.1 (by simpa using h.2)

:= by

  · by_cases hp : x <+: z
    · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hp
      simp [pullSub, List.take_add]
    · constructor <;> intro ⟨h, _⟩ <;>
        [skip; replace h := by simpa [List.take_take] using h.take x.length] <;>
        cases hp <| List.prefix_iff_eq_take.mpr (h.eq_of_length (by simpa)).symm
  · rw [mem_pullSub_short hl, mem_pullSub_short (by simp), mem_pullSub_short (by simp; lia)]
    simpa using fun _ ↦ (z.isPrefix_append_of_length hl).symm

name: lift_cof_congr_of_strictMono
statement:
theorem lift_cof_congr_of_strictMono {f : α → β} (hf : StrictMono f) (hf' : IsCofinal (range f)) :
    lift.{v} (cof α) = lift.{u} (cof β)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm <;> rw [le_lift_cof_iff] <;> intro s hs
  · have H (x : s) : ∃ y : α, x ≤ f y := by simpa using hf' x
    choose g hg using H
    refine (lift_le.2 <| cof_le (s := range g) fun a ↦ ?_).trans mk_range_le_lift
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨b, rfl⟩, hb⟩ := hf' (f a)
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩ := hs (f b)
    refine ⟨_, Set.mem_range_self ⟨c, hc⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← hf.le_iff_le]
    exact hb.trans (hc'.trans (hg ⟨c, hc⟩))
  · exact (lift_le.2 <| cof_le (hs.image hf.monotone hf')).trans mk_image_le_lift

    exact hs'.trans_lt h
  obtain ⟨t, ht, ht'⟩ := hf.exists_subsingleton_isCofinal hs
  apply (cof_le ht').trans
  simpa

statement:
theorem exists_ord_cof_eq [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α] :
    ∃ s : Set α, IsCofinal s ∧ typeLT s = (Order.cof α).ord
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ := exists_cof_eq α
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩ := exists_ord_eq s
  have ht := hs.trans (isCofinal_setOfPred_imp_lt r)
  refine ⟨_, ht, (ord_le.2 (cof_le ht)).antisymm' ?_⟩
  rw [← hs', hr', type_le_iff']
  refine ⟨.ofMonotone (fun x ↦ ⟨x.1, ?_⟩) fun x y hxy ↦ ?_⟩
  · grind
  · apply (trichotomous_of r _ _).resolve_right
    rintro (_ | hxy')
    · simp_all [Subtype.coe_inj]
    · obtain ⟨x, z, hz, rfl⟩ := x

statement:
theorem lift_cof_iSup_add_one [Small.{u} β] {f : β → Ordinal} (hf : StrictMono f) :
    Cardinal.lift.{v} (cof (⨆ i, f i + 1)) = Cardinal.lift.{u} (Order.cof β)
proof:
:= by
  have : StrictMono (β := Iio (⨆ i, f i + 1)) (fun i ↦ ⟨f i, ?_⟩) := fun x y h ↦ hf h
  · have := lift_cof_congr_of_strictMono this ?_
    · rw [← Cardinal.lift_inj.{_, max (u + 1) v}, Cardinal.lift_lift.{_, _, v},
        Cardinal.lift_umax.{_, u + 1}, Cardinal.lift_umax.{_, u + 1}, this]
      simp
    · intro ⟨b, hb⟩
      rw [mem_Iio, Ordinal.lt_iSup_add_one_iff] at hb
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hb
      exact ⟨_, Set.mem_range_self i, hi⟩
  · rw [mem_Iio]
    exact (lt_add_one _).trans_le <| le_ciSup bddAbove_of_small _

name: cof_iSup_add_one
statement:
theorem cof_iSup_add_one {f : γ → Ordinal} (hf : StrictMono f) :
    cof (⨆ i, f i + 1) = Order.cof γ

name: lift_cof_iSup
statement:
theorem lift_cof_iSup [Small.{u} β] [NoMaxOrder β] {f : β → Ordinal} (hf : StrictMono f) :
    Cardinal.lift.{v} (cof (⨆ i, f i)) = Cardinal.lift.{u} (Order.cof β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_add_one hf, lift_cof_iSup_add_one hf]

name: cof_iSup
statement:
theorem cof_iSup [NoMaxOrder γ] {f : γ → Ordinal} (hf : StrictMono f) :
    cof (⨆ i, f i) = Order.cof γ

name: cof_iSup_Iio_add_one
statement:
theorem cof_iSup_Iio_add_one {a} {f : Iio a → Ordinal} (hf : StrictMono f) :
    cof (⨆ i, f i + 1) = cof a
proof:
:= by
  simpa [← lift_cof] using lift_cof_iSup_add_one hf

name: cof_iSup_Iio
statement:
theorem cof_iSup_Iio {a} {f : Iio a → Ordinal} (hf : StrictMono f) (ha : IsSuccPrelimit a) :
    cof (⨆ i, f i) = cof a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iSup_Iio_add_one hf ha, cof_iSup_Iio_add_one hf]

name: cof_map_of_isNormal
statement: theorem cof_map_of_isNormal {f} (hf : IsNormal f) {a} (ha : IsSuccLimit a) : cof (f a) = cof a
proof:
:= by
  rw [hf.apply_of_isSuccLimit ha, cof_iSup_Iio _ ha.isSuccPrelimit]
  exact hf.strictMono.comp <| Subtype.strictMono_coe _

name: le_cof_map_of_isNormal
statement: theorem le_cof_map_of_isNormal {f} (hf : IsNormal f) (a) : cof a ≤ cof (f a)
proof:
:= by
  cases a using limitRecOn with
  | zero => simp
  | add_one a =>
    rw [cof_add_one, Cardinal.one_le_iff_ne_zero, cof_eq_zero.ne]
    exact (hf.strictMono (lt_succ a)).ne_zero
  | limit a ha => rw [cof_map_of_isNormal hf ha]

name: sSup_add_one_lt_of_lt_cof
statement:
theorem sSup_add_one_lt_of_lt_cof {s : Set Ordinal.{u}} {a : Ordinal.{u}}
    (ha : #s < (lift.{u + 1} a).cof) (hs : ∀ i ∈ s, i < a) : sSup ((· + 1) '' s) < a
proof:
:= by
  let f := OrderIso.ofRelIsoLT (enum (α := s) (· < ·))
  have : Small.{u} (Iio (typeLT s)) := by
    refine small_of_injective (β := Iio a) (f := fun x ↦ ⟨f x, hs _ (f x).2⟩) fun _ ↦ ?_
    simp [Subtype.val_inj]
  have : range (fun i ↦ (f i).1 + 1) = (· + 1) '' s := by
    convert! range_comp (· + 1) (fun i ↦ (f i).1)
    rw [range_comp', f.range_eq]
    simp
  rw [← this, sSup_range]
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne
  · simp [hs]
  · rintro rfl
    rw [← lift_cof, ← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, u + 2}, Cardinal.lift_lift,
      lift_cof_iSup_add_one fun _ ↦ by simp, cof_Iio, ← lift_cof, cof_type,
      Cardinal.lift_lift, Cardinal.lift_lt] at ha
    exact ha.not_ge (cof_le_cardinalMk _)

name: sSup_lt_of_lt_cof
statement:
theorem sSup_lt_of_lt_cof {s : Set Ordinal.{u}} {a : Ordinal.{u}}
    (ha : #s < (lift.{u + 1} a).cof) (hs : ∀ i ∈ s, i < a) : sSup s < a

name: lift_iSup_add_one_lt_of_lt_cof
statement:
theorem lift_iSup_add_one_lt_of_lt_cof {f : β → Ordinal.{u}} {a : Ordinal.{u}}
    (ha : Cardinal.lift.{u} #β < (lift.{v} a).cof) (hf : ∀ i, f i < a) : ⨆ i, f i + 1 < a
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSup, range_comp' (· + 1)]
  apply sSup_add_one_lt_of_lt_cof _ (by simpa)
  rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, v}]
  apply mk_range_le_lift.trans_lt
  rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, u + 1}] at ha
  simpa [← lift_cof] using ha

name: iSup_add_one_lt_of_lt_cof
statement:
theorem iSup_add_one_lt_of_lt_cof {f : α → Ordinal.{u}} {a : Ordinal.{u}}
    (ha : #α < a.cof) (hf : ∀ i, f i < a) : ⨆ i, f i + 1 < a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, u}, lift_cof] at ha
  simpa using lift_iSup_add_one_lt_of_lt_cof ha hf

name: lift_iSup_lt_of_lt_cof

theorem lift_iSup_lt_of_lt_cof {f : β → Ordinal.{u}} {a : Ordinal.{u}}
    (ha : Cardinal.lift.{u} #β < (lift.{v} a).cof) (hf : ∀ i, f i < a) : ⨆ i, f i < a

name: iSup_lt_of_lt_cof
statement:
theorem iSup_lt_of_lt_cof {f : α → Ordinal.{u}} {a : Ordinal.{u}}
    (ha : #α < a.cof) (hf : ∀ i, f i < a) : ⨆ i, f i < a
proof:

  rw [← Cardinal.lift_lt.{_, u}, lift_cof] at ha
  simpa using lift_iSup_lt_of_lt_cof ha hf

name: cof_lift_iSup_add_one_le
statement:
theorem cof_lift_iSup_add_one_le [Small.{u} β] (f : β → Ordinal.{u}) :
    cof (lift.{v} (⨆ i, f i + 1)) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{u} (#β)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! hf
  exact (lift_iSup_add_one_lt_of_lt_cof hf <| Ordinal.lt_iSup_add_one _).false

statement:
theorem _root_.Cardinal.sSup_lt_of_lt_cof_ord {s : Set Cardinal.{u}} {a : Cardinal.{u}}

proof:

name: _root_.Cardinal.lift_iSup_lt_of_lt_cof_ord
statement:
theorem _root_.Cardinal.lift_iSup_lt_of_lt_cof_ord {f : β → Cardinal.{u}} {a : Cardinal.{u}}

name: _root_.Cardinal.iSup_lt_of_lt_cof_ord
statement:

name: cof_lsub_def_nonempty
statement:
@[deprecated "to build an increasing function with limit o, use the fundamental sequence API."
(since := "2026-03-27")]
theorem cof_lsub_def_nonempty (o) :
    { a : Cardinal | ∃ (ι : _) (f : ι → Ordinal), lsub.{u, u} f = o ∧ #ι = a }.Nonempty

name: cof_eq_sInf_lsub
statement:
@[deprecated "to build an increasing function with limit o, use the fundamental sequence API."
(since := "2026-03-27")]
theorem cof_eq_sInf_lsub (o : Ordinal.{u}) : cof o =
    sInf { a : Cardinal | ∃ (ι : Type u) (f : ι → Ordinal), lsub.{u, u} f = o ∧ #ι = a }
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_csInf (cof_lsub_def_nonempty o) ?_) (csInf_le' ?_)
  · rintro a ⟨ι, f, hf, rfl⟩
    rw [← hf]
    exact cof_iSup_add_one_le f
  · rcases Order.cof_eq (α := o.ToType) with ⟨S, hS, hS'⟩
    let f : S → Ordinal := fun s => typein LT.lt s.val
    refine ⟨S, f, le_antisymm (lsub_le fun i => typein_lt_self (o := o) i)
      (le_of_forall_lt fun a ha => ?_), by rwa [cof_toType] at hS'⟩
    rw [← type_toType o] at ha
    rcases hS (enum (· < ·) ⟨a, ha⟩) with ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩
    rw [← not_lt, ← typein_le_typein, typein_enum] at hb'
    exact hb'.trans_lt (lt_lsub.{u, u} f ⟨b, hb⟩)

theorem exists_lsub_cof (o : Ordinal) :

theorem cof_lsub_le {ι} (f : ι → Ordinal) : cof (lsub.{u, u} f) ≤ #ι

theorem cof_lsub_le_lift {ι} (f : ι → Ordinal) :
    cof (lsub.{u, v} f) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v, u} #ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lift_id'.{u} (lsub f), ← Cardinal.lift_umax.{u, v}]
  exact cof_lift_iSup_add_one_le _

name: le_cof_iff_lsub
statement:
@[deprecated le_cof_iff (since := "2026-03-21")]
theorem le_cof_iff_lsub {o : Ordinal} {a : Cardinal} :
    a ≤ cof o ↔ ∀ {ι} (f : ι → Ordinal), lsub.{u, u} f = o → a ≤ #ι
proof:
:= by
  rw [cof_eq_sInf_lsub]
  exact
    (le_csInf_iff'' (cof_lsub_def_nonempty o)).trans
      ⟨fun H ι f hf => H _ ⟨ι, f, hf, rfl⟩, fun H b ⟨ι, f, hf, hb⟩ => by
        rw [← hb]
        exact H _ hf⟩

name: nfpFamily_lt_ord_lift
statement:
theorem nfpFamily_lt_ord_lift {ι} {f : ι → Ordinal → Ordinal} {c} (hc : ℵ₀ < cof c)
    (hc' : Cardinal.lift.{v, u} #ι < cof c) (hf : ∀ (i), ∀ b < c, f i b < c) {a} (ha : a < c) :
    nfpFamily f a < c
proof:
:= by
  refine lift_iSup_lt_of_lt_cof ?_ (fun l ↦ ?_)
  · rw [Cardinal.lift_umax, c.lift_id']
    apply (Cardinal.lift_le.2 (mk_list_le_max _)).trans_lt
    rw [Cardinal.lift_max]
    apply max_lt <;> simpa
  · induction l with
    | nil => exact ha
    | cons i l H => exact hf _ _ H

name: nfpFamily_lt_ord
statement:
theorem nfpFamily_lt_ord {ι} {f : ι → Ordinal → Ordinal} {c} (hc : ℵ₀ < cof c) (hc' : #ι < cof c)

name: nfp_lt_ord
statement:
theorem nfp_lt_ord {f : Ordinal → Ordinal} {c} (hc : ℵ₀ < cof c) (hf : ∀ i < c, f i < c) {a} :
    a < c → nfp f a < c
proof:
:=
  nfpFamily_lt_ord_lift hc (by simpa using Cardinal.one_lt_aleph0.trans hc) fun _ => hf

name: exists_blsub_cof
statement:
@[deprecated exists_lsub_cof (since := "2026-03-21")]
theorem exists_blsub_cof (o : Ordinal) :
    ∃ f : ∀ a < (cof o).ord, Ordinal, blsub.{u, u} _ f = o
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_lsub_cof o with ⟨ι, f, hf, hι⟩
  rcases Cardinal.exists_ord_eq ι with ⟨r, hr, hι'⟩
  rw [← @blsub_eq_lsub' ι r hr] at hf
  rw [← hι, hι']
  exact ⟨_, hf⟩

statement:

theorem le_cof_iff_blsub {b : Ordinal} {a : Cardinal} :
    a ≤ cof b ↔ ∀ {o} (f : ∀ a < o, Ordinal), blsub.{u, u} o f = b → a ≤ o.card
proof:
:=
  le_cof_iff_lsub.trans
    ⟨fun H o f hf => by simpa using H _ hf, fun H ι f hf => by
      rcases Cardinal.exists_ord_eq ι with ⟨r, hr, hι'⟩
      rw [← @blsub_eq_lsub' ι r hr] at hf
      simpa using H _ hf⟩

name: cof_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cof_add (a : Ordinal) {b : Ordinal} (hb : b ≠ 0) : cof (a + b) = cof b
proof:
:= by
  rcases zero_or_succ_or_isSuccLimit b with (rfl | ⟨c, rfl⟩ | hb)
  · contradiction
  · rw [succ_eq_add_one, ← add_assoc, cof_add_one, cof_add_one]
  · exact cof_map_of_isNormal (isNormal_add_right a) hb

name: cof_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cof_mul {a b : Ordinal} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : IsSuccPrelimit b) : cof (a * b) = cof b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb' : IsMin b
  · simp [hb'.eq_bot]
  · exact cof_map_of_isNormal (isNormal_mul_right ha.pos) ⟨hb', hb⟩

name: cof_preOmega

proof:

  · simp [h.eq_bot]
  · exact cof_map_of_isNormal isNormal_preOmega ⟨h, ho⟩
